chapters.title: Chapter 951: I Assumed
paragraphs: “Well done. Didn’t he do it well?” Huo Congjun stared at Department Director Kang, and he really looked as if he was asking for advice while showing his might.

Department Director Kang took a spoon and ate the yogurt. He looked at Huo Congjun with an indifferent expression before he gently touched the corner of his mouth, wiped off the liquid that was just flowing out, and said, “He really did it well.”
“Which part?” Huo Congjun asked sincerely, but he sounded as if he was just looking for trouble.

Department Director Kang was shocked by how provocative Huo Congjun was. He took a couple more mouthfuls of yogurt before he finally managed to get over his shock. He had no choice but to cooperate. “The good thing is that he has high efficiency when it comes to barehanded bleeding control, good suturing skills, and his exposure was done sufficiently as well...”
Department Director Kang said those words casually, but something crept into his heart.
He might have casually tossed those words out, but they were not spoken without basis.

Ling Ran’s barehanded bleeding control had always been famous, especially after it was used in front of Professor Feng and others from Beijing. His skills were pretty much well-known in the operating theaters. When doctors had patients whose blood they could not stop, they would often turn to Ling Ran for help. The main reason why Department Director Kang did not attempt barehanded bleeding control before, but he only had a few patients in his hands, and when they suffered from blood loss, they died very quickly, but he still remembered Ling Ran’s reputation when it came to his barehanded bleeding control.

In addition, Ling Ran’s suturing and exposure were still fresh in his memory. It would not be strange if Department Director Kang himself was able to do that, because he had been performing surgeries for around three decades. But Ling Ran was able to execute it so skillfully as well, and Department Director Kang had a hard time believing it when he thought about it.

Cardiac trauma repair was the simplest surgery in the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery, but it was not common. The small surgeries from the field of general surgery could be carried out in town hospitals, but it was not the same case for cardiovascular surgeries.
During Ling Ran’s time in Yun Hua Hospital, it was clear that he had never touched cardiovascular surgeries either.

“Old Kang, you’re an honest man. Here’s a peanut for you.” Huo Congjun took a peanut from the basket and put it into Department Director Kang’s yogurt. “Ling Ran is a doctor who’s blessed by his ancestors. I’m really surprised that he can perform cardiovascular surgeries as well...” he said with a smile.
Department Director Kang laughed dryly.

Huo Congjun was not prepared to let the Department Director Kang speak. He said, “Strictly speaking, cardiac traumas are actually emergency surgeries. Now that we have someone who can perform this surgery in the Emergency Medical Center, I feel relieved too...”

Department Director Kang raised his eyebrows when he heard that. ‘Listen to him! How can HE say such a thing?! Yes, cardiac trauma is considered an emergency surgery. But is it really surgery that can be performed by the Emergency Medical Center? Why doesn’t he just put a crown on his own head and proclaim himself king?!’
“What do you think, Department Director Kang?” Huo Congjun finally stopped speaking. He took a pine nut in his hand and peeled it slowly.

Department Director Kang stared at the young pine nut getting turned and twisted around in Huo Congjun’s huge, rough hand. It moaned as it was ravaged. His heart skipped a beat. “Department Director Huo, what you’ve said is reasonable, but...”

“In truth, there are never a lot of cardiac trauma repair cases. Whenever you are available, I would love it if you come and give advice.” Huo Congjun got up and dropped the pine nut into Department Director Kang’s yogurt cup.
Department Director Kang looked at the unpeeled pine nut in his cup as he got lost in his train of thought. ‘Does Old Hu mean that as long as he’s feeding me, he’s not in the wrong?’

Lu Wenbin felt extremely accomplished while he was in the operating theater. Before this, foreigners were involved, and he could not retain his status as an assistant. Now, as the first assistant, Lu Wenbin was able to touch a man’s heart.
If a man touched a living heart before, he was no longer an ordinary man.
He would be a... (please feel free to insert whatever title you find fit, reader.) [1]
“This is cardiac surgery.” Lu Wenbin removed his gloves and took out his phone to take photos at the end of the surgery.

Lu Wenbin was not the only one who did this. Several other doctors and nurses took out their phones and snapped photos one after another. This was a rare moment that only happened once in a blue moon.
Lu Wenbin looked at the scene and said with great emotion in him, “I’m going to carry out the plan!”
“Pavlov?” Young Nurse Wang Jia’s love for gossip would not be extinguished by the blood on the operating table.

“Yes.” Lu Wenbin nodded vigorously and said, “I think it’s okay for a strong surgeon like me to deliver things regularly. By this point, delivering things can be considered a conditioned reflex in me, right?”
Wang Jia laughed. “You were just sending pork trotters.”
“That’s impossible.” Lu Wenbin’s smile grew even wider. “I didn’t just send pork trotters, I also sent braised pork, small and large intestines, pig’s head meat, and pork snout...”
Wang Jia looked at Lu Wenbin calmly and was speechless for a long time.
“I have a large variety, right?” Lu Wenbin laughed a couple of times and said, “I didn’t expect to be so talented.”
“Talented at being single.” Wang Jia finally could not hold it in anymore.

“Even if I’m single, people like me are considered high-class bachelors.” Lu Wenbin had great mental fortitude and was not affected by what Wang Jia said. In his opinion, he was already incredibly sincere. All his gifts were made of his own products, which was not only a proof of strength. but also a kind of sentiment. After all, his own products were all prepared by himself, which was like a gift made by himself. It was a great show of goodwill and affection.

Lu Wenbin’s fingers stopped moving for a moment over his phone when he thought about this. He then sent out a WeChat message. [We will temporarily suspend sending pork trotters to those we want to flatter.]
“Too bad, Young Ma won’t be able to eat my delicious pork trotters for a few days.” Lu Wenbin put away his phone and pretended to sigh.

“Doctor Lu, you should think twice before you speak.” Wang Jia sincerely persuaded him otherwise before a thought crossed her mind, and she asked, “Doctor Ling, do you think that Doctor Lu’s Pavlov Dating Method is feasible?”
Ling Ran looked at the digits on the screen and replied casually, “Through conditional reflex? It makes sense.”
Lu Wenbin smirked. “Look! Doctor Ling agrees with me, too.”
“Let me ask you another question. How high is the probability of your method working, especially since Doctor Ling approved of it?” Wang Jia also asked a very logical question.
Lu Wenbin was confused.
Ling Ran made sure that the patient was in a stable state. After a while, he went out.

He never cared about the conversations between his doctors and nurses. There would always be people around him chatting and constantly saying something that attracted his attention. Ling Ran also learned not to listen to these people’s words after a long time of self-discipline, otherwise, he would not have enough time for his day.
“Doctor Ling.” Lu Wenbin caught up from behind.
“Yes?” Ling Ran stopped.

Lu Wenbin looked left or right to make sure there was no one around before he whispered, “Um... Doctor Ling. I’m wondering whether you’ll be free over the next few days. I’d like to perform another M-Tang surgery with you.”

Lu Wenbin had been practicing the M-Tang technique for two years and felt that he had reached a bottleneck. When he considered the fact that he might be getting a girlfriend, he would have less time, and Lu Wenbin wanted to take advantage of the time before Pavlov’s method took effect for final special training.
It did not matter to Ling Ran. After thinking about it, he said, “You can get some suitable patients and arrange a schedule with Zuo Cidian.”
“Okay, no problem!” Lu Wenbin clenched his fists and thought of the scene of him being a chief surgeon in M-Tang surgeries as Young Nurse Ma cheered him on with her sweet and gentle voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 952: Plastic
paragraphs: “Young Lu, your M-Tang Technique seems pretty professional now!” Huo Congjun looked at Lu Wenbin who was in the operating theater and kept nodding.
Lu Wenbin who was at the chief surgeon position looked very confident from afar, and the thread in his hands looked as if it was jumping.

“He now has Ling Ran’s essence.” Chief Physician Wang Haiyang from the Hand Surgery Department stared at Lu Wenbin, who was about the same age as Ling Ran, but whose looks were a far contrast from Ling Ran. He felt sentimental and said, “I can still remember Ling Ran’s M-Tang technique. That was not long ago, and now Lu Wenbin has already mastered it.”

“He still needs more practice compared with Ling Ran, but one could say that he has finished his apprenticeship.” Huo Congjun grinned. M-Tang technique was a surgery done at Zone II of the hand, so this was a skill that could make a surgeon very proud of himself once he mastered it. Furthermore, there was never a lack of surgeries for the hand at Yun Hua Hospital. Once Lu Wenbin mastered this skill, he could largely reduce Ling Ran’s surgical pressure and also increase the surgical volume of the Emergency Medical Center.

Certainly, it was inevitable that the Hand Surgery Department would be affected. But when Ling Ran had performed surgeries for the Hand Surgery Department nonstop and they said nothing about it, Lu Wenbin alone would naturally not bring about much of an effect to them.
“I hope that you can keep an eye on Young Lu, Chief Physician Wang. No matter what, these youngsters’ skills are cruder.” Huo Congjun shamelessly requested.
Wang Haiyang chuckled in annoyance and said, “You are making me slash my own throat, huh?”

“Not at all.” Huo Congjun immediately waved and said, “Lu Wenbin is not as bright as Ling Ran and loves to do stuff in the kitchen as well. Therefore, he cannot be compared with Ling Ran in the future. But since he’s willing to learn, we should help him, shouldn’t we?”
Huo Congjun phrased his words ingeniously in order to give protection to Lu Wenbin.

When Wang Haiyang heard what Huo Conjun said, he found himself not affected by it at all. He then remembered the supermarket loyalty card given by Lu Wenbin, he became soft-hearted and said, “If there is any chance in the future, I’ll help whenever I can.”
Wang Haiyang did not say anything definitive.

Speaking of which, he did really like taking in freelance surgeries that required him to mend the mistakes made by others. If he had to mend mistakes made by sensible doctors like Lu Wenbin, it might even be easier, and he could even earn more.

Huo Congjun naturally thanked him repeatedly. Once he was done, he sighed in relief. He pointed at the operating table at the ground floor, smiled, and said, “Previously, I only observed Ling Ran’s surgery, and now, I’m not used to observing other doctors’ surgeries.”
However, Huo Congjun’s tone made him sound really smug.
“Ling Ran’s style is still very obvious in his movements,” Wang Haiyang said in an airy tone.
“What do you mean?”
“Take a look at the incision and the exposure habit. That is all Ling Ran’s style.” Wang Haiyang had performed hand surgery for many years and performed extensive research on it.
Huo Congjun could understand it as well and just flattered Wang Haiyang, “Since you said that, it really seems like it...”

“It should be true. That’s the habit of a doctor. When Lu Wenbin brings his skills to the table next time, people would not even need to look at his face to know that he was under Ling Ran.” Once Wai Haiyang was flattered by Huo Congjun, a smile could be seen on his face. It was a face that belonged only to a chief physician, not even an associate department director. “In fact, look, Ling Ran is actually standing across Lu Wenbin right now.”
“Young doctors are always like that.” Huo Congjun smiled.
“Yes. When they’re in front of high-ranking doctors, young doctors will be bolder.” Wang Haiyang nodded but said, “If I stood at his position, I’d make some maneuvers I usually won’t dare make.”
“Hmm?” Huo Congjun did not understand it.
“I’ll just let Ling Ran cover for anything that happens,” Wang Haiyang said frankly before he started to laugh.
Huo Congjun could not help but shake his head. When he saw Wang Haiyang’s smile, he became jealous.

Chief physicians like Wang Haiyang had stopped thinking about climbing further up their careers, and because of it, they could live more relaxing and free lives. Basically, they could just say anything they thought and do anything they wanted... as long as the other party cooperated with them.
“Doctor Ling, I’ll start with the suture,” Lu Wenbin’s voice was heard from the ground floor, and he sounded very strong confidence.
“Okay,” Ling Ran replied, and he continued to help with checking the patient.
Ling Ran was quite experienced in becoming the assistant, but not with being the assistant for M-Tang technique procedures. That provided Ling Ran with a new perspective.
Lu Wenbin felt even better now.

Over the two years he performed the M-Tang technique, he was either Ling Ran’s assistant or was the chief surgeon alone. He always felt that something was missing because he did not have someone teaching him by the side, which was something he had while he was still a student.
When Lu Wenbin performed his surgery with Ling Ran today, Lu Wenbin tried performing the surgeries through multiple angles, and the result was indeed different.
“Special training is indeed different.” Lu Wenbin was overwhelmed.
Ling Ran still replied with just an “okay”.
“Previously, I was quite hesitant when I performed this surgery...” Lu Wenbin was used to Ling Ran’s attitude and kept talking to himself.
Ling Ran was okay with listening to what Lu Wenbin said until the surgery ended.
Right then, he heard Wang Jia say, “Who knew that once Lu Wenbin became the chief surgeon, he would become so long-winded?”
The doctors who were in the visitation room above could not help but smile.
Lu Wenbin happily cleaned himself and stayed in the on-call room and sent a WeChat message to Young Nurse Ma.

To him, his Pavlov’s Dating Method had produced an effect. It had just been two days since Young Nurse Ma did not have pork trotters, and she had already begun searching for an excuse to send him WeChat messages.
Of course, Lu Wenbin did not exercise any self-restraint as well.
After all, he believed that chatting without meeting would not have an effect on his Pavlov’s Dating Method.
“That’s why good things always come in pairs.” Lu Wenbin rested in the chair in the on-call room, sent WeChat messages, and showed off.
Zhao Leyi, who had to buy his wife a handbag once every few months using his own money, stared at Lu Wenbin and smiled faintly. “You’re right. The best is waiting for you ahead.”
Lu Wenbin nodded happily, and his typing speed became faster.
At the nurses’ station, Young Nurse Ma looked at the chat record on her phone, and she was in a bit of a daze.
“What happened? Can’t continue the conversation anymore?” the nurse at the side asked, wanting to gossip.
Young Nurse Ma said lackadaisically, “He’s a straight guy, so what else can I do about it? I can’t just give him a pass just because he said something wrong, right?”
“That’s more like it. But you don’t want to give him the pass because you can’t bear to give up on the new houses he bought, right?”

“Even the dog in my neighborhood won’t be able to give him the pass.” Young Nurse Ma sighed. “So many pork trotters and braised meat... If this happened forty years ago, my father would force me to marry him.”
*Beep*
Her phone started to vibrate again.
Young Nurse Ma took her phone, cast a look, and shrugged.
“Lu Wenbin’s?”
“Who else do you think?”
“Did he say something wrong?”
“Not really.” Young Nurse Ma shook her head and said, “Lu Wenbin said that he was preparing to change his WeChat username to True Hero because he had touched the patient’s heart.”
Young Nurse Ma smiled as she said that and started to type in WeChat, [Don’t you find it disgusting to touch the heart? Aren’t you afraid?]
[You typed quite a lot.] Her fake bestie craned her neck to take a look at her phone, and she was impressed.
In the on-call room, Lu Wenbin could not help to stand up.
“What happened?” The doctors at the side looked at him strangely.
“Hmm... Suddenly, I feel that Young Nurse Ma is boring.” The thought suddenly popped up in Lu Wenbin’s mind, and it went spiraling from there.

“Even the dog in my neighborhood won’t be able to give him the pass.” Young Nurse Ma sighed.
“So many pork trotters and braised meat...
If this happened forty years ago, my father would force me to marry him.”
*Beep*
Her phone started to vibrate again.
Young Nurse Ma took her phone, cast a look, and shrugged.
“Lu Wenbin’s?”
“Who else do you think?”
“Did he say something wrong?”
“Not really.” Young Nurse Ma shook her head and said, “Lu Wenbin said that he was preparing to change his WeChat username to True Hero because he had touched the patient’s heart.”
Young Nurse Ma smiled as she said that and started to type in WeChat, [Don’t you find it disgusting to touch the heart?
Aren’t you afraid?]
[You typed quite a lot.] Her fake bestie craned her neck to take a look at her phone, and she was impressed.
In the on-call room, Lu Wenbin could not help to stand up.
“What happened?” The doctors at the side looked at him strangely.
“Hmm...
Suddenly, I feel that Young Nurse Ma is boring.” The thought suddenly popped up in Lu Wenbin’s mind, and it went spiraling from there.

chapters.title: Chapter 953: Clinic Situation
paragraphs: When Ling Ran was back home at Lower Groove Clinic, he immediately went and slept until eight the next morning. Then, he got up and washed up.
With the Energy Serum helping him, he was actually not sleepy. However, sleeping was a good feeling, especially when he could sleep on his own bed.
“Son, you’re awake?” When Ling Jiezhou saw Ling Ran come down, he could not help but sigh in relief. He relaxed, and his fat tummy became soft again.
“Yes, I’m awake.”

“I made porridge for you. I even fried some pancakes and warmed up the milk for you. There is also some donkey meat and freshly cooked vegetables... I also cut you fruits...” Ling Jiezhou introduced all the delicious dishes on the table.
Ling Ran was surprised. “What happened?”

Tao Ping smiled and stared at Ling Jiezhou before he said, “Your dad is worried about you. When he woke up, he thought he could eat the porridge that you prepared, but when he came over, he found that the kitchen is cold, and started to worry about you.”

“Young Ran usually wakes up very early.” Ling Jiezhou was a bit embarrassed and coughed. He then asked Ling Ran, “Is it too tiring at the hospital? Just take a two-day leave if you’re too tired. Aren’t you the group leader now? It should make some adjustments so that you can take leave, right?”
“I’m not too tired. I just wanted to sleep a little bit more.” Ling Ran sat in front of the table, took the chopsticks, and gobbled up the food.
“I have to say, if you want to sleep, just sleep as much as you want. Sometimes, sleeping more is better than anything else...” Ling Jiezhou smiled and sat in front Ling Ran.
Tao Ping had not seen her son for a few days. Hence, she took her teacup and sat by the side. She felt at ease when she saw her son gobbling up her food.

Ling Jiezhou suddenly realized Tao Ping’s expression, smiled, and said, “I’m thinking, is it better to keep our son in our own clinic? The clinic is earning a lot, and it is so lively and relaxing. When he is around, we can see him whenever we want, but if we don’t, we can just kick him out of the clinic...”
“What kind of nonsense are you talking about? He can only have a brighter future when he stays in the hospital.” Tao Ping pretended to snort.
“Ha...” Ling Jiezhou replied and said, “As long as my wife is happy, who cares about our son’s future...?”
“Stop talking nonsense.” Tao Ping rolled her eyes at her husband, but a smile could be seen on her face.
“I’m done eating.” Ling Ran put down the bowl and stood up.
Ling Jiezhou shouted behind him. “Eat a bit more. Don’t waste it... What do you want to eat for lunch?”
“Anything.” Ling Ran patted his stomach and sat on the reclining chair at the yard.
Ling Jiezhou was stunned when he heard that. “Huh, are you really having lunch at home?”
“Yes.” Ling Ran’s reply was straightforward.
“You’re not going to hospital?”
“I’m resting for today.”
“Did anything happen at the hospital?”
“No.”
“Then, what’s so special about today?”
Ling Ran sighed. “The hospital beds are fully occupied.”

With the number of hospital beds Ling Ran had, it was actually quite difficult for him to fully occupy all of them. That was because the average level of his patient’s prognosis was good. So, even with the long-term hospitalization strategy, a normal patient would not stay long at the hospital. Furthermore, the hospitalization period before the surgery was short too. When Ling Ran’s treatment group was not performing orthopedics surgery, the turnover rate of the hospital ward was near the average value.

However, over the past few days, Ling Ran had given Lu Wenbin special training, and the hospital beds in Ling Ran’s group were fully occupied. Even when they asked for additional beds, it was still not enough for them to work in an endless cycle.

The M-Tang technique performed by Lu Wenbin needed a longer recovery period. If he were in other hospitals, the hospital would ask the patient to rest at home. However, based on Ling Ran’s request for long-term hospitalization, these patients were the people who resulted in insufficient hospital beds.

This was an unavoidable matter. Previously, when the chief surgeon in Ling Ran’s treatment group was Ling Ran, Zhang Anmin and Lu Wenbin could only become the chief surgeon once or twice, and their surgery volume in a week was only about ten.

As Lu Wenbin and Zhang Anmin had become more independent, their chances of becoming the chief surgeon naturally increased, and every week, they had an average of twenty surgeries to be performed. That was the normal level of a doctor in Yun Hua Hospital. Since they were a treatment group, they needed to ensure that each surgeon could reach the quota of surgeries.
The development speed of Ling Ran’s treatment group far surpassed the speed of the number of beds they could increase.
This was the normal situation faced by hospitals and doctors in the country. Even Ling Ran could not keep asking for more hospital beds.
Certainly, if the Emergency Medical Center had their own ICU, the number of hospital beds he had would increase.

Ling Jiezhou was familiar with the situation in the hospital. He was relieved when he heard Ling Ran say that. He then chuckled and said, “Since the hospital beds are fully occupied, you can just restl. I’ll make some crispy roast pork belly, and you can replenish your body.”
“Sure.” Ling Ran was not picky. He took out his phone and opened Kings of Glory.
Ling Jiezhou did not disturb him as well. He changed his clothes and went to the market.

When he was back again, the bag he carried was filled with a huge strip of the fat pork belly. Ling Jiezhou blanched it for a while, cut it, flipped the meat over, and poked the meat using scissors...
Then, Ling Jiezhou seasoned the meat with the prepared sauces and carefully put on a thin layer of baking soda on top of the pork skin.
The crispy layer of the crispy roast pork belly was made using baking soda.

“Today’s pork is really good.” Ling Jiezhou busied himself with lunch preparation, and once he was done, he praised himself after he left the kitchen. When he saw Ling Ran lay lazily playing on his phone, he was annoyed. “Although the hospital beds in your hospital are not enough, you can still perform surgery at home, right? When we rebuilt our clinic, we made our operating theater according to the standard of hospitals. Once we put in the instruments, you can carry out normal surgeries. It’s so wasteful that Doctor Miao only uses it for plastic and reconstructive surgery.”
Ling Ran was stunned when he heard this, and the screen turned dark.
Ling Ran heaved a long sigh, put down his phone, and said, “I’m performing more hepatectomy recently, and the clinic does not have the criteria required for one.”

Ling Jiezhou’s tone with his son was rather casual, “As if you only know how to perform hepatectomy. Just perform the minor surgeries you know at the clinic. I think you should have no problem in that. Just treat it as you getting a few more hospital beds.”
Ling Ran was a bit interested.

The recovery period for orthopedics related surgery was longer. Therefore, many big hospitals were increasingly averse to performing finger replantation surgery. Not only did the doctors have to use lots of stamina for them and their eyes had to suffer for them, but their comparatively long recovery period reduced the utilization rate of hospital beds. Furthermore, finger replantation was less challenging, and it was considered work for blue-collar workers, which resulted in many big hospitals refusing to perform it.

Correspondingly, it was now a trend for small hospitals to start up a Hand Surgery Department. These lower ranked hospitals could also perform surgeries such as Achilles tendon repair, because they did have the instruments required to perform those surgeries.
COMMENT
“If you want to have surgeries in the clinic, your nursing team and anesthetist must be certified too.” Ling Ran looked at his father.
“Just get the nurses and anesthetist from your hospital to come over.” Ling Jiezhou did not think too much into it.
“Seems plausible.” Ling Ran hesitated and said, “If someone is willing to perform surgeries at the clinic, I’ll come over and have a look.”

“I’ll get you a patient for you to try.” Ling Jiezhou did not treat this too formally either. He just found the sight of his son lazing around an eyesore. He did not have a strong desire to expand the clinic.
However, Doctor Miao, who sat at the other side of the yard, felt his heart tremble.

chapters.title: Chapter 954: East Wind
paragraphs: Since Miao Tansheng resigned from the hospital, he only focused on earning a lot of money.

His focus paid off, especially when compared to his peers. Miao Tansheng’s monthly income from cosmetic sutures was already comparable with a group of junior attending physicians.Together with double eyelid operations and injections of hyaluronic acid, Miao Tansheng’s monthly income in Lower Groove Clinic was not worse than an associate chief physician in the tertiary Grade A hospital.
Of course, he rode on the wave of Lower Groove Clinic, so Miao Tansheng treasured his current job very much.

However, people’s mindset would change. As the saying went, “When a person is well-fed and warmed, he will think of something else.” When he had earned enough, Miao Tansheng could not help but start thinking of something else.

Thoughts like improving his skills or performing some high-end surgeries popped up in Miao Tansheng’s mind from time to time, just like how problems would appear on the face from time to time after it receives a hyaluronic acid injection. By then, it would be a reminder to the person that it was time for her to receive another injection.
Unfortunately, for doctors who left big hospitals, while earning money was easy, it was not easy to do things related to skills and surgeries.

The development of modern medicine kept promoting surgery specialization and teamwork. In the past, an appendectomy performed by a township hospital was not different from a big hospital in essence. Some experienced surgeons in county hospitals might even be able to perform the surgery better than newbies in big hospitals.

However, as laparoscopes appeared, the situation became completely different. A bigger gap inevitably appeared between hospitals who could afford and use laparoscopes well and the hospitals who could not afford laparoscopes and were not good at using them, regardless of how good their skills were when it came to performing open appendectomy.
Surgeries requiring higher and complicated skills were naturally not friendly to small hospitals and clinics.
Usually, Miao Tansheng always paid attention to looking for opportunities, but for a doctor who had left the hospital, he would have to be very opportunistic to gain chances.
From Miao Tansheng’s perspective, there was no better chance than Lower Groove Clinic.
If Ling Jiezhou and Ling Ran were willing to expand Lower Groove Clinic, the chance would be even more precious to Miao Tansheng.
“I can get patients.” Miao Tansheng decided to grab this chance, so he answered loudly when the father-son duo were talking.

He was very sure that with how busy a doctor like Ling Ran was, if Miao Tansheng did not seize the chance this time, he could not be sure when would be the next time he could meet Ling Ran. At that time, Ling Ran and Ling Jiezhou’s thoughts might change again.
Miao Tansheng’s interruption made Ling Jiezhou stunned a little.
Ling Jiezhou then smiled. “Old Miao, where are you going to get patients? You don’t go and cut off people’s hands at night, right?”

“My body can’t afford to take up a hacking knife, anyway.” Miao Tansheng gave a random answer before he quickly continued, “Of course, I’m still able to hold a scalpel. I’ll have no problem persisting in normal surgeries for four to five hours.”
“Amazing.” Ling Jiezhou laughed.

“Although I left the hospital, I still have my previous contacts.” Miao Tansheng switched the topic back and said, “If it comes to patients, we all know about the current condition of public general hospitals. Many patients cannot even get a hospital bed. If Doctor Ling is in charge of the clinic, I think getting a few patients will not be difficult.”
Miao Tansheng’s fish eyes twitched to hide his nervousness.

If the clinic decided to perform surgeries, he would naturally become the assistant. Doctor Xiong was too old. It was not a problem for him to be the physician in charge while talking and prescribing medications, but not performing surgeries.

Although the type of surgeries they could carry out was limited and they practically did not have any surgeries to choose from, Miao Tansheng was still very excited when he thought that the chief surgeon was going to be Ling Ran.
At his current position, he was considered super lucky when he had a leader of a treatment group in Yun Hua Hospital guiding him in his surgery.

Ling Jiezhou knew a little about Miao Tansheng’s thoughts, and he hesitated a little. He looked at his son and said, “Young Ran, you’ve been busy in the hospital. Our clinic is running very well now, so you should just do what you can.”
Ling Ran thought and said, “It isn’t a bad thing to get a few more hospital beds. I think the clinic is a suitable place to perform Achilles tendon repairs...”

Achilles tendon repair was one of the most high-end surgeries that Ling Ran mastered. Not only was his Achilles tendon repair technique at Perfect Level, the Zhu-Ling Achilles Repair Technique that Academician Zhu was the main force in developing was also an advanced technique that can be considered a world-class technique. On the other hand, the high amount of anatomical experience he had in the limbs and feet was something that a normal doctor could never get in his lifetime.

Besides, the requirements from Achilles tendon repair requirement toward the operating theater and equipment were not high. The skill requirement for a normal Achilles tendon repair technique and those performed using a small incision was slightly high, but Ling Ran used large incisions, and the conditions required for it could be provided by the operating theater in Lower Groove Clinic.

In addition, the recovery period for Achilles tendon repair was longer, so this was also the reason Ling Ran rarely performed Achilles tendon repair in Yun Hua Hospital, but he always performed it at Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center.

If he performed Achilles tendon repair in Lower Groove Clinic, the corresponding disadvantage was no longer a disadvantage. Based on the current bed utilization rate in the clinic, the longer the patients stayed, the happier Ling Jiezhou would be.
“Are you really able to do so?” Ling Jiezhou asked Ling Ran seriously.
Ling Ran nodded. “The requirements for Achilles tendon repair are not high, and I can also refine my skills in this surgery.”

If he were not performing the Achilles tendon repair technique for athletes, Ling Ran’s Zhu-Ling Achilles Repair Technique was actually not needed. In other words, the Achilles tendon repair technique performed by a normal doctor was enough to satisfy the ordinary needs of ordinary people.
In such a situation, Ling Ran naturally prefered to give the hospital beds away to patients who required hepatectomy.
However, mastering this skill but not using it would still be a waste.
Ling Ran thought that implementing the skill in the clinic was a good choice.

Ling Jiezhou easily relented and said, “If you’re willing to perform it, that’s naturally great. Previously, when Miss Tian helped renovate the clinic, she also helped us apply for quite a number of medical resources, so now they can be used now.”
Ling Jiezhou looked at Miao Tansheng as he said this. He decided to be frank and asked, “Doctor Miao, what do you think? Let’s just get straight to the point, hmm?”

“I want to learn the skills from Doctor Ling...” Miao Tansheng quickly voiced his thoughts. Actually, it was not as if those words were difficult to say. It was very natural for a doctor to want to perform surgeries and do some skillful work.

When Ling Jiezhou heard that Miao Tansheng’s request did not involve any issues of commision or division of profit, he instantly became relieved. He comforted Miao Tansheng. “I understand your desire to learn a skill. Hmm... since it’s rare for Doctor Miao to have such a mentality, let’s not talk about the matter of who is the teacher and student. Doctor Miao, please make arrangements as soon as possible. Let’s just go straight to the surgery first.”
“And nursing care.” Ling Ran reminded him.
“No problem.” Ling Jiezhou patted his chest and answered. He turned around, took out his phone, and sent out messages.
Meanwhile, Miao Tansheng was also excited. He also took out his phone and sent out messages in a frenzy.
As for Ling Ran, he sat on his reclining chair, took out his phone, and started playing his game with familiar motions.

Ling Jiezhou easily relented and said, “If you’re willing to perform it, that’s naturally great.
Previously, when Miss Tian helped renovate the clinic, she also helped us apply for quite a number of medical resources, so now they can be used now.”
Ling Jiezhou looked at Miao Tansheng as he said this.
He decided to be frank and asked, “Doctor Miao, what do you think?
Let’s just get straight to the point, hmm?”
“I want to learn the skills from Doctor Ling...” Miao Tansheng quickly voiced his thoughts.
Actually, it was not as if those words were difficult to say.
It was very natural for a doctor to want to perform surgeries and do some skillful work.
When Ling Jiezhou heard that Miao Tansheng’s request did not involve any issues of commision or division of profit, he instantly became relieved.
He comforted Miao Tansheng.
“I understand your desire to learn a skill.
Hmm... since it’s rare for Doctor Miao to have such a mentality, let’s not talk about the matter of who is the teacher and student.
Doctor Miao, please make arrangements as soon as possible.
Let’s just go straight to the surgery first.”
“And nursing care.” Ling Ran reminded him.
“No problem.” Ling Jiezhou patted his chest and answered.
He turned around, took out his phone, and sent out messages.
Meanwhile, Miao Tansheng was also excited.
He also took out his phone and sent out messages in a frenzy.
As for Ling Ran, he sat on his reclining chair, took out his phone, and started playing his game with familiar motions.

chapters.title: Chapter 955: Everything is ready
paragraphs: “Delicious.” Miao Tansheng put his elbow on the table and used it as an axis so that he can bring the crispy pork belly from the plate into his mouth. He was so happy that his fish eyes twitched, and his rosacea-infected nose seemed to have become redder.
Ling Jiezhou looked calm while he counted, “Six, seven, eight... Eat more if you want.”

“Pork is still more delicious than other meat, especially this pork belly. It’s not only oily, but its aroma is unique...” Miao Tansheng looked like he had not eaten pork for four hours, two days, and a week. He chewed the meat with gusto, and he looked very happy.
“Old Miao, you’ve earned quite a lot. Is all your money used up by your wife?” When Ling Jiezhou counted to twelve, he decided to interrupt Miao Tansheng.

Miao Tansheng sighed, drank a mouthful of water, smiled, and said, “How could it be? My wife is very thrifty. She’s the kind who will not buy shirts only when both sides can be worn, and not the ones where only the outer side can be worn, but not the inner side.”
Ling Jiezhou stared at Miao Tansheng’s chopsticks, nodded, and said, “I can tell.”

“She can’t be compared with you, Chief Ling.” Miao Tansheng picked another piece of pork belly again, then he put his chopsticks together on the table. He chewed the pork belly and said, “If I use modern terms, then Chief Ling, you’re a second generation rich kid. You’re running such a big clinic, and the commissions you receive alone is great enough for you to travel to Tahiti. I’m thinking of whether I can open a clinic when I am at your age.”

Ling Jiezhou’s veins were ready to pop when he heard those words. He had many things to criticize about what Miao Tansheng said, but since there were just too many things to criticize about Miao Tansheng’s words, so much so that there were flaws everywhere in what he said, Ling Jiezhou did not know where to start.
“Doctor Miao, didn’t you say you’ve found a patient? Is the patient coming over by himself or herself or through other means?” Ling Jiezhou decided to change the topic.

Miao Tansheng made phone calls throughout the morning. After contacting a number of people, he finally found a suitable patient. Although there was only one patient, no one could ever start anything without facing difficulties, so Ling Jiezhou did not mind the number. In fact, Ling Jiezhou was still hopeful about the first patient who would come to have his or her Achilles tendon repaired.

Honestly, when the Ling family first started up Lower Groove Clinic, they made it so that they could perform surgeries. Ling Jiezhou’s dad could perform the simple debridements and sutures, appendectomies, and even the more complex orthopedic surgeries, plastering, putting on splints, and other surgeries. Besides, the old man also knew how to administer traditional Chinese medicine. He could perform acupunctures, so when the neighbours had headaches or fevers, he could administer acupuncture and treat them well.

But when the clinic was passed to Ling Jiezhou, the clinic slowly transformed into a transfusion hall and pharmacy. It was not because Ling Jiezhou could not hire a doctor, but because the environment caused the clinic to fall to this state. Even if he could offer a high salary and hire a good doctor, the patients were still from this neighborhood, and it was impossible that they would fall sick and come for treatment all the time.
However, the current Ling Ran had already surpassed what Ling Jiezhou would consider a good doctor.

Forget everything else, Ling Jiezhou knew that the cost for a VIP number for Ling Ran’s consultation would cost 800 RMB, and even the scalpers also sold his consultation numbers from 500 RMB to 600 RMB. Of course, it might be because Ling Ran only consulted patients for half a day every week.
While in the big first-tier cities like Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, doctors like Ling Ran who gave consultations in private clinics or private hospitals were a common sight.

For patients who did not have medical insurance or did not care to apply for reimbursement, they went to private clinics or private hospitals for consultation, paid a price which was much higher than the consultation fees in public hospitals, and were guaranteed a chance to see the doctor of their choice. They could even receive a slightly better service than in public hospitals.
The Ling family had their own clinic, so developing a second battlefield for Ling Ran was also something they could try once Ling Jiezhou considered things from his perspective.
Miao Tansheng was actually envious of this too.

Even if the clinic looked like a pharmacy, it was still a clinic. Besides, the Ling family’s clinic had a complete set of licenses, had a long history, and a good foundation. If the clinic were passed to him, Miao Tansheng would launch breast augmentation surgeries without any hesitation...

“I was exhausted just to get this patient,” Miao Tansheng answered Ling Jiezhou’s question. He first complained, before he smiled and said, “But it’ll be convenient in the future. I’ve discussed it with them. If they meet any suitable patients, they will send them over to us. I can’t say it’ll be a continuous supply, but there’s going to be quite a number of patients.”

“That’s great. We don’t need a continuous supply, because our clinic has only fewer than twenty hospital beds, so we can’t also accommodate a high number of patients.” What Ling Jiezhou referred to was the hospital beds that could accommodate the patients staying over. The hospital beds used for fluid transfusion at the lower floor were naturally excluded.
Miao Tansheng chuckled and nodded. Then, he said, “After we complete this surgery, I will report to every hospital. Then, we will basically have sealed the deal. But... munch, munch...”
Miao Tansheng was halfway through his words before he picked up another crispy pork belly and chewed it.
‘Fifteen.’ Ling Jiezhou silently counted. Then, he went along the flow of the conversation and asked, “But?”

“Among the people I contacted, some are classmates and friends, whereas some are my former colleagues and social contacts. I’m thinking if we should give them some rewards? You know, to increase their motivation.” Miao Tansheng’s fish eyes twitched. After leaving the hospital and entering the clinic, Miao Tansheng had his own understanding about the way of life on both sides, so he also knew how to communicate well.
Ling Jiezhou did not think too much into it. He nodded and said, “Then, we’ll just give them the same rewards as we do to Golden Deer Health Services Pte Ltd.”

“Sure.” Miao Tansheng did not prepare to ask for a lot either. If he really offered a stimulating price, it would be bad if these parties sent such a high number of patients over that they could take all of them.
Once they were done talking, Miao Tansheng also sighed in relief. He then looked at Ling Ran and said, “Doctor Ling, can I be your assistant in the coming surgeries?”

“Sure.” Ling Ran agreed. For him, all his assistants needed to do was to have hands. For skilled assistants, he would give them more tasks while he focused on the core part of the surgery in order to reduce the patient’s risk, but when he encountered assistants with bad skills like Yu Yuan, as long as her attitude was serious, Ling Ran could also afford to take up the majority of the operation while giving her tasks that she could handle.

Ling Ran had been using this reverse spoon-feeding technique over the past two years. In fact, as celebrity doctors gained more experience, they would more or less master some reverse spoon-feeding techniques, otherwise, having a continuous stream of doctors on-training, interns and visiting doctors coming over was not a good thing.

Miao Tansheng felt relieved. He thanked Ling Ran again and helped increase Ling Ran’s confidence in him by saying, “My surgical technique back in the day was quite good, and I’ve been performing minor surgeries often lately, so I will not drop the ball.”
Ling Ran glanced at Miao Tansheng and said, “It’s fine even if you make mistakes.”
The passionate Miao Tansheng’s excitement was instantly stuck in his body, and he did not know what to say.
He knew that Ling Ran had just said those words with absolutely good intentions.
However, when he thought that he would be Ling Ran’s assistant, Miao Tansheng could not help but be perturbed.
“Oh yes, about what time will the nurse and anesthetist arrive?” Miao Tansheng forcefully changed the topic.
“Two in the afternoon.” Ling Ran was still very attentive when it came to surgeries.
Miao Tansheng became excited again. He said, “So, everything is ready now. The nurse and anesthetist from Yun Hua Hospital are very busy, right? Was it easy for you to get them to help?”
Ling Ran answered, “Yes. When I don’t perform surgery, they are free.”

With Ling Ran’s surgical volume, the nurses and anesthetists allocated to him were basically overworked. Therefore, when Ling Ran was free, the nurses in the Emergency Medical Center and the allocated anesthetists had their workload reduced, and they naturally had free time.
Miao Tansheng nodded, but he heard Ling Jiezhou saying, “Let Juan Zi perform the surgery. I’ll hire another two nurses later.”

Ling Jiezhou was still not willing to hire more people, but he would earn more when they began performing surgeries. When he thought about this, he did not find it a waste that Miao Tansheng had eaten thirteen big pieces and twelve small pieces of crispy pork belly.
Miao Tansheng thought for awhile and asked, “Has Juan Zi worked as a scrub nurse before?”
Ling Jiezhou answered, “She can be considered to have approached the field before. But the young girl is willing to learn, so she can pick it up after learning a few times.”
Miao Tansheng forced himself to smile. “Young girl, huh...?”

chapters.title: Chapter 956: Don’t Overthink
paragraphs: The lights of the ambulance of Golden Deer Health Services Pte Ltd blinked as it was driven slowly into Lower Groove Clinic.
There was no need for the ambulance to use its siren. Miao Tansheng immediately came forward and asked the patient to come down from the back.

The patient today was a girl about twelve or thirteen years old. She had long hair and had a smile that brought out the best in her cute feminine features. She attempted to take a selfie as she sat in a wheelchair.
“Fei’er, stop playing your phone.” The parents who followed along looked anxious, and the mother actually sounded rather serious.
The girl pursed her lips and said with a lisp, “Whad can I do if I don’ play wid my fone? Keeb shouting in pain an’ cry?”

“At the very least, don’t be in such a hurry to take a selfie. Isn’t this lesson enough? Because of this selfie business, you broke your leg. Seriously, you... I’m telling you now, your Achilles tendon is ruptured. Even if it’s repaired, it won’t be as good as it was before, and we can’t tell whether you can dance again.”
“It’ll be good if I can’d danse.” The thirteen-year-old girl’s voice seemed to be low, but came out much louder than intended.

The mother felt her blood pressure spike at that moment. Her face became as red as a cooked mantis shrimp, and she was ready to extend her hand and slap the girl lightly. She scolded her, “What are you saying now? Did you actually think it’s easy for me to send you to dance class three to four times a week?”
The girl pursed her lips and quickly shouted, “Ow, my leg hurds.”
“Hurry up and send the patient inside.” Miao Tansheng was immediately anxious when he heard this.

“Old Miao.” The father watched his wife and daughter enter the clinic and called out to Miao Tansheng before he looked around before he whispered, “Old Miao, we’re straightforward people, so let’s not beat around the bush. Are you sure Doctor Ling from Yun Hua Hospital is the one performing this surgery?”
The patient’s father was the same age as Miao Tansheng, and he was also a doctor.

“Of course, how can I lie about that?” Miao Tansheng straightened himself up to full height. When he saw the father’s worried face, he said gently, “This clinic belongs to Doctor Ling’s family. Doctor Ling is inside the clinic now, and he will meet you later. You have seen Doctor Ling before, right?”
“Yes, I’ve seen him before.” Old Hong sighed lightly in relief.

“It’s good that you’ve seen him before. With how he looks, it’s impossible for me to search for a body double or imposter, right?” Miao Tansheng was joking, at the same time, he was reducing the stress of the parents.
He had been working in the clinic over the past few years. While his skill level did not improve by much, his capability of comforting patients and their families had improved a lot.
Old Hong pursed his lips, but he still did not laugh. He looked slightly relieved. He relaxed a little and said slowly. “If you hire an actor who looks like Doctor Ling, you will go bankrupt.”
“Haha... that’s true.” Miao Tansheng’s fish eyes twitched a little, and he suddenly felt hurt.

“There’s no problem with the equipment and facilities, right? You once said that this clinic has not performed any surgery before, right?” Old Hong raised his head and looked around again. After Lower Groove Clinic was renovated, it definitely looked good. In fact, it could even be considered beautiful, despite its size.
However, aesthetics did not mean successful surgeries, so Old Hong still had many concerns.

A new operating theater and a clinic that was just only introducing its surgery programme deducted a lot of marks in terms of reliability. If not for Miao Tansheng mentioning Ling Ran, Old Hong would never bring his daughter here for treatment.
However, from another perspective, if Ling Ran was really the chief surgeon, the clinic could be in shambles for all Old Hong cared.

Miao Tansheng knew Old Hong’s thoughts, so he simply tried his best to comfort him, “The operating theater in the clinic and equipment have been checked many times, and the anesthetist also works for Doctor Ling. You also know that Doctor Ling rarely performs Achilles tendon repair technique nowadays, right? Coincidentally, the clinic intends to launch their own surgery programme, so there are a few slots...”
“Hmm,” Old Hong answered before he sighed, “Doctor Ling performs Achilles tendon repair technique so well, but he’s not doing it anymore.”
“That’s because Doctor Ling’s hepatectomy is also ranked top in the country.” Miao Tansheng shrugged.
“He is really good, sigh...” Old Hong sighed heavily again.

He was the same age as Miao Tansheng, and they both were considered colleagues. However, even if they both were doctors, it would be rather difficult for the patient’s father to invite Ling Ran to perform Achilles tendon repair when he did not know Ling Ran personally.

Ling Ran only offered consultations for half a day every week, and the Emergency Medical Center did not allow the patient to choose their doctor. Therefore, unless Old Hong was willing to wait for three to four days, he generally did not have any way to invite Ling Ran for surgery.

Naturally, Old Hong did not have Ling Ran as the only choice. According to his original plan, he wanted to send his daughter to Shanghai for treatment. Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center was the top orthopedic hospital in the country, so an Achilles tendon repair was not a problem to them.

However, it was precisely because he knew what was the advantage of Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center over other hospitals that Old Hong understood just how proficient Ling Ran was in Achilles tendon repair.
Therefore, when his friend made a call and mentioned Ling Ran, Old Hong immediately changed his plan.
With Ling Ran serving as the chief surgeon for his daughter’s Achilles tendon repair, why should they go to Shanghai?
It was only when his daughter was about to receive surgery that Old Hong became worried about his daughter, so he kept asking questions.

“I’ll bring you to Doctor Ling.” Miao Tansheng had been working for the clinic in many things, so he knew how to handle the patient’s father, and this was also the first surgery for the clinic, so he was in particularly high spirits.
Old Hong immediately nodded, and he followed Miao Tansheng inside.
The operating theater of the clinic was designed to be at the middle of the west wing. When the patient and her family entered, they entered a small, open waiting room.

At that moment, Ling Ran was sitting on the couch placed in the center of the waiting room. Both his long legs were stretched far apart from each other, and he gave off an incredibly magnificent and imposing presence.
It was Old Hong’s first time meeting Ling Ran face-to-face. He felt a pressure slam upon his shoulders before it was quickly removed.
When he saw a doctor who was skilled, capable, and had such a strong, imposing presence, as a doctor, Old Hong naturally felt intimidated. But as the patient’s family, he felt really relieved.

“Doctor Ling, I heard your speech during a seminar, and it left a deep impression on me. I could not forget it even after a long time...” Old Hong took a few steps forward quickly, and he surpassed Miao Tansheng in the blink of an eye.
Miao Tansheng had been thinking about how to break the ice and how to save the situation if Ling Ran spoke too straightforwardly, but now, he did not know whether he wanted to cry or laugh.

He stared at Old Hong, who looked like a fan. Although he knew that Old Hong was putting up an act for Ling Ran, he still felt uncomfortable. Even if he wanted to act, why would he act like he was not satisfied at all in front of him, instead of acting like a fan in front of Ling Ran?
Once a person started thinking a lot, it was impossible for his mood to improve.
“Doctor Miao, are you okay?” Su Mengxue, who came from Yun Hua Hospital, saw that Miao Tansheng was in a daze, and she kindly called out to him.
“Oh... It’s Nurse Su. Thank you for today, too.” When Miao Tansheng saw the pretty Su Mengxue and her big chest, he subconsciously had his intellect as a city man awakened.
Su Mengxue smiled sweetly and said, “It’s not hard for us. It’s just a surgery, and we receive a lot of allowance. But... are you jealous of Doctor Ling, Doctor Miao?”
“You should say that I am envious, jealous, and full of hate.” Miao Tansheng pretended to be calm and smiled.
Su Mengxue nodded lightly and smiled. “Actually, there is nothing to compare. Doctor Ling is just young, good-looking, skilled, has good surgical senses, is hardworking, and has a bright future...”
“But?” Miao Tansheng tried to follow up with the conversation.
Su Mengxue laughed. “No buts. Anyway, you just need to do your part well. Don’t overthink things. Bye...”
Miao Tansheng really wanted to flip the bird right then.

He had been working in the clinic over the past few years.
While his skill level did not improve by much, his capability of comforting patients and their families had improved a lot.
Old Hong pursed his lips, but he still did not laugh.
He looked slightly relieved.
He relaxed a little and said slowly.
“If you hire an actor who looks like Doctor Ling, you will go bankrupt.”
“Haha... that’s true.” Miao Tansheng’s fish eyes twitched a little, and he suddenly felt hurt.
“There’s no problem with the equipment and facilities, right?
You once said that this clinic has not performed any surgery before, right?” Old Hong raised his head and looked around again.
After Lower Groove Clinic was renovated, it definitely looked good.
In fact, it could even be considered beautiful, despite its size.
However, aesthetics did not mean successful surgeries, so Old Hong still had many concerns.
A new operating theater and a clinic that was just only introducing its surgery programme deducted a lot of marks in terms of reliability.
If not for Miao Tansheng mentioning Ling Ran, Old Hong would never bring his daughter here for treatment.
However, from another perspective, if Ling Ran was really the chief surgeon, the clinic could be in shambles for all Old Hong cared.

Miao Tansheng knew Old Hong’s thoughts, so he simply tried his best to comfort him, “The operating theater in the clinic and equipment have been checked many times, and the anesthetist also works for Doctor Ling.
You also know that Doctor Ling rarely performs Achilles tendon repair technique nowadays, right?
Coincidentally, the clinic intends to launch their own surgery programme, so there are a few slots...”
“Hmm,” Old Hong answered before he sighed, “Doctor Ling performs Achilles tendon repair technique so well, but he’s not doing it anymore.”
“That’s because Doctor Ling’s hepatectomy is also ranked top in the country.” Miao Tansheng shrugged.
“He is really good, sigh...” Old Hong sighed heavily again.
He was the same age as Miao Tansheng, and they both were considered colleagues.
However, even if they both were doctors, it would be rather difficult for the patient’s father to invite Ling Ran to perform Achilles tendon repair when he did not know Ling Ran personally.
Ling Ran only offered consultations for half a day every week, and the Emergency Medical Center did not allow the patient to choose their doctor.
Therefore, unless Old Hong was willing to wait for three to four days, he generally did not have any way to invite Ling Ran for surgery.
Naturally, Old Hong did not have Ling Ran as the only choice.
According to his original plan, he wanted to send his daughter to Shanghai for treatment.
Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center was the top orthopedic hospital in the country, so an Achilles tendon repair was not a problem to them.

However, it was precisely because he knew what was the advantage of Orthopedic and Sports Medicine Center over other hospitals that Old Hong understood just how proficient Ling Ran was in Achilles tendon repair.
Therefore, when his friend made a call and mentioned Ling Ran, Old Hong immediately changed his plan.
With Ling Ran serving as the chief surgeon for his daughter’s Achilles tendon repair, why should they go to Shanghai?
It was only when his daughter was about to receive surgery that Old Hong became worried about his daughter, so he kept asking questions.

“I’ll bring you to Doctor Ling.” Miao Tansheng had been working for the clinic in many things, so he knew how to handle the patient’s father, and this was also the first surgery for the clinic, so he was in particularly high spirits.
Old Hong immediately nodded, and he followed Miao Tansheng inside.
The operating theater of the clinic was designed to be at the middle of the west wing.
When the patient and her family entered, they entered a small, open waiting room.
At that moment, Ling Ran was sitting on the couch placed in the center of the waiting room.
Both his long legs were stretched far apart from each other, and he gave off an incredibly magnificent and imposing presence.
It was Old Hong’s first time meeting Ling Ran face-to-face.
He felt a pressure slam upon his shoulders before it was quickly removed.
When he saw a doctor who was skilled, capable, and had such a strong, imposing presence, as a doctor, Old Hong naturally felt intimidated.
But as the patient’s family, he felt really relieved.
“Doctor Ling, I heard your speech during a seminar, and it left a deep impression on me.
I could not forget it even after a long time...” Old Hong took a few steps forward quickly, and he surpassed Miao Tansheng in the blink of an eye.
Miao Tansheng had been thinking about how to break the ice and how to save the situation if Ling Ran spoke too straightforwardly, but now, he did not know whether he wanted to cry or laugh.
He stared at Old Hong, who looked like a fan.
Although he knew that Old Hong was putting up an act for Ling Ran, he still felt uncomfortable.
Even if he wanted to act, why would he act like he was not satisfied at all in front of him, instead of acting like a fan in front of Ling Ran?
Once a person started thinking a lot, it was impossible for his mood to improve.
“Doctor Miao, are you okay?” Su Mengxue, who came from Yun Hua Hospital, saw that Miao Tansheng was in a daze, and she kindly called out to him.
It’s Nurse Su.
Thank you for today, too.” When Miao Tansheng saw the pretty Su Mengxue and her big chest, he subconsciously had his intellect as a city man awakened.
Su Mengxue smiled sweetly and said, “It’s not hard for us.
It’s just a surgery, and we receive a lot of allowance.
But... are you jealous of Doctor Ling, Doctor Miao?”
“You should say that I am envious, jealous, and full of hate.” Miao Tansheng pretended to be calm and smiled.
Su Mengxue nodded lightly and smiled.
“Actually, there is nothing to compare.
Doctor Ling is just young, good-looking, skilled, has good surgical senses, is hardworking, and has a bright future...”
“But?” Miao Tansheng tried to follow up with the conversation.
Su Mengxue laughed.
“No buts.
Anyway, you just need to do your part well.
Don’t overthink things.
Bye...”
Miao Tansheng really wanted to flip the bird right then.

chapters.title: Chapter 957: Atmosphere That He Likes
paragraphs: “Miss Hong, let me put your phone away for you,” the circulating nurse who was performing preoperative preparation spoke politely to Hong Fei. She spoke in the same way she did after receiving specific training to speak to the patients in the VIP patient building.
Hong Fei pouted and said, “Aren’ I jus’ suturing my legs? I’m lyin’ on my stomach while playin’ on my phone, so you can jus’ suture my legs.”
“That won’t work.”
“Why not?” Hong Fei pursed her lips, lifted her phone, and blinked. “Right, can I do a livestream? Livestreaming my surgery should be allowed, right?”

“That’s not allowed.” Su Mengxue came in at this moment, took out her phone, called someone, and said, “Doctor Su, can you please hurry up? If the patient jumps out of bed and runs, we’ll have to find a rope for her.”
Hong Fei’s eyes widened. “Are you guys planning to issue general anesthesia? Isn’ regional anesthesia sufficient?”

“The Zhu-Ling Achilles Repair Technique used by Doctor Ling is rather long, and the average patient can’t wait that long. Plus, you will be given a very weak anesthetic, which is almost the same as a hypnotic drug.” Su Mengxue changed her expression at this moment. She started explaining with a smile on her face.
Hong Fei was subconsciously won over by Su Mengxue’s smile. Then, she looked down. Hong Fei felt that she gained even greater knowledge when she did, and she looked at her chest subconsciously.
“How about this? If you help me film a short video, I’ll give my phone to you.” Hong Fei looked at Su Mengxue as if she was looking at the number of her fans rising in the future.

What was the difference between herself and those who had a lot of subscribers while they livestreamed? Was not the difference between them just big breasts? Although Hong Fei was young, she already had her own ideas and way of doing things.
Su Mengxue was stunned, but laughed as she was entertained by Hong Fei. She just shook her head. “I don’t know how to record any videos.”
“You’re not the one recording it, I am. You just need to follow my cues.”
“I wouldn’t know how to do that too.” Su Mengxue did not want to be involved in a video with a teen.
“Then let’s record the video togeder.” Hong Fei worked hard to fight for benefits.
*Swish*
Su Jiafu opened the door to the operating theater.
“You guys sure act fast.” Su Jiafu’s very first act was to start complaining right when he came in so that he would not end up with the young nurses complaining about him.

“Miss Hong, this is the anesthetist. Doctor Su often cooperates with Doctor Ling for surgery. His technique is very good. You don’t have to worry too much.” Su Mengxue was rather patient with young girls.
Hong Fei was, however, not a patient child. When she saw the situation, she shook her head vigorously. “No, if you don’ record a video for me, then I won’ have the surgery.”
“Doesn’t your foot hurt?” Su Jiafu sat on a chair and quietly operated the computer.

Hong Fei was stunned. She acted as if she did not hear him and gritted her teeth before she said, “Miss Nurse, help me take two videos, okay? Take one with me, and the other one will be the one where I record you working.”
Su Mengxue smiled and refused.
Her appearance was her gift, and rejecting others was part and parcel of her gift.

No matter what, Hong Fei was a young girl. Once she said this, it was a little hard for her to go on demanding that Su Mengxue record a video with her. She laid on the operating table, and tears started pooling in her eyes without her knowledge.

She was a pretty young girl and a patient to boot. When she suddenly burst into tears, Anesthetist Su Jiafu instantly became nervous, even though he had nothing to do with the situation. He said quickly, “Come on, isn’t it just a video? I’ll record it with you, alright?”
The young girl glanced at Su Jiafu and cried even more.
Just then, a nice male voice traveled into her ears,
“What happened?”

Hong Fei quietly made a gap between her fingers and saw a doctor in a white coat walking into the operating theater under the bright shadowless lamp in the operating theater. His appearance, figure, voice, and the way he walked were all exactly like the Prince Charming in her heart.
Hong Fei hurriedly wiped her face and tried to make herself look more beautiful before she let Prince Charming look at her.
At this time, she heard Prince Charming speak again, “Anesthetize her.”

Hong Fei’s tiny brain was still pondering over the deep meaning in Prince Charming’s words when she felt her head gradually getting drowsy. It was as if she had too much oxygen and was about to fall unconscious.
Then, she fell asleep.
The operating theater returned to silence. It was the atmosphere that Ling Ran liked best.
“Didn’t you take an MRI?” Ling Ran put his hands together and began to look at various scans around the wall.

“The patient’s family considered sending the patient to Shanghai, so they didn’t do a lot of examinations.” It was Ma Yanlin who spoke. His main focus was Achilles tendon repair, so whenever there was a chance for him to perform a related operation, he proactively came over to take part in the surgery.

After all, the standards for performing hepatectomy were too high, and ordinary doctors who had not accumulated at least a decade of experience would not dare to touch the field. Ma Yanlin was only able to become Ling Ran’s assistant because Ling Ran was simply too good; his assistants only needed to occasionally take action during the surgery. For more complicated surgeries, Ling Ran would also mainly use Zhang Anmin and Lu Wenbin.

Compared to Ma Yanlin, who had only been promoted to a resident doctor, Lu Wenbin was a senior resident doctor with three to four years of experience, along with his time as a houseman, and he also had six to seven years of surgical experience. This experience may not usually show itself prominently, but it would be reflected in the end when he handled the details in a surgery.

If Ma Yanlin wanted to improve, he would have to perform more surgeries to catch up to Zhang Anmin and Lu Wenbin. It was the same for all the young doctors in the hospital. No one wanted to work from nine in the morning to nine at night for six days a week, but they did not want to be left behind by the others even more.
“If any patient comes here with the thought of going through Achilles tendon repair in the future, try to get them to go through an MRI scan,” Ling Ran said to Miao Tansheng, who stood across him.
“Okay. I wasn’t quite familiar with the situation before,” Miao Tansheng quickly explained.

Ling Ran nodded. Ma Yanlin explained beside him, “Doctor Ling can make a lot of judgments through MRI scans. Now, when it comes to reading MRI scans, Ling Ran is one of the best in Yun Hua Hospital. However, we are in no condition of getting MRI scans during emergency surgeries. During those times, using X-ray scans and CT scans are also okay.”
Miao Tansheng nodded repeatedly and said obediently, “I’m not familiar with Doctor Ling’s habits. In the future, I’ll need to ask you to be more lenient with me in the future, Doctor Ma...”
“Just ask me whatever you want,” Ma Yanlin answered with a grin.
Miao Tansheng thanked him again.

After going through so much work, in the end, he only managed to secure himself the position of the second assistant, but he was not dissatisfied. He had never cooperated with Ling Ran before, and it was very important for him to be the second assistant to familiarize himself with the situation. Furthermore, Miao Tansheng himself had not had such a “major operation” in a long time. He also needed to be familiar with the environment.

Miao Tansheng turned his head intentionally to observe the instruments. There were a stainless steel needle retractor, a one-prong retractor, a lamina retractor, a bone spreader, a bone chisel, a osteotome, a bone elevator, a bone curette, a small bone rongeur, a small bone scissor...
The familiar yet unfamiliar equipment made Miao Tansheng involuntarily take a deep breath.
There was always an inexplicable air of excitement in a clean operating theater.

“Let’s start the operation.” Ling Ran looked up and glanced at Miao Tansheng. It was naturally a good sign if the doctors working with him had the urge to perform surgery, because it meant that they could withstand a lot of surgical pressure.
Probably.
