chapters.title: Chapter 958: Jealousy
paragraphs: “Today, we’ll make a small medial incision.” As Ling Ran listened to the conversation between Miao Tansheng and the patient’s family, he had already determined the basic surgery plan.

The patient was not an athlete and had no need to go through any high-intensity exercises. Furthermore, she was also young. She was at the age where she still wanted to be beautiful. Using an Achilles tendon repair that would leave a large incision may not necessarily meet the patient’s interests, even if they managed to give her a perfect Achilles tendon repair.
Therefore, as Ling Ran was deciding the surgery plan, he was already prepared to conduct the surgery with a small incision.
However, the goal of the surgery was mainly about the strength of the Achilles tendon, and Ling Ran was not prepared to make too many compromises about it.
Compared to the time when he first began performing the Achilles tendon repair technique, Ling Ran was now more skilled. Hence, there was more room for flexibility in the operation.
Ma Yanlin had performed hundreds of Achilles tendon repairs with Ling Ran. When he heard Ling Ran’s orders, his mind was alert, and he came to attention.

Miao Tansheng was naturally completely clueless. He just watched Ling Ran cut through all layers of the skin and stripped the subcutaneous layer of the skin. During that time, he was still thinking about how to make himself look more experienced in operating the retractor...
“Doctor Miao, come and clear up the blood clots.” Ling Ran was suturing without looking up while Ma Yanlin was threading the needle.
Miao Tansheng froze for a moment and was suddenly a little excited. “Okay, I’ll clear up the blood clots.”
Clearing a blood clot was a trivial task, but after being away from the operating table for so long, Miao Tansheng was now as excited as a fresh graduate intern.
“Don’t touch the blood vessels.” Ling Ran reminded him before he went back to suturing the blood vessels.

The core of the Zhu-Ling Achilles Repair Technique was to ensure blood circulation, and the way to ensure blood circulation was to repair as many blood vessels as possible. In a way, he was performing the Achilles repair technique the same way as he would a finger replantation surgery.

If any other surgeon were to perform this surgical method, they would feel that it was a tremendous workload. Only a doctor like Ling Ran who liked the operating theater and did not care about money would not mind it.

Of course, he did not do it often. As a doctor, he always hoped that his technique could be used in a more suitable place. Compared to Achilles tendon repairs, the effect of his skills on hepatectomy was obviously greater.
Miao Tansheng, however, did not care about how useful his skills were to the surgery. He was just one-hundred percent invested in the operation.
But Miao Tansheng quickly realized that Ling Ran’s request required far more than his entire focus.

Clearing a blood clot was easy. Ling Ran’s request of not touching the blood vessels would usually just make any other surgery just a tiny bit more difficult, but it was not so easy for this surgery, because the incision was small.
In addition, Ling Ran’s speed also stimulated Miao Tansheng to work harder.

He knew that he did not need to compare with Ling Ran, but Miao Tansheng also knew that if his operation speed was too slow, Ling Ran’s speed would probably be dragged down, which would affect the progress of the entire operation.
Many surgeons were reluctant to bring new people for surgeries because not only did they have to worry about these new people making mistakes, their speed was also an important consideration.
In the hospital, the speed of a surgery group was directly linked to factors such as performance bonuses. Whenever it was possible, no one would be willing to lug a burden around.

Miao Tansheng did not want to become Ling Ran’s burden, because if he did become a burden, Ling Ran would probably reduce the number of operations in the clinic. After all, he was no longer in school or a hospital, and Ling Ran had no obligation to teach him...
Miao Tansheng stole a glance at Ling Ran before he lowered his head. Once he composed himself, he worked hard to clear up the blood clots.
His foundation was still there. As he focused all his attention into the surgery with all his strength, he finally finished the tasks assigned by Ling Ran. But he was also exhausted.

Ling Ran nodded in satisfaction. Just as expected, Miao Tansheng was a middle-aged man who was able to bear the pressure. Even after transferring seventy to eight percent of Ma Yanlin’s workload to him, Miao Tansheng still managed to carry his weight, and it was not an easy feat.
No matter what, Ma Yanlin had been a doctor who had been performing the Achilles tendon repair technique for two years, and Miao Tansheng had left large hospitals for quite some time.
But Ling Ran only thought about this before he continued with the surgery. He did not increase Miao Tansheng’s workload any further.

As Miao Tansheng was nearing the last stage in his task of clearing the blood clots, he showed clear symptoms of low stamina. Not only did he perform slower, his error rate also increased. He did not manage to clean up the blood clots cleanly either...
All in all, according to Ling Ran’s judgment, he was about to no longer be able to use Miao Tansheng.
“Tendon suture thread.” Ling Ran was suturing the main part at this moment, and he no longer paid attention to Miao Tansheng.
Juan Zi, who was learning to be a scrub nurse, gently put a tendon suture thread into Ling Ran’s hand.
Ling Ran’s hand sank slightly. He cast a glance at her before he continued with the surgery.
Juan Zi released a long breath weighing 11 pounds at that moment.

However, Miao Tansheng quickly relaxed and regained his identity as a person who operated the retractor. His mind operated like a spinning table lamp as he recalled countless details in the hospital: the first time he met a beautiful female doctor in the hospital, the first time he met a beautiful female nurse during an operation, the first time he met a beautiful female family member during his first ward round, the first time he went to the mortuary...
“Today’s operation proceeded quite smoothly, right?” As the pressure on Miao Tansheng lessened, he attempted to be friendly, though no one knew whether it was done intentionally or unintentionally.

Ma Yanlin was familiar with Ling Ran’s habits and naturally bore the heavy responsibility of chatting. In truth, he had also relaxed, and now, he wanted to chat. “According to Doctor Ling’s usual progress, today’s surgery is conducted at just about average speed. His speed might have been affected a little because we switched locations.”

“That’s only par for the course. Sigh, there are not many surgeons now like Doctor Ling, who would be willing to spend two to three hours performing such a minor surgery.” Miao Tansheng praised Ling Ran indirectly.
Ma Yanlin agreed, and he was feeling sentimental when he said, “Who wouldn’t say so? Most people would not perform an Achilles tendon repair like this.”

Miao Tansheng smiled and said, “When you look at it from another perspective, we’re also competing in a different manner. I also contacted other hospitals and doctors, and we will be receiving more patients later on. According to previous estimates, we should have more than three patients every week.”

The conversation he had with Old Hong today also strengthened Miao Tansheng’s confidence. He believed that as long as there were suitable patients, the opportunity he would get here was still relatively large.

“That’s good. If there are only three operations a week, you can utilize the beds here effectively.” Ma Yanlin could not help but be positive. His main purpose was to learn the technique. Now, Yun Hua Hospital performed an average of three or four Achilles tendon repairs a week, and they were mainly aimed at foreign patients and athletes. If he could have an additional three surgeries at Lower Groove Clinic every week, he will be able to learn faster.

Miao Tansheng was a little proud at this moment. He chuckled and said cheerfully, “Three operations is the lowest possible number I can promise you. We’re just beginning, so let’s keep a lower profile. I’ll look for my old friends. Of course, it’s mainly because of Doctor Ling’s reputation. When they heard that Doctor Ling’s the chief surgeon, they were willing to send patients over. ”

Ma Yanlin listened as he nodded and praised Doctor Miao’s extensive network, which made Miao Tansheng, who had not been flattered for a long time, to laugh. The operating theater’s atmosphere was suddenly extremely harmonious.
Soon after, Ling Ran finished suturing the Achilles tendon. He then gave the rest of his work to Ma Yanlin and went out to take a bath.
The benefits of performing surgery in his own clinic were vividly manifested at this time. Ling Ran really changed his clothes this time.
Ling Ran left the operating theater. Miao Tansheng and Ma Yanlin were also full of joy as they complimented each other.
When all the surgeries were completed, they left the operating theater, and they saw another ambulance from Golden Deer Health Services Pte Ltd stopping in the yard.
“Why did the ambulance stop here?” Miao Tan frowned.
“The back is full.” The driver also knew Miao Tansheng, so he could only purse his lips in resignation.
“Full with what? There are other ambulances?”

“They are all sending patients over.” Juan Zi was also in a good mood today. After running around with her fifty-two pound left leg and fifty-four pound right leg, she explained to Miao Tansheng, “Changxi Medical Company collected a patient with an Achilles tendon rupture from somewhere and sent him over. Bazhaixiang hospital branch also found a patient with an Achilles tendon rupture. The patients from both sides arrived at the same time, and now, one of them has to wait for the other to finish his surgery before he can receive his own surgery...”
“These lap dogs...” Miao Tansheng could feel the jealousy in his stomach gushing out.

sentences.text: “Today, we’ll make a small medial incision.” As Ling Ran listened to the conversation between Miao Tansheng and the patient’s family, he had already determined the basic surgery plan.
The patient was not an athlete and had no need to go through any high-intensity exercises.
Furthermore, she was also young.
She was at the age where she still wanted to be beautiful.
Using an Achilles tendon repair that would leave a large incision may not necessarily meet the patient’s interests, even if they managed to give her a perfect Achilles tendon repair.
Therefore, as Ling Ran was deciding the surgery plan, he was already prepared to conduct the surgery with a small incision.
However, the goal of the surgery was mainly about the strength of the Achilles tendon, and Ling Ran was not prepared to make too many compromises about it.
Compared to the time when he first began performing the Achilles tendon repair technique, Ling Ran was now more skilled.
Hence, there was more room for flexibility in the operation.
Ma Yanlin had performed hundreds of Achilles tendon repairs with Ling Ran.
When he heard Ling Ran’s orders, his mind was alert, and he came to attention.
Miao Tansheng was naturally completely clueless.
He just watched Ling Ran cut through all layers of the skin and stripped the subcutaneous layer of the skin.
During that time, he was still thinking about how to make himself look more experienced in operating the retractor...
“Doctor Miao, come and clear up the blood clots.” Ling Ran was suturing without looking up while Ma Yanlin was threading the needle.
Miao Tansheng froze for a moment and was suddenly a little excited.
“Okay, I’ll clear up the blood clots.”
Clearing a blood clot was a trivial task, but after being away from the operating table for so long, Miao Tansheng was now as excited as a fresh graduate intern.
“Don’t touch the blood vessels.” Ling Ran reminded him before he went back to suturing the blood vessels.
The core of the Zhu-Ling Achilles Repair Technique was to ensure blood circulation, and the way to ensure blood circulation was to repair as many blood vessels as possible.
In a way, he was performing the Achilles repair technique the same way as he would a finger replantation surgery.
If any other surgeon were to perform this surgical method, they would feel that it was a tremendous workload.
Only a doctor like Ling Ran who liked the operating theater and did not care about money would not mind it.
Of course, he did not do it often.
As a doctor, he always hoped that his technique could be used in a more suitable place.
Compared to Achilles tendon repairs, the effect of his skills on hepatectomy was obviously greater.
Miao Tansheng, however, did not care about how useful his skills were to the surgery.
He was just one-hundred percent invested in the operation.
But Miao Tansheng quickly realized that Ling Ran’s request required far more than his entire focus.
Clearing a blood clot was easy.
Ling Ran’s request of not touching the blood vessels would usually just make any other surgery just a tiny bit more difficult, but it was not so easy for this surgery, because the incision was small.
In addition, Ling Ran’s speed also stimulated Miao Tansheng to work harder.

He knew that he did not need to compare with Ling Ran, but Miao Tansheng also knew that if his operation speed was too slow, Ling Ran’s speed would probably be dragged down, which would affect the progress of the entire operation.
Many surgeons were reluctant to bring new people for surgeries because not only did they have to worry about these new people making mistakes, their speed was also an important consideration.
In the hospital, the speed of a surgery group was directly linked to factors such as performance bonuses.
Whenever it was possible, no one would be willing to lug a burden around.
Miao Tansheng did not want to become Ling Ran’s burden, because if he did become a burden, Ling Ran would probably reduce the number of operations in the clinic.
After all, he was no longer in school or a hospital, and Ling Ran had no obligation to teach him...
Miao Tansheng stole a glance at Ling Ran before he lowered his head.
Once he composed himself, he worked hard to clear up the blood clots.
His foundation was still there.
As he focused all his attention into the surgery with all his strength, he finally finished the tasks assigned by Ling Ran.
But he was also exhausted.
Ling Ran nodded in satisfaction.
Just as expected, Miao Tansheng was a middle-aged man who was able to bear the pressure.
Even after transferring seventy to eight percent of Ma Yanlin’s workload to him, Miao Tansheng still managed to carry his weight, and it was not an easy feat.
No matter what, Ma Yanlin had been a doctor who had been performing the Achilles tendon repair technique for two years, and Miao Tansheng had left large hospitals for quite some time.
But Ling Ran only thought about this before he continued with the surgery.
He did not increase Miao Tansheng’s workload any further.
As Miao Tansheng was nearing the last stage in his task of clearing the blood clots, he showed clear symptoms of low stamina.
Not only did he perform slower, his error rate also increased.
He did not manage to clean up the blood clots cleanly either...
All in all, according to Ling Ran’s judgment, he was about to no longer be able to use Miao Tansheng.
“Tendon suture thread.” Ling Ran was suturing the main part at this moment, and he no longer paid attention to Miao Tansheng.
Juan Zi, who was learning to be a scrub nurse, gently put a tendon suture thread into Ling Ran’s hand.
Ling Ran’s hand sank slightly.
He cast a glance at her before he continued with the surgery.
Juan Zi released a long breath weighing 11 pounds at that moment.
However, Miao Tansheng quickly relaxed and regained his identity as a person who operated the retractor.

His mind operated like a spinning table lamp as he recalled countless details in the hospital: the first time he met a beautiful female doctor in the hospital, the first time he met a beautiful female nurse during an operation, the first time he met a beautiful female family member during his first ward round, the first time he went to the mortuary...
“Today’s operation proceeded quite smoothly, right?” As the pressure on Miao Tansheng lessened, he attempted to be friendly, though no one knew whether it was done intentionally or unintentionally.
Ma Yanlin was familiar with Ling Ran’s habits and naturally bore the heavy responsibility of chatting.
In truth, he had also relaxed, and now, he wanted to chat.
“According to Doctor Ling’s usual progress, today’s surgery is conducted at just about average speed.
His speed might have been affected a little because we switched locations.”
“That’s only par for the course.
Sigh, there are not many surgeons now like Doctor Ling, who would be willing to spend two to three hours performing such a minor surgery.” Miao Tansheng praised Ling Ran indirectly.
Ma Yanlin agreed, and he was feeling sentimental when he said, “Who wouldn’t say so?
Most people would not perform an Achilles tendon repair like this.”
Miao Tansheng smiled and said, “When you look at it from another perspective, we’re also competing in a different manner.
I also contacted other hospitals and doctors, and we will be receiving more patients later on.
According to previous estimates, we should have more than three patients every week.”
The conversation he had with Old Hong today also strengthened Miao Tansheng’s confidence.
He believed that as long as there were suitable patients, the opportunity he would get here was still relatively large.
“That’s good.
If there are only three operations a week, you can utilize the beds here effectively.” Ma Yanlin could not help but be positive.
His main purpose was to learn the technique.
Now, Yun Hua Hospital performed an average of three or four Achilles tendon repairs a week, and they were mainly aimed at foreign patients and athletes.
If he could have an additional three surgeries at Lower Groove Clinic every week, he will be able to learn faster.
Miao Tansheng was a little proud at this moment.
He chuckled and said cheerfully, “Three operations is the lowest possible number I can promise you.
We’re just beginning, so let’s keep a lower profile.
I’ll look for my old friends.
Of course, it’s mainly because of Doctor Ling’s reputation.
When they heard that Doctor Ling’s the chief surgeon, they were willing to send patients over. ”
Ma Yanlin listened as he nodded and praised Doctor Miao’s extensive network, which made Miao Tansheng, who had not been flattered for a long time, to laugh.
The operating theater’s atmosphere was suddenly extremely harmonious.
Soon after, Ling Ran finished suturing the Achilles tendon.
He then gave the rest of his work to Ma Yanlin and went out to take a bath.
The benefits of performing surgery in his own clinic were vividly manifested at this time.
Ling Ran really changed his clothes this time.
Ling Ran left the operating theater.
Miao Tansheng and Ma Yanlin were also full of joy as they complimented each other.
When all the surgeries were completed, they left the operating theater, and they saw another ambulance from Golden Deer Health Services Pte Ltd stopping in the yard.
“Why did the ambulance stop here?” Miao Tan frowned.
“The back is full.” The driver also knew Miao Tansheng, so he could only purse his lips in resignation.
“Full with what?
There are other ambulances?”
“They are all sending patients over.” Juan Zi was also in a good mood today.

After running around with her fifty-two pound left leg and fifty-four pound right leg, she explained to Miao Tansheng, “Changxi Medical Company collected a patient with an Achilles tendon rupture from somewhere and sent him over.
Bazhaixiang hospital branch also found a patient with an Achilles tendon rupture.
The patients from both sides arrived at the same time, and now, one of them has to wait for the other to finish his surgery before he can receive his own surgery...”
“These lap dogs...” Miao Tansheng could feel the jealousy in his stomach gushing out.

chapters.title: Chapter 959: Small Clinic
paragraphs: “Doctor Ling, I’ve peeled some pine nuts for you.” Miao Tansheng was waiting in the courtyard for Ling Ran to return. The moment he saw Ling Ran, he immediately handed the latter a plate of peeled pine nuts and flashed a smile. “I peeled them with a pair of tweezers.”
“Oh, you’re pretty skilled,” Ling Ran could not help but comment when he looked at the plate of smooth and shiny pine nuts.

Miao Tansheng looked like he had just received the greatest praise in the world, and he was smiling from ear to ear. His huge eyebags trembled like the chest muscles of a burly man. “It’s great that you like them.”
“Thanks a lot.” Ling Ran took the plate and sniffed it before grabbing a handful of pine nuts. He ate some to replenish his strength and asked, “Are there any more patients?”

Only then did Ma Yanlin get an opportunity to show his face. “There are two more patients. One of them was sent over by Changxi Medical Company, and he’s suffering from chronic Achilles tendon rupture. The other patient is from Xiang Xueming from the Bazhaixiang hospital branch. He’s suffering from a fresh Achilles tendon rupture. Xiang Xueming said that he happened to encounter a patient with Achilles tendon rupture...”
Ma Yanlin explained things to Ling Ran. He was feeling envious.

How much attention had Xue Xueming been paying to Ling Ran’s actions, and how lucky he must be to coincidentally send over a patient with a fresh Achilles tendon rupture just when Ling Ran was starting to perform Achilles tendon repair surgery?

For a hospital such as the Bazhaixiang hospital branch, under normal circumstances, they would not even encounter a single patient suffering from Achilles tendon rupture for half a month or even three to five months. It was just like hunting. A hunter would always be able to score some prey, but there was no telling what they would be getting. Hence, aside from working hard in the jungle, they also had to pay attention to the demands of the consumers in the city.

Xiang Xueming and Changxi Medical Company were definitely not the only ones who were paying attention to what Ling Ran was doing. They just happened to be the hunters who managed to score suitable prey.
Naturally, Ling Ran was satisfied.

A surgeon’s job was like solving mathematical equations. It was definitely easier to perform the same kind of surgery for a period of time than alternate between different surgical methods. Aside from that, it was also more comfortable.

At the end of the day, humans needed a sense of achievement. Surgeons would feel a sense of achievement when they became better and better at a surgical method, and this would give them a reason to persevere.

It was just like solving mathematical equations. When a student solved the same kinds of mathematical equations for a period of time and got the correct answer again and again, not only would they be willing to continue studying, but they would also desire to challenge themselves and solve even harder mathematical equations. But if they were to alternate between different kinds of mathematical equations, even though things might look interesting from the surface, considering the variety, their interest in studying would actually diminish.

Ling Ran had performed an Achilles tendon repair surgery today, and he was at a point when he would like to carry out more Achilles tendon repair surgeries. He would forget about the notion if there were no suitable patients, but now that there were patients available, he started making arrangements without hesitation.
Ma Yanlin, Miao Tansheng, and Juan Zi were feeling the same. They proactively made arrangements together.

Su Jiafu was the only one who seemed a little tired. But when Ling Ran shot him an inquiring gaze, Su Jiafu answered so proactively that it was as if he was about to jump up from his seat. “I’ll be fine. Don’t worry, Doctor Ling.”
“Then, let’s hurry up and operate on those two patients. We can all have dinner together at my house after that.” As Ling Ran spoke, for some reason, he felt very good.
He definitely enjoyed more freedom when operating on patients at home.
The patient from Bazhaixiang was sent there only after receiving an X-ray before they hurriedly sent him over. But that did not really affect anything.

As the patient that Changxi Medical Company sent over was suffering from chronic Achilles tendon rupture, he had already received an MRI. The scans were clear, and it was definitely easier on the eyes in contrast to the X-ray scans.

“As expected, people from medical companies give better gifts,” Miao Tansheng said emotionally as he gazed at the pharmaceutical sales representative before him, who was treating Ling Ran with respect.

Actually, pharmaceutical sales representatives paid visits to the clinic every now and then too. They mostly sold drugs used for fluid transfusions and vaccines. At most, they would give him a box of tea leaves as a gift. This was totally different than Changxi Medical Company, which not only prepared a patient for Ling Ran but also took other things into consideration.
Something like that could not be quantified in monetary terms. The effort was priceless.
Financially, Miao Tansheng was doing pretty well nowadays. Hence, compared with the doctors from large hospitals, he cared more about the effort other people made.
“Doctor Ling, I’ll work hard to operate on these two patients too.” Standing before Ling Ran, Miao Tansheng tried his best to show how enthusiastic he was.

Ma Yanlin was Ling Ran’s loyal subordinate. Miao Tansheng was not shameless enough to fight for a position with a young man who was only a little more than twenty years old either. Hence, he chose to suck up to Ling Ran by speaking flattering words instead.

Ling Ran did not have any comment. He merely nodded. It was, of course, a good thing to have a proactive assistant. But when it came to surgical methods such as the Zhu-Ling Achilles Repair Technique, the workload was endless, and his assistants should not worry that someone would snatch away work that belonged to them.
“Do work hard, everyone. Pork rib soup will be served at night.” Ling Jiezhou raised an arm and waved at them. With his plump body, he looked like an amiable lottery vendor.
“Sure, Chief Ling,” Juan Zi replied and made her way to the operating theater. Her footsteps were loud due to how heavy she was.
Ling Jiezhou furrowed his eyebrows. Was it a losing deal for him to treat everyone to pork ribs soup?
At night, Wang Zhuangyong held a thick stack of medical books as he traversed the alleys of Lower Groove. There was a vigilant expression on his face.

If a person were to disregard his face and body, Wang Zhuangyong looked like a beautiful high school student from the Republic of China who was holding a stack of books and walking on a dangerous alley right now. Special agents from the Central Bureau of Investigation and Statistics and the National Bureau of Investigation and Statistics [1] would be standing on both her sides, ready to jump in to rescue this beautiful young woman at any moment. Meanwhile, Japanese people and members of the Collaborationist Chinese Army would be standing in front of her and behind her, ready to give a chance for the main characters to show how heroic and bold they were.
However, after taking a look at Wang Zhuangyong’s face and body, you would realize that he was merely a burly man who was walking past an alley without streetlights.
The place only felt like it belonged in a city when he arrived at the courtyard of Lower Groove Clinic because there were finally voices ringing out from the building.
“Ling Ran!” Wang Zhuang Yong yelled loudly before entering the clinic.
More than ten pairs of eyes shifted their gaze toward Wang Zhuangyong.
Wang Zhuangyong just had to stop in his tracks. “Chief Physician Shi, Chief Physician Yi, Doctor Yue...”
He had gotten to know quite a few doctors when he carried out his internship in Yun Hua Hospital.

“Oh, Young Wang, you’re here? Oh, both you and Doctor Ling are from Yun Hua University, right?” Doctor Yue, an attending physician from the Rehabilitation Department greeted Ling Ran. The other doctors nodded politely at him.
Wang Zhuangyong smiled at them one by one. “Yeah. We were batchmates.”

“Oh, yeah. I have almost forgotten about this. I keep feeling like Doctor Ling has graduated for a long time,” Doctor Yue could not help but say emotionally. He then looked at Wang Zhuangyong and asked in puzzlement, “Why are you here? To join in the fun?”
“Ling Ran asked me to come over to help out,” Wang Zhuangyong said in resignation.
“Oh, yeah. Since Doctor Ling knows you, of course, he thought of asking you to help out.” There was a hint of vigilance in Doctor Yue’s eyes.

Even though it was a private gig, it meant different things to be working on a private gig for different doctors. For example, because Ling Ran was part of Lower Groove Clinic, working for the clinic meant that a doctor could easily get close to Ling Ran.
Be that as it may, rehabilitation had never been a difficult field, so Wang Zhuangyong ended up becoming his competitor.

Doctor Yue narrowed his eyes. He believed that Ling Ran had a bright future in Yun Hua Hospital. If Wang Zhuangyong insisted on competing with him later, he might have no choice but to employ those tactics that he had learned throughout his years as a doctor to give this young man a good lesson.

“Are you Doctor Wang Zhuangyong?” Juan Zi walked out of the ward area with a phone in her hand. She looked like she was holding a sesame as she carefully shook the phone a few times. There was a photograph of Wang Zhuangyong on the screen.
“I am...” Wang Zhuangyong immediately answered.
“Doctor Ling said that you’ll be responsible for the rehabilitation of all three of the patients who have been operated on today. Are you capable of that?”

“Yes, no problem!” Wang Zhuangyong quickly answered. Due to the fact that he was afraid of blood, he had changed his career path and was fully focusing on rehabilitation medicine right now. But it was still hard for him to be responsible for individual patients.
Doctor Yue, who was sitting beside Ling Ran, asked, “Shouldn’t a comparison be made? Like via a test or something> Doctor Ling, nepotism isn’t a good practice...”
“We’re just a small clinic.” Juan Zi emphasized the word, “small”.

chapters.title: Chapter 960: Fish in Water
paragraphs: Wang Zhuangyong felt like a fish in water in the Ling family’s small clinic.

He was not that hemophobic, and he could have passed off as an internist. But it was obviously more comfortable for Wang Zhuangyong to be a rehabilitation specialist. Moreover, he seemed to be quite talented in rehabilitation medicine.

Previously, when Wang Zhuangyong worked together with the attending physicians and the senior resident doctors in the hospital to help patients with rehabilitation, not only was it tiring, but he was not taken seriously. This did not end in the department. To the patients and their family members, Wang Zhuangyong was too young to be substantially skilled in any area.
However, when a legit rehabilitation specialist appeared in Lower Groove Clinic, all of the people in the neighborhood regarded him with importance.
“Ah, my shoulders...”
“My legs hurt when it’s cold...”
“I scraped my knees...”

Lower Groove Clinic had always been a place where the residents of Lower Groove liked to gather. Now that they heard that there was a legit rehabilitation specialist there, all of them took the initiative to come over and make inquiries as well as receive treatment. There were also some who merely went there to join in the fun.

Ling Jiezhou decided to hang the board Dong Sheng had used outside the clinic. The words “25 RMB” were printed in large and bold font. The price was the same as what a salon in Lower Groove used to charge for a hair wash. It was very affordable for the people in Lower Groove.

When Wang Zhuangyong saw how busy Ling Jiezhou was and the way the latter allocated a special room for him, he was a little embarrassed. He said, “Uncle Ling, you don’t have to make things so formal. I’m just helping out in the neighborhood. It’s not very appropriate to involve money in this, isn’t it?”

“If it’s not appropriate to involve money, what should we involve? It’s not like you’re from Lower Groove. Also, even people in Lower Groove don’t do things for free. If we were to do everything for free, how is anyone going to make a living? I have to pay even when I eat sliced noodles in the Yang family’s restaurant, okay? I can’t just eat for free because my son had stitched up Old Yang’s hand before, can I?” Ling Jiezhou waved in dismissal and said, “Just be at ease and help the people in the neighborhood with recovery. As for the 25 RMB fee, I’ll give all of them to you.”
“Rehabilitation,” Wang Zhuangyong said in a soft voice. “Moreover, rehabilitation exercises are not for everyone.”
“If they feel like doing it, just help them out. The exercises won’t harm the body, will they?”
Wang Zhuangyong thought about it and shook his head a little. “There definitely won’t be any harm, as we tailor-make the exercise programs based on the condition of the patients’ bodies.”

“That’s why. It’s just like how we add glucose into the fluid transfusion bags. Without glucose, the patients would think that you’re shortchanging them. It took Wang Zhuangyong quite a while to do the math. “It’s impossible for twenty patients to be seeking treatment from me every day, isn’t it?” he asked a little hesitantly.

“You’ll know after giving it a try. Our clinic is actually pretty famous for massages.” Ling Jiezhou looked pleased with himself. “Ling Ran and Dong Sheng offer their massage service here all the time, and everyone’s pretty willing to pay for it.”
“Then... about this... shouldn’t we split the profit equally?”

“There’s no need for that. You can have all the money. The fact that you’ll be bringing patients to the clinic alone makes me happy,” Ling Jiezhou said generously and waved in dismissal. Indeed, it was important for Lower Groove Clinic to be able to retain their patients.

Correspondingly, if all the patients decided to head to Upper Groove or Yun Hua Hospital instead, Lower Groove Clinic would meet its end soon.

“My shoulders are pretty stiff.”
“Let me take a look at it first.” Wang Zhuangyong walked forward as he spoke and gave her shoulders a few presses. “They’re pretty stiff indeed. Are you taking any medications?”
“No. It’s an old injury, and none of the medications work.” The middle-aged woman shook her head.
“How did you hurt yourself?”
“When I was frying sunflower seeds.”
“Oh.” Wang Zhuangyong took a look at the middle-aged woman’s body size and showed his understanding.

“Young man, just give me a good, hard massage.” The middle-aged woman often went for massages in Lower Groove Clinic too. When Dong Sheng was around, she would let him do it. But whenever Ling Ran was around, she would be more proactive in coming. Even though another doctor was offering massage services today, she was also willing to give it a try.

Wang Zhuangyong chuckled and massaged the middle-aged woman like how Ling Ran taught her to. Before he was done, he said, “Madam, I mainly help patients with rehabilitation exercises, and it’s not really the same thing as massages.”
“Is it more expensive?”
“Not really.”
“Oh, how do you do that, then?

Wang Zhuangyong thought about it for a few seconds and slowly said, “I’ll simplify things. For massages, you just have to sit there without doing anything; the masseur does all the work. As for rehabilitation exercises, I’ll teach you a few moves, and you’ll have to do it yourself.”
“I’ll have to do it myself?” The middle-aged woman furrowed her eyebrows.
“Yes. Let me teach you the first move. You can give it a try.” As Wang Zhuangyong spoke, he started to move his arm.
The middle-aged woman stood up a bit reluctantly and said, “Alright, if I have to move myself, so be it. Do make it cheaper...”
“Just pay whatever you think you should.” Wang Zhuangyong had never gotten used to such monetary transactions, but he sounded like a typical doctor right then.
The middle-aged woman could not find any fault in what he had said. She had no choice but to start moving according to Wang Zhuangyong’s instructions.
Wang Zhuangyong naturally rose and made sure that she would not hurt herself. He also gave her instructions.
“Use more force, okay?”
“I’ll press it for you.”
“Keep going. Just three more times!”
Wang Zhuangyong’s voice kept ringing out from the room.
Along with his voice were the middle-aged woman’s uncontrollable screams.

The sounds pierced through the walls into the courtyard and penetrated the ceiling, and they could be heard in the reception hall. All the neighbors who were receiving fluid transfusion could hear them.
“That’s quite a commotion.”
“Pretty interesting.”
“So, this is how Big Sister Liu sounds like when she screams.”
Fifteen minutes later, the middle-aged woman who was drenched in sweat walked out of Wang Zhuangyong’s little consultation room with a refreshed expression.

An old man who often sold fritters in front of the small supermarket gazed at the white clouds on the horizon with a languid expression and spoke to Ling Jiezhou, who was walking past him. “Old Ling, I know that everyone’s businesses aren’t doing well this year, but as a clinic, you guys should stick to what you’re good at. You can’t just sell everything.”
Ling Jiezhou was shocked. “What are you talking about?”
The old man gave Ling Jiezhou a profound look. “I heard that your clinic has started selling shampoo and body shampoo.”
Ling Jiezhou could not help but laugh. “Those are for people who are allergic to ordinary products and pregnant women.”
The old man chuckled. “Whatever you say. It’s not like I can control what you sell, anyway...”

chapters.title: Chapter 961: Friendly
paragraphs: Wang Zhuangyong worked in Lower Groove Clinic until a little over eleven at night. Only then did he leave reluctantly after renting a shared bicycle.

Truth be told, very few people came to the clinic after ten at night. However, money was a huge motivation. Wang Zhuangyong could not help but carry on when he thought about how he could make 25 RMB per patient.
With every extra patient he treated, he got to make another 25 RMB. Of course, Wang Zhuangyoung, the young resident doctor, could hardly say no to such a tempting offer.

He had helped patients with rehabilitation exercises in the hospital too. Those sessions took a longer time, and he would basically be doing the same thing. Even though he did not get much respect while working in the hospital, he only got to make 12.50 RMB per session. With that money, all he could buy was a small bottle of coke.

As a man who had just graduated from university, what Wang Zhuangyong wanted to do the most was to prove his worth. The fact that he could make money through his own hard work put him in high spirits. Of course, most importantly, the fact that he could make 25 RMB per patient excited him.
He went home and slept. He then woke up the next day to go to work.
After work, Wang Zhuangyong rushed over to Lower Groove Clinic when the sky was turning dark.
“Ah, Doctor Wang is here.”
“Young Wang, save a slot for me.”
“Doctor Wang, come over to our shop to have some fun when you have time...”
A cacophony of voices rang out from the courtyard of Lower Grove Clinic, and the place was so lively that it looked like a karaoke bar for senior citizens which was full of elderly women.

Ling Jiezhou was also chuckling happily. He grabbed a thermos he purchased when his wife gave birth to Ling Ran and walked Wang Zhuangyong to his small consultation room. He then poured the latter some warm water and said with a smile, “Doctor Wang, you’ve been working hard. I’ll ask the patients who had booked a slot to come in one by one later. We’ll do things like how we did for the past few days.”
“Sure, sure,” Wang Zhuangyong agreed. He sounded like an elderly singer who had been singing by the streets for years.

“I got the first slot.” The middle-aged woman who injured her shoulders while roasting seeds and nuts ran over, and a few other middle-aged women jokingly threw curses at her, calling her an old cow and a fat carrot.
After working hard to offer consultations for a few days, Wang Zhuangyong had become fairly renowned. Quite a lot of residents from the nearby houses came over for rehabilitation exercises.
After all, they had lived for quite a few years, and it was inevitable that they would experience bodily discomforts.
Motivated by the money, Wang Zhuangyong worked for another two days. He then gave Chen Wanhao a call and asked him to come to Lower Groove Clinic for a dormmate reunion.
Nowadays, people no longer liked to attend university reunions. But people were pretty willing to attend small gatherings of between three to five people.
Wang Zhuangyong thought about how he wanted Chen Wanhao, who was a rich man’s son, to see how he had made it in life.
Chen Wanhao did not think much about it. He asked, “Is Ling Ran free?”

“Yes. He goes home to the clinic a lot nowadays, otherwise, how are we going to gather?” There was a smile on Wang Zhuangyong’s face. Part of the patients he helped with rehabilitation exercises in the clinic were patients who received surgery from Ling Ran. The process was the same as how it was in the hospital, with the fees being similar.

“He’s not facing problems at the hospital, is he? He didn’t use to go home at all. Yun Hua Hospital is a large hospital. I hope that he’s not getting bullied,” Chen Wanhao said with concern. Unlike Ling Ran who received offers from many departments in Yun Hua Hospital even before his internship ended, Chen Wanhao and Wang Zhuangyong had no choice but to work in smaller hospitals. Things were slightly more relaxing in those hospitals, but it was not like they were living an extremely easy life.

Wang Zhuangyong burst out laughing. “Nerd, don’t let your thoughts run wild. Ling Ran is doing very well. He’s only coming home more now because he’s helping out his family business. You’ll know what’s going on exactly after coming over.”
“Alright, then.” Chen Wanhao agreed on a time with Wang Zhuangyong and hung up.

After the conversation ended, Wang Zhuangyong immediately started tidying up his small consultation room, including his table and chair. He also wiped the neon board that said “25 RMB” outside the door with a washcloth.
Chen Wanhao was from quite a rich family. But Wang Zhuangyong doubted that Chen Wanhao could make so much money through his own efforts.
Truth be told, Wang Zhuangyong reckoned that Chen Wanhao was definitely not capable of this. When he thought of this, Wang Zhuangyong felt like laughing out loud.

No matter what, the fact that he had found a reason for all of them to gather after graduating from university itself was a joyous thing. It would be even better if he got to make some money during the gathering.
The following day, during the afternoon, people were walking back and forth on the first floor of Lower Groove Clinic and decorating the place.
Huang Maoshi stood in the kitchen and carefully scrutinized all the dishes.
“Those who are carrying the plates, please be careful. These dishes are very delicate, and their selling point is the presentation of the plates,” Huang Maoshi ordered. He was feeling very anxious.

Ling Ran was more than the leader of a treatment group in Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center now. The entire Emergency Medical Center and even the entire Yun Hua Hospital were inevitably influenced by his habits when it came to the consumption of drugs and medical consumables. This was especially true when it came to hepatectomy, and Ling Ran’s choices of drugs and medical consumables greatly influenced everyone in the hospital.
The medical consumables and drugs Ling Ran alone used were three to five times more than what the entire Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery used.
Changxi Medical Company originally had a firm grip on this excellent doctor. They did not expect Yunli Medical Company to appear out of nowhere and wantonly snatch away what belonged to them.
Fortunately, Huang Maoshi was familiar with Lower Groove Clinic. Now that he had heard that Ling Ran was organizing a small gathering, he went all out to make sure that it was a success.

He made sure that expensive-sounding seafood such as abalone, sea cucumbers, and yellow croakers were served in large amounts. There was not really a need to serve exuberant seafood like shark fin soup, fish snout, and fish belly, though...

Huang Maoshi had to make sure that he did not go over the budget while ensuring that the food served was presentable at the same time. After that, he decided to contribute his friendliness and attentiveness by standing outside the door and welcoming all the guests.

“Things are definitely different for doctors working in large hospitals. There’s even a pharmaceutical sales representative helping him out.” Chen Wanhao passed his coat to Huang Maoshi. His footsteps were light as he entered the courtyard, and his voice could be heard from far away.

“It’s nothing to do with me. He’s here to suck up to Ling Ran.” Wang Zhuangyong led Chen Wanhao upstairs and said with a smile, “Can you wait for a while? Ling Ran is still operating on a patient, and I need to attend to a few patients too. Go ahead and make yourself some tea. I remember that you know how to make tea, right?”
“Yes.” Chen Wanhao looked at Wang Zhuangyong with a dumbfounded expression and asked, “You have patients in Ling Ran’s family’s clinic too?”
“Yeah, not many. Maybe around ten or twenty a day.” Wang Zhuangyong lowered his head. He was worried that he would look pleased with himself, as this would affect himself trying to appear cool.
As expected, Chen Wanhao was rather shocked. After a while, he asked, “Are Ling Ran’s family members around?”
Wang Zhuangyong said, “They heard that we’re having a gathering in the clinic today, so they went traveling. They literally packed their bags and left.”
“Alright, then. Go ahead and attend to your patients.” Chen Wanhao sat down in the main seat of the tea table and started to make tea.
Wang Zhuangyong went downstairs and disappeared into the small consultation room with the “25 RMB” board.

Chen Wanhao froze for a moment. He could not help but become emotional, and he whipped out his phone and took a picture of the neon board along with the small door which looked like it hid a lot of secrets beneath it. He then uploaded the picture into his Circle of Friends with a caption. [As a doctor, we work hard so that our patients can walk out of the consultation room all refreshed.]

“Young man, you should pay more attention to what you’re doing when you’re making tea. Your tea would taste better that way.” A voice rang out from opposite the tea table. There was a little bit of an accent to the voice.
“Oh, I’m not really skilled at making tea.” When Chen Wanhao saw that the other party had sat down, he simply smiled. “I’ll wash a cup for you.”
Wang Chuanwen who had just returned from another state politely said, “Thanks a lot. Are you a staff member of Lower Groove Clinic?”
“No, I was Ling Ran’s classmate.” Chen Wanhao smiled.
“You’re very young,” Wang Chuanwen said and asked, “Are you here for some fun?”
“Yeah, I was Ling Ran’s roommate back in university, so we’re having a gathering between dormmates.”
“You’re Doctor Ling’s old friend, then. That’s great...” Wang Chuanwen immediately became a little more friendly.

He’s here to suck up to Ling Ran.” Wang Zhuangyong led Chen Wanhao upstairs and said with a smile, “Can you wait for a while?
Ling Ran is still operating on a patient, and I need to attend to a few patients too.
Go ahead and make yourself some tea.
I remember that you know how to make tea, right?”
“Yes.” Chen Wanhao looked at Wang Zhuangyong with a dumbfounded expression and asked, “You have patients in Ling Ran’s family’s clinic too?”
“Yeah, not many.
Maybe around ten or twenty a day.” Wang Zhuangyong lowered his head.
He was worried that he would look pleased with himself, as this would affect himself trying to appear cool.
As expected, Chen Wanhao was rather shocked.
After a while, he asked, “Are Ling Ran’s family members around?”
Wang Zhuangyong said, “They heard that we’re having a gathering in the clinic today, so they went traveling.
They literally packed their bags and left.”
“Alright, then.
Go ahead and attend to your patients.” Chen Wanhao sat down in the main seat of the tea table and started to make tea.
Wang Zhuangyong went downstairs and disappeared into the small consultation room with the “25 RMB” board.
Chen Wanhao froze for a moment.
He could not help but become emotional, and he whipped out his phone and took a picture of the neon board along with the small door which looked like it hid a lot of secrets beneath it.
He then uploaded the picture into his Circle of Friends with a caption.
[As a doctor, we work hard so that our patients can walk out of the consultation room all refreshed.]
“Young man, you should pay more attention to what you’re doing when you’re making tea.
Your tea would taste better that way.” A voice rang out from opposite the tea table.
There was a little bit of an accent to the voice.
“Oh, I’m not really skilled at making tea.” When Chen Wanhao saw that the other party had sat down, he simply smiled.
“I’ll wash a cup for you.”
Wang Chuanwen who had just returned from another state politely said, “Thanks a lot.
Are you a staff member of Lower Groove Clinic?”
“No, I was Ling Ran’s classmate.” Chen Wanhao smiled.
“You’re very young,” Wang Chuanwen said and asked, “Are you here for some fun?”
“Yeah, I was Ling Ran’s roommate back in university, so we’re having a gathering between dormmates.”
“You’re Doctor Ling’s old friend, then.
That’s great...” Wang Chuanwen immediately became a little more friendly.

chapters.title: Chapter 962: Link
paragraphs: “Old Chen.” When Wang Zhuangyong went upstairs again, he saw that Chen Wanhao was engaged in a conversation with the old man sitting opposite him.

Chen Wanhao extended his hand and waved. He said with a smile to Wang Zhuangyong, “I’ve met someone who likes tea too. Mister Wang is telling me about smoked tea. Oh yeah, both of you share the same surname. This is Young Wang. He used to be my dormmate too.”

“Your dorm gave rise to plenty of genii,” Wang Chuanwen praised them. “Doctor Wang was helping some patients with rehabilitation exercises downstairs earlier, and I saw that he’s quite good at it. Quite a number of people were queueing up to receive treatment from him.”

Wang Zhuangyong was pleased with himself when he heard this, and he was so happy that even his fingers were bent more elegantly as he held the teacup. He then gazed at the elderly Wang Chuanwen with a look of admiration on his face and praised him. “You’re not from Lower Groove, are you?”
“I don’t look like I am, do I?”
“Yea.” Wang Zhuangyong had encountered plenty of people from Lower Groove for the past few days.

Lower Groove was once one of the filthy parts of Yun Hua City, and people from Lower Groove of Wang Chuanwen’s age mostly used to be lower-class citizens who earned money courtesy of hard labor. They did not study much and were not very cultured people. After they made some money, they would, at most, start a small business. Those businesses might not even be successful.
Only Lower Groove residents from Ling Jiezhou’s generation onwards enjoyed a better quality of life.

Wang Chuanwen was wearing a jacket, but the jacket was a crisp and smooth one, and it was spotless. It might even be brand new. With this kind of aesthetics, this jacket was obviously not cheap. The way people dressed said a lot about them. Even though wearing such an expensive-looking jacket could not prove just how successful Wang Chuanwen was, but it was clear that he was definitely not from Lower Groove.
Wang Zhuangyong had been working in Lower Groove Clinic for quite a few days, and none of his elderly patients looked this rich.

Rich elderly men and rich elderly women would not trust doctors who only charged 25 RMB per session, anyway. They would naturally go to classy establishments like traditional Chinese medicine hospitals, and there would be highly-qualified and skilled physicians there.

“Young man, you’re observant indeed. I’m here to see Doctor Ling.” Wang Chuanwen did not bother to explain things. He changed the topic. “How about you, Doctor Wang? Why did you decide to help patients with rehabilitation exercises in Lower Groove Clinic?”

“I was just thinking about helping out Ling Ran’s family, but I didn’t expect there to be so many regular patients. I can’t just stop coming over with them around.” There was a smile on Wang Zhuangyong’s face as he said that.
Even though he had worked in the hospital for quite a while, almost no patients ever asked to see him.

Nowadays, patients were often discharged quickly from the wards. Even patients from the Rehabilitation Department were not allowed to stay in the hospital for a long time. And patients who were new to the hospital often liked to look for chief physicians or the leader of treatment groups without being aware of it. And after they were more used to life in the hospital and knew that they should be looking for attending physicians or their doctors in charge instead, it would almost be time for them to recover and get discharged.

Things were not the same in Lower Groove. Most patients who were there for physiotherapy exercises did not just intend to look for Wang Zhuangyong. They had no other choices, anyway. This was also why Wang Zhuangyong asked Chen Wanhao to come over so that he could show off.
“Doctor Wang!” After a few sips of tea, someone downstairs called for Wang Zhuangyong.
“Can’t help it. I’ll go over and take a look.” Wang Zhuangyong smiled, and he looked pleased with himself as he went downstairs with his head raised.

Chen Wanhao was in a little bit of a daze as he stared after Wang Zhuangyong, and as expected, he totally bought into Wang Zhuangyong’s boasting. He could not help but sigh. He then poured Wang Chuanwen a cup of tea and sipped his tea in silence.
Wang Chuanwen smiled and said, “You guys enjoy a pretty good relationship.”

Former classmates who showed off to each other after attaining small achievements enjoyed healthy relationships. Those who disappeared for a long time and showed up after ten years after they achieved success were usually seeking revenge.
Chen Wanhao flashed a wan smile. “There’s nothing for me to do other than watch as they show off. I’m still under rotation in the hospital, and I don’t know what’s going to happen next.”

As Chen Wanhao and Wang Chuanwen had tea, Wang Zhuangyong went upstairs to show off every time he had some free time. After a few rounds of showing off, Wang Zhuangyong already looked so pleased with himself that it was as if he was shining. Only then did Ling Ran exit the operating theater in the west wing of the clinic and walk upstairs as he washed his hand with some alcohol-based hand sanitizer.
“Are you done with the surgery?” Wang Zhuangyong stuck out his pinky finger as he held his teacup. He held his tea napkin in his other hand as he waved at Ling Ran.
“I’m done with all the surgeries today.” Ling Ran only saw Wang Chuanwen when he sat down by the tea table, and he greeted the latter.
“You’re late. Isn’t he, Old Chen?” Wang Zhuangyong smiled as he elbowed Chen Wanhao.
Chen Wanhao did not play along with Wang Zhuangyong, though. “I’m just early,” he said honestly.

Wang Zhuangyong gasped. “Not bad, Old Chen. You know the etiquettes of society now. Yes, this is the right way to talk... Ling Ran, take a look at the way Old Chen speaks and think about how you speak. You don’t seem to be showing any improvement.”
“How should I be talking, then?” Ling Ran asked.
“You need to at least tell us why you’re late, and make an apology according to the circumstances or something,” Wang Zhuangyong ordered Ling Ran excitedly.

Ling Ran thought about it for a moment and slowly said, “I was performing Achilles tendon repair surgery, and the assistant made a mistake. He used too much force, and he broke five thin blood vessels and a large number of capillaries. To ensure that the patient enjoys a good prognosis, I spent quite a lot of time suturing the broken blood vessels...”

“Alright, under these circumstances, you don’t have to apologize. You know, as surgeons, you guys can’t really be flexible with your time. It’s different for rehabilitation specialists. We have fixed working hours and make quite a lot of the money at the same time,” Wang Zhuangyong said with a resigned expression.
As he spoke, Wang Zhuangyong turned and pointed at the 25 RMB board, Ultraman-style.

It may have been because there was an outsider around, but Wang Zhuangyong’s move, which he used to only do in their dorm, seemed especially embarrassing today. To someone who was not in the know, he looked more like a female superhero from an anime who was transforming into her costumed self.
There was an extremely shocked expression on Wang Chuanwen’s face.
‘What is he doing?
‘I’m about to talk about something serious!’
“Mister Wang, why are you here today? Is something the matter?” Ling Ran asked Wang Chuanwen as he sipped his tea.

“Yes. It’s about the ICU.” Now that Ling Ran was asking Wang Chuanwen this question, the latter immediately sat up straight. He looked like he was about to get down to business as he said, “I have had a detailed discussion with Department Director Huo, and I’m also willing to fork out money to help out Yun Hua Hospital as well as the Emergency Medical Center to build a new ICU. But before I do that, I would like to ask you for your opinion. After all, I’m mainly willing to fork out such a large sum because of you, Doctor Ling.”
Wang Chuanwen spoke in a sincere tone, and he was also explaining things in detail.
Wang Zhuangyong and Chen Wanhao looked at each other. Wang Zhuangyong then slowly said, “I feel like I have seen this scene somewhere before.”
“At the lecture halls, the field, the shaded walkway, the cafeteria, the roof, in front of the dorm...” Chen Wanhao sounded similarly calm.

Wang Zhuangyong immediately understood what Chen Wanhao meant. He could not help but sigh when he looked at Wang Chuanwen’s enthusiastic and sincere expression. He went to sit beside Chen Wanhao and watched Ling Ran and Wang Chuanwen’s interaction like he was watching a movie.
Even though the environment was different, it was that same scene...

“For our initial plan, we will be building an ICU with eight beds along with the corresponding facilities and equipment. Department Director Huo said that the hospital and the Emergency Department would be paying for part of it...

“Technically, we will have to go through a tendering process when it comes to the facilities and equipment. But aside from donating cash, I can also donate facilities and equipment. Doctor Ling, if you’re interested...

“Overall, Yun Hua Hospital will be responsible for the hiring and allocation of doctors. I reckon that even Department Director Huo has a limited say in this matter. But if there’s anything you want to say about it...”

It only took a short while for Wang Zhuangyong and Chen Wanhao to understand what was going on. The elderly man was not there to talk because he was bored. Instead, he was there to offer goodies to Ling Ran.
Unfortunately, Ling Ran was unable to read between the lines. Wang Zhuangyong and Chen Wanhao were anxious on Ling Ran’s behalf.

However, they had been dormmates with Ling Ran for a long time, and they knew what kind of person Ling Ran was. If Ling Ran were after the goodies other people offered him, he would have dated one of the beautiful young women who drove sports cars and wore Richard Mille watches...
Yet, by the end of the conversation, Chen Wanhao could hardly stop himself as he said, “Ling Ran, can you give me a chance if there’s any vacancy in the new ICU?”
“You’re interested in working in the ICU?” Ling Ran was a little shocked as he looked at Chen Wanhao.

In the hospital, doctors working in the ICU were known for living a tiring life that always ended up with their bodies getting dirty by the end of the day. Of course, they earned a lot more than the average doctor. But Chen Wanhao was not someone who needed money.

Chen Wanhao nodded solemnly and said, “My grandfather went in and out of the ICU before passing away, so I’m quite interested in working in the ICU. It’s just that I have not gotten a chance to do so yet.”

“Sure,” Ling Ran agreed to Chen Wanhao’s request before he looked at Wang Chuanwen. With Wang Chuanwen’s position and power, he was definitely capable of ensuring that a junior doctor was hired by Yun Hua Hospital for the new ICU. Ling Ran did not know whether it would be difficult for him to do so, though.

“No problem. I will personally make a request for Doctor Chen to be hired so that there’s nothing the hospital can say about it.” Wang Chuanwen immediately agreed. It might be more convenient for him to use Wang Chuanwen as a link tying him to Ling Ran instead of directly appealing to Ling Ran.

chapters.title: Chapter 963: Thrown to the Ground
paragraphs: At the fountain, with its tail sticking up, Fragrance Yard walked around its territory in a leisurely manner. It poked and prodded the food thrown to it by those around it.

The children feeding it might not necessarily possess a bachelor in zoology and more than three years of experience in rearing a goose. Hence, most of the things the children threw to feed Fragrance Yard were what they liked to eat rather than what the large white goose favored.

Fragrance Yard found this a problem. It had no choice but to spend energy to single out all of the food that was edible and considered delicious to it. It also walked toward the children who gave it food it did not like to chase them away even though its legs were bound by chains. It hoped that it could ensure the quality of its food supply by doing this. Hopefully, one day in the near future, it would wake up to ground full of food instead of inedible things and rubbish.
*Honk honk...*

Fragrance Yard saw a lump of soil being thrown to the ground before it. Not only was it inedible, but it would also pollute the water in its pond. It could not help but become so angry that it extended its wings and opened its mouth, showing its beak with its serrated tongue. It charged toward the person who threw the lump of soil at it without hesitation...
However, the man who threw the lump of soil to it slapped Fragrance Yard’s neck and shoved it away.
Fragrance Yard charged toward him again, and it was shoved away again...
“Hey, who’s the one rearing this goose. Is it edible?” The man was holding another lump of soil in his other hand, and he chuckled provocatively. He looked at Fragrance Yard’s buttocks.

“If it’s edible, it would have been eaten a long time ago. You wouldn’t stand a chance. Alright, quickly come over and put on your helmet. That fierce old man from the Emergency Department is here again.”
“Ah, what a pity. This goose is gigantic. It would taste amazing if we stew it in a metal pot.”
“You have never had your salary deducted before, have you?”

“Don’t talk about this all the time.” When he heard that, the man who was still provoking the large white goose immediately put on his safety helmet and returned to the fenced area. He continued to carry out boring renovation work.

The Emergency Medical Center’s ICU would be located on the other side of the fountain, as this was the only place that had enough space for eight ICU hospital beds, an additional operating theater, and all kinds of facilities.

There were more than ten construction workers, and they were racing against time to complete the renovation of the building. They worked especially hard every time Huo Congjun and his entourage came over.
“You guys are doing a pretty good job. Would you guys be able to complete it in time?”
“Keep going!”
“You’ve worked hard.”
As Huo Congjun looked at the ICU that was already taking shape, he felt so excited that even jumping into the fountain would not be able to extinguish the flame in his heart.

The foreman naturally said what Huo Congjun wanted to hear. People in that industry who were used to building hospital buildings knew that all they had to do was do a good job fooling the doctors. Those who were in control of the progress of the construction were always the medical company who funded the construction and the Medical Affairs Department. Of course, it would not do them any favors to offend doctors either. If they had the misfortune to be on the receiving end of a powerful doctor’s hatred, even if they were able to complete the construction, they would not be able to receive their retainage.

“Why is there a smaller adjoining building at the side? What will it be used for?” Hospital Director Zhou was walking in front of Huo Congjun. She did not know much about the details of the construction, but she had a rough idea of what all the rooms in the building which were under construction would be used for.
“It was Old Zuo’s suggestion. Why don’t you tell her about it, Old Zuo?” Huo Congjun cleared his throat and stood aside so that Zuo Cidian could speak to Hospital Director Zhou.
Zuo Cidian who was walking along with them chuckled and said, “We plan to make the adjoining building you are seeing now a lounge for paramedics.”
Hospital Director Zhou froze for a moment. “Lounge for paramedics? Doesn’t the hospital provide accommodation for the paramedics?”

Zuo Cidian said with a smile, “Regarding that matter, we have also taken public ambulances and ambulances from other hospitals into consideration. After sending patients to the Emergency Medical Center, drivers and paramedics from any ambulance can get some rest in the lounge to drink tea, have some snacks, watch television, and stuff like that.”
Hospital Director Zhou had worked as an emergency medical specialist before, and she immediately understood. “Oh... you guys plan to make it a...”
“Luxurious lounge.” Huo Congjun finished Hospital Director Zhuo’s sentence so that she would not speak the embarrassing truth.

Zuo Cidian was not a person who cared about his image as much as Huo Congjun. He continued. “If there’s a need, there’s a dining area in the lounge for paramedics where we can provide a buffet. Aside from that, we can also equip the area with some computers so that the paramedics can watch movies, listen to music, or play computer games...”
With that, if it were possible, paramedics would try their best to send patients to Yun Hua Hospital.
There were quite a number of emergency medical companies in Changxi Province now. Together with the city council’s Emergency Medical Care Center, the management of ambulances was quite a mess.

Under ordinary circumstances, the patients or their family members could request for a particular hospital. But if they either did not do that or asked the paramedics for a suggestion, the paramedics would definitely prioritize Yun Hua Medical Center which possessed a comfortable lounge for paramedics.

Hospital Director Zhou could not help but smile. “I was worried about whether you guys would have enough patients after the construction of the ICU is completed. It seems that you guys already have plans.”
“As an Emergency Medical Center, we should live up to our name.” Huo Congjun never made any compromises when it came to this.

“You have my support. Now that you guys are a center, there’s no turning back.” Hospital Director Zhou’s expression became a little more solemn. “The surgical volume and number of patients treated must be increased, and money is also a consideration. But when it came to the number of staff members, you guys still have to try to keep it down. The Emergency Medical Center is now the largest department in the hospital. If you add more staff members, other department directors would have something to say about it.”

“They’re also going to comment if we don’t hire more staff members.” Department Director Huo snorted a few times and continued, “Now that we’re building an ICU, if there are insufficient staff members, we won’t be able to run the ICU properly.”
“Hm... I reckon that the ICU Department won’t allocate that many staff members and resources to you either.”
Huo Congjun said nonchalantly, “We don’t need that. I plan to hire someone from another hospital, but I have not encountered any good candidate for the time being.”
Huo Congjun looked at Hospital Director Zhou as he spoke.

Hospital Director Zhou smiled. She lowered her head and thought about it for a moment. “Alright, then. When the time comes, I’ll hook you up with a few candidates. By the way, regarding the lounge for paramedics, it’s an extremely brilliant idea. It doesn’t take much money, and it should be very effective. Doctor Zuo is a clever person indeed.”
Compared with the ICU that had to be equipped with all kinds of facilities and equipment, the cost-effectiveness ratio of the lounge for paramedics was definitely a lot higher.
Zuo Cidian flashed a shy smile. “I’ve carried out some surveys together with Doctor Ling, and I feel that this lounge for paramedics is very important.”

“A patient suffering from cardiac trauma came in just now, and because we ran out of hospital beds, we transferred him to the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery and sent him straight to the operating theater.” Huo Congjun paused for a moment and continued, “Ling Ran followed them there to take a look.”

Hospital Director Zhou did not see anything wrong with the first part of what Huo Congjun said. No matter what the reason was, it was reasonable for the Emergency Department to transfer a patient to another department. But what was with the second part?

“Aren’t you worried that they would eat Ling Ran up?”

It poked and prodded the food thrown to it by those around it.
The children feeding it might not necessarily possess a bachelor in zoology and more than three years of experience in rearing a goose.
Hence, most of the things the children threw to feed Fragrance Yard were what they liked to eat rather than what the large white goose favored.
Fragrance Yard found this a problem.
It had no choice but to spend energy to single out all of the food that was edible and considered delicious to it.
It also walked toward the children who gave it food it did not like to chase them away even though its legs were bound by chains.
It hoped that it could ensure the quality of its food supply by doing this.
Hopefully, one day in the near future, it would wake up to ground full of food instead of inedible things and rubbish.
*Honk honk...*
Fragrance Yard saw a lump of soil being thrown to the ground before it.
Not only was it inedible, but it would also pollute the water in its pond.
It could not help but become so angry that it extended its wings and opened its mouth, showing its beak with its serrated tongue.
It charged toward the person who threw the lump of soil at it without hesitation...
However, the man who threw the lump of soil to it slapped Fragrance Yard’s neck and shoved it away.
Fragrance Yard charged toward him again, and it was shoved away again...
“Hey, who’s the one rearing this goose.
Is it edible?” The man was holding another lump of soil in his other hand, and he chuckled provocatively.
He looked at Fragrance Yard’s buttocks.
“If it’s edible, it would have been eaten a long time ago.
You wouldn’t stand a chance.
Alright, quickly come over and put on your helmet.
That fierce old man from the Emergency Department is here again.”
“Ah, what a pity.
This goose is gigantic.
It would taste amazing if we stew it in a metal pot.”
“You have never had your salary deducted before, have you?”
“Don’t talk about this all the time.” When he heard that, the man who was still provoking the large white goose immediately put on his safety helmet and returned to the fenced area.
He continued to carry out boring renovation work.

They worked especially hard every time Huo Congjun and his entourage came over.

Those who were in control of the progress of the construction were always the medical company who funded the construction and the Medical Affairs Department.
Of course, it would not do them any favors to offend doctors either.
If they had the misfortune to be on the receiving end of a powerful doctor’s hatred, even if they were able to complete the construction, they would not be able to receive their retainage.

Hospital Director Zhou had worked as an emergency medical specialist before, and she immediately understood.

Zuo Cidian was not a person who cared about his image as much as Huo Congjun.
