chapters.title: Chapter 964: Ceremoniously
paragraphs: The operating theater of the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery was situated to the right of the elevators. They chose to build it there so that the patient could straightaway be wheeled into the operating theater at lightning speed after going up the elevator.

Back when the building was built, Department Director Kang really liked the location of this operating theater, which was located at the center of the hospital. He had imagined the scene that would unfold whenever a patient was wheeled into the wards. Cardiovascular surgeons who mastered top-notch medical skills who were clad in beautiful scrubs would be ceremoniously entering the wards with both their hands raised, leaving the crowd of doctors who were watching behind them.
No matter how arrogant a surgeon was, they would have no choice but to pass by the elevators, and bumping into the doctors from the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery was inevitable.
The cardiovascular surgeons’ expression may have been solemn or jocular, with hulking figures and fingertips that were pulsing with strength...
At least, when Department Director Kang imagined this scene, there was background music in his mind.
“All of you, stand up straight.” Department Director Kang looked around and reprimanded his subordinates.
‘All of them are slumping! Is this how a doctor should look?’
“Boss, I haven’t been home for thirty hours,” one of his subordinates grumbled as he stood up straight.

“You haven’t been home for thirty hours. This doesn’t mean that you didn’t get any sleep over these past thirty hours.” Department Director Kang snorted internally. He knew very well that his department did not have that many patients.
Department Director Kang furrowed his eyebrows. He was very dissatisfied with his subordinate’s attitude. What would have happened if Huo Congjun said the same thing? Would anyone refute this?

At the end of the day, he had too little control. Department Director Kang furrowed his eyebrows and thought about if it was not for the fact that he was lacking in manpower, he would make things difficult for everyone in his department to safeguard his authority as a department director.

“Stand up straight, everyone. Wash your hands more carefully and stop whispering to one another. Why do I feel like a school teacher?” Department Director Kang kept barking orders and tried to make his subordinates act more like what he imagined top surgeons should be like.
Of course, it was useless.
If it were of any use, he would not have needed to wait until today to say these words.
His subordinates obeyed his orders nonchalantly. They looked more like they were dealing with an associate chief physician than a stern department director.

Department Director Kang softened his tone. “Keep your spirits up, everyone. We don’t really get that many surgeries every week, so now that we’re in the operating theater, we should work earnestly. Surgeons become skillful through practice.”
“But our surgical volume is a little too low, isn’t it?” His assistant today, Assistant Physician He Liang pursed his mouth and grumbled out of habit.

Junior doctors must respect senior doctors and fulfill all of the senior doctors’ reasonable and unreasonable demands. They also have to act as an outlet for senior doctors to vent their emotions while getting minimal pay and doing maximal work... But the prerequisite was that the said senior doctors were able to provide those junior doctors with resources.

A monetary reward, as well as a promotion, could be considered as resources. Unquantifiable skills and a bright future could also be considered as resources. But the most basic resources a doctor could get were patients and surgeries.
If a department did not even have enough patients and surgeries, how were the doctors going to have any future or develop any skills? How was the doctor going to get any monetary reward?

Unfortunately, this was how things were currently like in the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery of Yun Hua Hospital. Department Director Kang tried all means and methods to rope in more patients, but he could not even get enough patients for himself. How could there be any more patients left for his subordinates to practice on?
Department Director Kang did feel slightly guilty about it.
*Mumble, mumble, mumble, mumble...*
A few young nurses who were passing by the handwashing room were talking to each other.
*Clack, clack, clack, clack...*
Two doctors who looked like they were passing by stopped in their tracks and looked over.
Department Director Kang suddenly felt slightly touched.

‘Yes, Yun Hua Hospital’s Department of Cardiovascular Surgery is a little small. But cardiovascular surgery is still a respectable, top-notch field that garners other people’s attention, or else, why would so many people look at the few weak doctors in our department?’
“He Liang!” Department Director Kang suddenly called out fiercely.
He Liang froze, but he answered obediently, “Department director?”

“Stop spreading fallacies to mislead people. If you’re not willing to operate on patients anymore, just go home and rest.” Department Director Kang was directly chasing He Liang away. Based on Department Director Kang’s usual behavior, this was considered a very stern warning.
They were only doing simple cardiac trauma repair today. Even without an assistant like He Liang, Department Director Kang would be able to handle things himself.
He Liang did not know what was going on in his department director’s mind. He froze for a moment before lowering his head and letting it go.
Department Director Kang felt that he had regained some of his authority as a department director. Just as he was about to flash a smile, a silhouette appeared in the corridor.
“Department Director Kang.” Ling Ran’s tall figure appeared, and he walked into the handwashing room after greeting Department Director Kang.
“Doctor Ling.”
“Doctor Ling?”
All the people in the handwashing room were extremely astonished.

After Ling Ran started washing his hands, more and more people started to walk past the hand washing room. There were also nurses who pretended to pass by and intruded the hand washing room. They looked at Ling Ran like they were about to eat him up before leaving with their heads lowered.
Department Director Kang panicked internally and asked, “Ling Ran... do you have a surgery going on here?”
“Not yet... I think.”
“Then, why are you washing your hands?”
“Oh... I’m thinking of taking a look at your operating theater.” Ling Ran flashed a socially appropriate smile. “Sometimes, I like to wash my hands before watching surgeries.”
Department Director Kang almost cursed out loud.
What was the purpose of him washing his hands after watching other people performing surgery? The answer was self-evident.
Department Director Kang looked coldly at Ling Ran and said, “Doctor Ling, there will be quite a lot of people working in the operating theater today, so I won’t be inviting you over.”
Ling Ran froze for a moment and asked, “How many people are there in your department?”
Department Director Kang was extremely furious. ‘Is the main point in what I said the number of people?!’
“How’s the patient’s condition?” When Ling Ran saw that Department Director Kang was saying nothing, he threw the latter another question.
“How good can the condition of a patient suffering from cardiac trauma be?” Department Director Kang asked in exasperation.
“If it’s pure cardiac trauma, I’ve operated on a patient with this condition before...” Ling Ran had learned how to voice out his point of view.

When it came to surgeries like this, the fact that a surgeon had performed it before was the best proof of his capabilities. A surgeon who had performed a cardiovascular surgery before was totally different from one who had never performed cardiovascular surgery.
As long as a surgeon had performed cardiovascular surgery before, the likelihood of him making any mistake was relatively lower.

Department Director Kang saw that Ling Ran had revealed his true intention, and he was still thinking about how to say no when a young nurse beside him said in a soft voice, “Department director, I’ve asked someone to switch on all the air-conditioners and ventilators. Having a few more doctors in the operating theater won’t be a problem.”
“Alright, then.” Department Director Kang flung his hands to dry them and headed to the operating theater. He did not even bother saying anything.
In the operating theater, the anesthetist was done making preparations. When he saw that Department Director Kang and his entourage were back, he rose and said, “We can get started now.”
“Let’s get started, then.” Department Director Kang took the position of chief surgeon.
“Oh, alright.” The anesthetist was not very used to how aggressive Department Director Kang was acting. ‘I thought that we’re taking it easy.’
*Shick*
The moment the surgery began, someone opened the door of the operating theater.
“Doctor Ling.” The nurses let out soft gasps.
Department Director Kang said nothing. He was operating on the patient with his head lowered.
“Midline incision,” Ling Ran simply commented when he saw what Department Director Kang was doing.

Department Director Kang, though, could not help but suck in a sharp breath. His desire to get to the patient ahead of Ling Ran suddenly disappeared, and his mind was flooded with worry instead. ‘Am I going to fade into the background during this surgery?’

chapters.title: Chapter 965: Hold On
paragraphs: Department Director Kang’s hand was steady.
Department Director Kang steadily performed the incision.
Department Director Kang’s thoughts were clear.
However, Department Director Kang was panicking.
He felt like a beautiful golden pheasant with beautiful tail feathers that was being stared at by a white tiger with beautiful patterns while it was catching bugs.

Department Director Kang had felt a similar way before. It was way before the country began an intensive crackdown. Department Director Kang had excitedly opened a hotel near Prosperous Fountain Restaurant, intending to meet up with his girlfriend—whom he had never met before and paid for online—to do the nasty. Unexpectedly, the hotel was under police surveillance...
“Aspirate,” Department Director Kang shouted rather emotionally.
The attending physician, He Liang, who was an assistant, moved the aspiration tube over.

“Your hands should be stable, and your mind should be filled with thoughts of the surgery. Don’t take action only when I tell you to. You have to do it before I do it, understand?” Department Director Kang reprimanded He Liang with the authority of a department director.
He Liang had no choice but to endure it.

It was not easy for doctors to look for jobs now as well. It was even more difficult to find a hospital at Yun Hua Hospital’s level. Before he resigned, all his confidence allowed him to do was grumble. He did not dare confront Department Director Kang face to face.

Of course, that was why his skills were not good. If the department director was a better person, He Liang could have been given a little more chance to operate and let him practice his skills. Then, he would have quit his job after he mastered the skill and left.

The gushing blood flowed out of the patient. The blood was sucked into the autologous blood transfusion canister, had saline solution added to it, started moving via a centrifugal pump, and was reinjected into the patient.
Department Director Kang frowned and asked for a pair of rib shears to enlarge the incision on the patient’s chest.
Normally, he could perform this surgery smoothly, but perhaps it was because someone was staring at him, and it made Department Director Kang feel like things just were not progressing smoothly.
Perhaps it was because it had been too long since someone watched his surgery, and very few people wanted to.
Department Director Kang was in a daze for a few seconds.

Once upon a time, his surgeries were very popular in the hospital. Many doctors, especially those who were interested in the field of cardiovascular surgery, would stop by to see Department Director Kang’s surgeries whenever they were free.
At that time, Department Director Kang also mastered several famous skills...
However, the development of the field of cardiovascular surgery was obviously faster than Department Director Kang’s speed in development.
It should be said that since the 21st century, the clinical surgeries that developed the fastest were from the field of cardiovascular surgery.

It had the most equipment, instruments, and drugs, as well as a lot more surgical methods and surgical ideas compared with other fields, which caught the doctors focusing on cardiovascular surgeries by surprise. By the time they realized it, they were already lagging behind the others.
Department Director Kang disliked people watching his surgeries.

He especially hated it when a doctor specializing in cardiovascular surgeries watched him because he would always be able to tell that Department Director Kang’s skills were outdated, and even... rusty...

The lower the ranking of the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery of Yun Hua Hospital was, the lesser attention would be paid to it, and the lesser resources they could obtain, which would lead to fewer patients. Now, Department Director Kang could not even guarantee his surgery volume. He could vaguely feel that his surgery skills had not only become stagnant as time passed, but he may have even gotten worse.

Take the cardiac trauma repair he was performing now as an example. It was the simplest cardiac surgery, but he found it a little unfamiliar, especially when compared with Ling Ran, who was in front of him...

“Aspirate cleaner. Hurry up. Is this how you perform surgery?” It seemed like Department Director Kang was about to stab He Liang on the opposite side with the scalpel in his hand at any moment. He ordered him loudly as if the surgery would progress smoother if he did.
The nurses and anesthetist in the operating theater all lowered their heads quickly to avoid being caught in the crossfire.

As long as an angry surgeon’s level was high enough, regardless of whether he was calling out for muscle relaxants or something else, he would still be skilled, and they would still not dare to offend him.
He Liang could only lower his head in silence. Next to him was Ling Ran. He could not let another surgeon who was also in the Department of Surgery see him make a fool of himself.

He Liang raised his head quietly and took another look at a lovely young nurse standing at the back. She was looking at Ling Ran in all seriousness. He could not help but shake his head, ‘How foolish the world is...’
“Be serious!” Department Director Kang shouted at He Liang again.
He was busy looking for the location where the heart was bleeding. He then saw that He Liang was distracted. Suddenly, he had something new to scold him about.
He Liang shook his head and smiled bitterly. ‘It’s no use for me to just be serious,’ he thought to himself.

Hence, when he faced Ling Ran, who continued persecuting him, he came up with six scenarios and eighteen strategies when he thought about how he should handle Ling Ran, and from there, formed seventy-two models of he should take care of Ling Ran.

His movements stopped for a moment. “Doctor Ling, the rules of the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery may be different from what you are familiar with. Ling Ran hummed and said, “But how can you stop the bleeding if you don’t expand the exposure range?”
“Hmm?” Department Director Kang frowned. The answer was a little off his model.
However, Department Director Kang soon realized what Ling Ran meant.
“You can see the location of the bleeding just by looking at it from far away?” If Ling Ran had not been in front of him, Department Director Kang would have laughed by now.

As Ling Ran talked, he pointed at the position covered by Department Director Kang’s palm.
Since he had Perfect Level Barehanded Bleeding Control, he could obtain a lot of information.
Department Director Kang hesitated for a moment before he said, “Let’s cut it open and take a look.

If Ling Ran did not say anything, Department Director Kang would have to spend another half minute to find it. If he could not find the bleeding point, he would have to continue cutting up the patient.

Surgical exploration was, in truth, a surgeon looking for something slowly after he cut up a patient. The most typical ones were intestinal surgeries from the field of general surgery. Surgical exploration for cardiac surgeries or thoracic surgeries was the same. It would be best if ordinary surgeons could find the right exposure point through their incision, but if they could not find it, they would need to continue cutting until they found it.

Department Director Kang would not deliberately go against the direction pointed out by Ling Ran in order to prove himself. One, it was because he did not have quite the idea of how he should proceed with the exploration. Two, Department Director Kang was wary of Ling Ran’s reputation in hemostasis and the cardiovascular surgery skills he revealed the other day.

He Liang was a little surprised. Before Department Director Kang changed his mind, he hurriedly started.

The muscle around Department Director Kang’s eyes twitched in annoyance. He then said in a self-deprecating way, “Good thing that it’s not at the bottom...”
“There’s a possibility that the bottom is bleeding too.” As soon as Ling Ran spoke again, the muscles around Department Director Kang’s eyes twitched in annoyance even more.

Department Director Kang had felt a similar way before.
It was way before the country began an intensive crackdown.
Department Director Kang had excitedly opened a hotel near Prosperous Fountain Restaurant, intending to meet up with his girlfriend—whom he had never met before and paid for online—to do the nasty.

chapters.title: Chapter 966: Attack
paragraphs: Department Director Kang was having difficulty thinking. His eyes were fixed in the direction of the patient’s chest, they were not focused.
He never thought that Ling Ran could really do it; he did not even put his hands on the patient, and he was already able to tell where the blood loss was.
With such an ability, did that not mean that he could stop all blood losses regardless of where they were?
With such a thought, Department Director Kang could not help but smile bitterly. ‘Isn’t that what Ling Ran is doing now?’

Only the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery had no time to ask Ling Ran for help. Other departments had asked Ling Ran for help more than once or twice. As for the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery that needed hemostasis the most... it had been directly taken over by the Emergency Department...

The muscle around Department director Kang’s eyes twitched in annoyance again. The lessons from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery were so brutal that the department directors of the small departments would all shudder for three hours whenever they remembered it.
“The wound is sutured.” He Liang took the opportunity to complete the suturing of the cardiac rupture he saw earlier.

He did not care whether there was a wound at the end of the vertical long axis or whether there was a wound at the back. If the position was too difficult, he could not suture it nicely, anyway. It would be better if he just sutured one at a time and considered it done.
Department Director Kang hummed before he sighed in slight regret. “Young He, are you done suturing?”
The department currently had very few patients and very few chances to perform surgeries. It was to the point that Department Director Kang himself needed to practice suturing cardiac wounds.
It was a pity that the cardiac wound had been taken care of by his assistant during the chaos. Department Director Kang felt an indescribable feeling of displeasure in him.
“Department director, please check it.” He Liang was still smiling. On the inside, he was incredibly happy.
Often times, the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery could not even touch a living heart, and that was also incredibly sad.
Fortunately, he managed to suture one today, and he could go through his day with a smile again. He could persevere for at least a few more weeks.

Department Director Kang sulked and checked it again. He remembered the story in “Thirty-six Ways to Scheme Against Others”. His gaze was on the monitor, and he counted silently. After a while, his expression changed a little.
“There’s no problem, right?” He Liang was unsure.
“There may be another wound...” the department director spoke reluctantly and glanced at Ling Ran from the corner of his eye.
He did not mention where the location was. One, it was because he did not believe Lin Ran could estimate the location so accurately. Two, he had no idea where it was either.
How would he know where the wound was if he did not cut it open?
Despite that, from his prior experience, Ling Ran may really know its location. Yet, Department Director Kang was reluctant to believe it.
Ling Ran’s expression was calm as if he was not surprised by this at all.

On average, Ling Ran performed thirty to fifty freelance surgeries per month. Who knew how many doctors had cooperated with him? He must have met doctors like Department Director Kang, the kind who had poor skills but had many ideas.
It was very easy for doctors to embarrass themselves if they had many ideas but poor skills.
Department Director Kang’s current feeling of embarrassment was an example.
“Make the incision wider.” Department Director Kang frowned as he gave another order. He tried to avoid eye or verbal contact with Ling Ran.

He now understood why Ling Ran said that he could still widen the incision a little more. In fact, when he went back further in the recollection of his memories, he could remember how Ling Ran sounded when he mentioned midline incision.
If he had done what Ling Ran said before, they would not have been in such trouble right now.
If he had chosen lateral incision, it would have been easier to reveal the wound now.
Department Director Kang scowled as he said to himself, ‘Is Lin Ran’s preoperative judgment that accurate?’
Even so, he refused to ask, and he could not ask. He worked without a sound and took the bone forceps before he hit the patient’s ribs.
*Swish*
The operating theater door was opened again.
Department Director Kang turned his head around and was ready to find an excuse to scold the person who came in. ‘Is this a market? Is it a place for people to come and watch whenever they want?’
Then Department Director Kang saw Huo Congjun’s wrinkled old face.
“Oh, Department Director Huo. We have a rare visitor.” Department Director Kang immediately smiled to the point that his face was full of wrinkles.
Huo Congjun smiled. “I just happened to be on the surgical floor and thought I’d stop by to take a look. Associate Hospital Director Zhou’s come along too.”

“Oh, Associate Hospital Director Zhou...” Department Director Kang repeated his name a few times. As a department director from a small department, he usually only had a few opportunities to see the hospital’s senior management.
Associate Hospital Director Zhou smiled modestly and said, “Department Director Kang, you must have had a long day. Is today’s surgery going well?”
It was a common question, but it struck Department Director Kang right where it hurt.
Department Director Kang could not help but freeze.

Of course, the standard answer was to say it was going smoothly. However, it would be a little embarrassing to say that the surgery was smooth while Ling Ran watched and the patient was still bleeding.

Well, if he said that it was not going well, it would not fit into the normal dialogue shared between leaders, and if he had to say that the surgery was not going smoothly for such a minor cardiac trauma repair surgery, it would not seem unacceptable as well.
Department Director Kang could not help but think things through.
Associate Hospital Director Zhou noticed that something was off, but he asked, “What’s today’s surgery?”
“Um... It’s a cardiac trauma repair,” Department Director Kang answered.

“Is it an emergency surgery? You can go ahead and ignore us.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou asked even though he knew the answer. He went there to keep track of Ling Ran’s situation. He did not care about how the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery was doing.

Department Director Kang answered with a smile. He took another deep breath, returned to his position as the chief surgeon, and looked at his patient’s opened chest. He appeared to be in a slight daze.
‘Now, do I continue with the exploration? Would it be kind of humiliating?’

The Department of Cardiovascular Surgery had embarrassed itself in Yun Hua Hospital multiple times, and it was precisely because of this that Department Director Kang did not want to continue embarrassing himself.

“Let’s continue.” Department Director Kang did not show any emotion on his face. He had saved hundreds of people. Regardless of whether he would end up saving another patient or sending one away, his personality meant that he would still be determined to continue the surgery.
While the patient did not sustain injuries in a good spot, Department Director Kang was confident that he could find it. There was just the possibility that he would spend a lot of time doing so.
*Glug glug*
The big autologous blood transfusion bottle was the only thing that made a sound in the operating theater.

Associate Hospital Director Zhou was standing by the side with a smile on his face. He was waiting for Department Director Kang to complete the surgery, then he would praise him. However, he waited and waited...
Department Director Kang was still busy with the patient’s chest. The sweat on his forehead gradually accumulated.

“Isn’t this cardiac trauma repair?” Associate Hospital Director Zhou was also quite knowledgeable. So, how could he not know that this was the simplest surgery for the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery?

Department Director Kang’s entire mind was occupied by lawsuits. He explained in a completely unembarrassed manner, “The position of the wound is not very good. The patient was stabbed in the chest by broken glass. Perhaps the broken glass has hit his ribs and stabbed his heart...”
“That’s indeed really complicated.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou laughed as he thought. ‘Has Old Kang’s skills regress?’
However, Huo Congjun was no longer able to hold back. He went along the flow of the conversation and said, “Ling Ran, lend Department Director Kang a hand since you’re already here.”
“Lending a hand” was a broad concept, but in conclusion, it just showed irresponsibility.

Department Director Kang hesitated for a moment and did not resist anymore. By then, he wanted to end the situation before him more than anyone else. In his present form, he was like the national soccer team playing soccer. Forget about winning the game, as long as he made it to the next match, he would have already been considered a winner!
Ling Ran waited for a few seconds. When he saw that Department Director Kang was silent, he nodded and said, “I can block the bleeding point with my finger first, then expand the opening...”
He spoke as he stretched out his right hand boldly to the side where the vertical long axis of the heart was.
“I’m done.” Ling Ran stood straight as he indicated that the bleeding had stopped.
A few people turned their heads to look at the monitor.
“The bleeding has stopped,” the anesthetist reported. He felt a little faint.
“Noted,” Department Director Kang whispered as if something was stuck in his throat.

chapters.title: Chapter 967: Where Should We Go?
paragraphs: At the center of the surgical floor in Yun Hua Hospital, the door of the Class 100 Laminar Flow Operating Room was labeled with blue characters that spelled “extra sterile”. The room was spacious and bright...

A cute-looking scrub nurse lowered her head while she organized the instruments, the anesthetist lowered his head, organizing the... files in the computer, and He Liang lowered his head with a nervous expression... managing the patient’s thoracic cavity.
Department Director Kang raised his head and was as proud as an old lion that had been chased out from his pride.
His lionesses were slowly leaving him.

Department Director Kang did not care about the attitude of the lionesses. He looked at Ling Ran with a complicated expression. There were a lot of emotions mixed together on his face, and even he could not tell just what kind of emotions he felt.
Was he angry? A bit.
Was he surprised? A lot.
There was also regret, jealousy, admiration, repentance, reflection...
If not for the fact that Department Director Kang still had some sense left in him, he would have thrown the forceps in his hands and let Ling Ran suture the wound.

If he did that, he might create some problems for Ling Ran because Ling Ran was pressing on the patient’s wound with one of his hands. It would be a little difficult for him to only use one hand to expose the surgery field.
Even if He Liang and Huo Congjun were there to help, due to the level of their skills, they would have to be busy for a while as well.
Nonetheless, Department Director Kang knew that it would only take a while.
Furthermore, the result would be something he could not accept.

Should he let Associate Hospital Director Zhou, one of the members of the hospital’s top management, get a chance to observe Ling Ran perform a cardiovascular surgery independently? Whether the surgery was difficult or not, once the chief surgeon performed cardiovascular surgery, he was already considered qualified.
Besides, today’s surgery was not that difficult.

Cardiac trauma repair was like an appendectomy in cardiovascular surgery, but what was the death rate for appendectomies? A person may find it hard to find a death even if they looked at every single case, and they would only be able to find one among a thousand cases or one among ten thousand cases. However, it was normal for the survival rate of cardiography to be at around 86% to 94%.
There were patients who injured their inferior vena cava as well as their back, and they eventually died on the operating table.
If Ling Ran did not help, even Department Director Kang could not guarantee whether the patient today would leave the operating theater alive.
Twenty years ago, he could still be more confident. Although his confidence level had increased a lot, now...
“Scalpel.” Department Director Kang extended his hand as if he was not aware of the awkward atmosphere. He started to enlarge the incision on the patient to provide larger exposure.
Ling Ran’s hand was still pressed on the patient’s heart, and Department Director Kang pretended that he did not know.
After all, he was determined to practice the principle of look not, ask not, and speak not.
He Liang continued to work as Department Director Kang’s assistant.
Usually, he would say something that annoyed others, but he dared not do so today.
Department Director Kang was not considered a very fierce surgeon when he scolded people in comparison to other surgeons, but his nagging was still really annoying.
The person who was most suited to be scolded by Department Director Kang was He Liang. Therefore, he was the most careful one.
Everyone had something on their minds, but no one was willing to speak. The operating theater slowly became silent.
Be that as it may, the speed of the surgery increased, and the accuracy improved as well.
Ling Ran smiled in satisfaction. Indeed, as long as everyone did their job and did not chat too excitedly, efficiency could be increased, and there would be an upgrade in their abilities too.
“He Liang, you’ll do the suturing.” When Ling Ran saw that the incision had been enlarged and that the exposure was pretty much perfect, he automatically gave up his chance to suture the wound.

Huo Congjun, who was ready to provide backup to Ling Ran at any moment, could not help but smile in relief. He was still thinking about what to do if Ling Ran made Department Director Kang feel embarrassed.

Certainly, they should still treat the patient as they were supposed to according to the steps, but Huo Congjun had to prepare for an attack and save up some saliva so that he could make Department Director Kang obey them willingly nonetheless.
However, Huo Congjun never thought that Ling Ran would willingly let He Liang suture the cardiac rupture.

He did not hand the chance over to Department Director Kang. After all, Department Director Kang was the chief surgeon, and he would definitely not be satisfied if he was instructed by Ling Ran. Although Ling Ran was from the Emergency Department, if he insisted on suturing the patient, in pleasant terms, that meant that he did not respect the department director. In unpleasant terms, that meant he was not respectful of others.
He Liang was truly the most suitable choice. He was young, capable, and someone who could be scolded...
Huo Congjun nodded slightly. Since Ling Ran appointed He Liang, it meant that he had grown.
He Liang had no other option. He looked at Department Director Kang subconsciously and soon realized he had made a mistake.
Department Director Kang only stared at him coldly without saying anything.

Coincidentally, He Liang could only perform suturing. His department director may have been useless, but Huo Congjun and Associate Department Director Zhou were not. They did not need to say anything else. They could just look for an excuse and send him to help the poor, which could easily make him lose 33.1 pounds of weight.
He Liang lowered his head again like an assistant dog. He asked tamely for the thread and needle, speaking in a low voice, “I haven’t sutured this spot before.”
“Insert the needle from the position of my finger.” Ling Ran started to teach him without any hesitation.
“Alright.” That was the only reply He Liang dared to give. He was just like an intern, and he held the needle with a trembling hand.
“Wait for a while... Hold your hand more steadily.” Ling Ran could tell He Liang’s condition and reminded him emotionlessly.
Ling Ran was truly experienced when it came to teaching others in performing surgery or spoon-feeding others during surgery.
He had performed many freelance surgeries within the Changxi Province, and finishing the surgery was not his goal every time.

Patients who invited freelance surgeons over usually aimed to get better treatment. However, it was different in different hospitals with different doctors. Many doctors invited freelance surgeons over to learn. For example, the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City invited freelance surgeons so that they could learn hepatectomy and be independent when they performed the surgery later on.

Such an act was just like asking the supplier to provide the production skills after purchasing the products. It was normal in Chinese companies, and as long as the price was reasonable, they would help the buyers achieve their goal.
Ling Ran usually did not mind teaching his skills to other doctors.
In fact, with the series of freelance surgeries he had performed, Ling Ran even gained a lot of experience in teaching.

When dealing with doctors like He Liang who had some skills but no confidence, Ling Ran would explain in detail, “Normally, you can use a simple interrupted stitch or horizontal mattress suture on all layers of the muscle for a cardiac rupture like this. Just use whichever you’re more competent with. But for this position, to avoid affecting the blood supply, you can suture on both sides of the rupture and use intersecting traction to stop the bleeding temporarily...”
He Liang quietly listened without a word. Ling Ran only mentioned the suturing technique for normal cardiac trauma. He was quite familiar with the technique as well.
But as Ling Ran explained things, He Liang slowly calmed down.
‘That’s right. I’m just suturing for a cardiac trauma in a bad position. Who would’ve sutured every location, right? It’s the same as other surgeons executing the same plan in a different position.’
When He Liang thought about that, his hand stopped trembling while he held the needle.
Ling Ran helped him pull the thread, and within a short time, the patient’s cardiac rupture was sutured.
Both of them cooperated well, as though they had cooperated for many years.
He Liang sensed kindness. He felt more comfortable working together with Ling Ran than Department Director Kang, whom he was more familiar with.
At that moment, he could not help but look at Department Director Kang for a while.
Department Director Kang still lowered his head like an old lion that refused to take defeat lying down. He would wait for Ling Ran to leave before he regained his power.
“Wash it, then perform sternal closure.” Yet, Ling Ran did not want to leave.
What a joke. There was no way he would run after performing bleeding control. He took a lot of effort to get there.
Ling Ran did not mind the effort in performing the surgery, though, and told He Liang to rinse the pericardial cavity and perform drainage tubing as well as multi-layer sternal closure.
Department Director Kang was stunned. He could only raise his hands in front of him and observe from the side without feeling humiliated.
It was fortunate that he did not need to wait for a long time. The sternal closure was faster than usual because of Ling Ran.
Even so, the length of time for the sternal closure was long enough that Department Director Kang was able to observe Ling Ran’s operation carefully.
It was simple, straightforward, and careful.
Ling Ran’s operation was just like a standard answer that made anyone who saw it enlightened, but at the same time, frown and fall into deep thought.
Department Director Kang raised his head slightly, and countless thoughts flashed through in his mind.
‘How can he be so powerful?
‘If he’s so powerful, what should I do?
‘Which direction should the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery progress to if that’s the case?’

chapters.title: Chapter 968: Show Your skills
paragraphs: “The surgery’s complete.” Ling Ran cut the last thread and threw away the scissors.
A round of applause naturally rose in the operating theater.
Ling Ran smiled faintly and treated it as a normal surgical procedure.
Department Director Kang also clapped with a dark expression on his face. If he did not clap when everyone was clapping, he would be described as arrogant.
However, Department Director Kang’s reluctance was not very strong as well.

He was a doctor and a surgeon. Although he was prejudiced when he observed Ling Ran’s operation with his own judgment, he could still feel a pleasant sensation run up his spine while he watched it. This was just like how a mechanic would feel when he saw the logistics group at an F1 racetrack changing tires, refilling petrol, and servicing the race car at high speed.
The characteristics of their maneuvers were the same, but Ling Ran’s were better, causing Department Director Kang to feel happy when he looked at Ling Ran’s operation.
He clapped twice, and that was it.
He Liang clapped for even longer.
He had practically performed half of the surgery with Department Director Kang and the other half with Ling Ran. There was no need for him to even mention which doctor had allowed him to feel better.
Even if He Liang was treated as a bootlicker, he would still do the things he did.
He could tell that Department Director Kang could hardly catch up with Ling Ran’s skills. Perhaps the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery’s destiny now lay in Ling Ran’s hands.
Huo Congjun suddenly had a feeling in his heart when he heard the applause.
Unlike Ling Ran, who had grown up listening to applause, Huo Congjun did not find that applause could be easily obtained.
When he thought carefully, there were at least four reasons why Ling Ran received the applause.
First, his skills were really good. Second, he had a strong background. Thirdly, he was not annoying, and fourthly, he was handsome.
It was not easy to have all those four attributes together.
Huo Congjun felt that he should not let the applause go to waste.
“Department Director Kang, do you have other surgeries after this?” Huo Congjun suddenly asked.
Department Director Kang frowned. ‘As the saying goes, do not reveal others’ shortcomings when you’re attacking them. Old Huo, isn’t your ego a little too big now?’

“No, do you have any advice for me, Department Director Huo?” Department Director Kang did not speak in a good tone. It was true that he was only the department director of a small department, but he was still a department director, right? Furthermore, he was not just somebody who came from outside with no support. He would not be like He Yuanzheng, who allowed himself to be bullied by Huo Congjun.
Huo Congjun smiled gently. “What I mean is, since it’s not easy for us to gather together, why don’t we have a meal together? Associate Hospital Director Zhou, what do you say?”
“Okay.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou did not know what Huo Congjun was up to, but he agreed.
Department Director Kang was stunned and felt a little embarrassed. He hesitated for a few seconds before he laughed. “Let’s have a meal together, then.”
Even if it was a banquet full of traps, it was still a banquet.
At that moment, Department Director Kang felt respected.

“In that case, I’ll book a hotel. Let’s fix it at Prosperous Fountain Restaurant.” Department Director Huo took out his phone and called them. “Xiao Fei, you recently ordered those extra-large Australian spiny lobsters, right? Yes, give me three lobsters... The weight shouldn’t be less than 6.6 pounds...” he shouted.
Department Director Kang’s expression became friendlier as he listened to Huo Congjun speak through the phone.
Even though he was sure that Huo Congjun would not be the one treating him, a 6.6-pound Australian spiny lobster was enough to show his sincerity.
Huo Congjun did indeed want to show his respect and sincerity.

He had already thought things through by then. He could not be too crude if he wanted to form a connection with the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery. Besides, Department Director Kang was not as weak as He Yuanzheng. Also, despite Ling Ran’s good skills, he was still alone, and the difficulty level of cardiac surgery was high...

Yun Hua Hospital’s Department of Cardiovascular Surgery may have seemed weak, but it was always convenient to have friends to help. There were still doctors like Zhang Anmin who could help Ling Ran in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. Yet, the situation was still unknown when it came to the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery.
Huo Congjun felt that they could still talk about it.
The group left the operating theater together in tacit agreement, and Ling Ran was summoned by Huo Congjun.
“If you want to continue to perform cardiac surgery, let’s go and have a meal.” Huo Congjun’s words made Ling Ran stay.
“An hour?” Ling Ran was not opposed to having a meal, but he was pretty stringent with time.
“Two to three hours, maybe? There are three Australian spiny lobsters. We shouldn’t waste it.” Huo Congjun chuckled.
Ling Ran thought about it and agreed.
Huo Congjun was excited and made two more calls to settle departmental matters before he called for a car.
When Department Director Kang saw the situation, he did not delay matters. In a show of shrewdness, he managed his own departmental matters through the phone.
At the same time, a new system mission popped up in front of Ling Ran.
[Mission: Show Your Skills]

[Mission Details: You can also show your skills outside the operating theater. Make Kang Jian and He Liang provide you with Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chests by using your skills outside the operating theater. Then, from this, you can obtain more surgeries along with more freedom to choose your surgeries.]
[Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]

Ling Ran carefully read through the mission details twice and immediately came up with a suitable scenario in his mind. ‘Kang Jian and He Liang will both suffer cardiac arrests at the dining table... Hmm, it’s not suitable for both of them to have cardiac arrests together. Their cardiac arrests should happen concurrently, and I would save both of their lives through my skills with CPR...’

If he had to simulate the scenario in greater detail, then He Liang would suffer a cardiac arrest first, and Department Director Kang would perform CPR for He Liang. The burden on his heart would then be too great, resulting in him having a cardiac arrest as well...

When Ling Ran thought about that, he kept shaking his head and felt like he should not be thinking in such a manner. If a young person like He Liang suddenly suffered a cardiac arrest next to him, he could still save him without Department Director Kang’s help. If he did not make it, He Liang would not have the chance to give him a Peer’s Admiration Basic Treasure Chest...
What if only one of them had a cardiac arrest?
It would be difficult for him to obtain a Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chest through CPR alone.
What about prolonged CPR?
...No, there was nothing worth admiring when a person suffered through a cardiac arrest with a group of doctors around and was eventually resuscitated through prolonged CPR.
For the same reason, skills such as tracheal intubation would not get him any admiration too.
Hepatectomy and the Achilles tendon repair technique would not be suitable to be performed outside the operating theater either...
“What are you thinking?” After Huo Congjun finished his call, he called out for Ling Ran again. He was worried that if he was careless, Ling Ran would slip away into the operating theater.
Ling Ran certainly could not reveal anything about the system, and he only said, “I was thinking about bringing Zuo Cidian and Lu Wenbin.”
Both of them were members of the CPR group. If the scenario Ling Ran thought about really happened, it would be more convenient with help from both of them.

Huo Congjun became even happier when he saw Ling Ran’s expression. “Of course. That’s the correct train of thought for you to have. Old Zuo has a glib tongue, and Lu Wenbin can talk to Doctor He. It’s also appropriate for him to serve others.”
Out of the three people on his side, Ling Ran was the youngest, but he did not know about the unspoken rules of a feast. So, it would be better if he brought two other people to make up some numbers.
Ling Ran did not want to correct Huo Congjun because he just wanted to achieve his goal. It would be too difficult to correct other people’s opinions.

If he were to ask others to change, others would want to change his opinion as well. If that were the case, Ling Ran would not have been bothered by how he had to destroy the love letters he received when he was studying.
“I’ll ask them to get ready at Prosperous Fountain Restaurant.” Ling Ran sent a WeChat message and gave Zuo Cidian a special reminder.
[When you come over, please remember to bring my tracheotomy pack.]

If the scenario Ling Ran thought about really happened, it would be more convenient with help from both of them.
Huo Congjun became even happier when he saw Ling Ran’s expression.
“Of course.
That’s the correct train of thought for you to have.
Old Zuo has a glib tongue, and Lu Wenbin can talk to Doctor He.
It’s also appropriate for him to serve others.”
Out of the three people on his side, Ling Ran was the youngest, but he did not know about the unspoken rules of a feast.
So, it would be better if he brought two other people to make up some numbers.
Ling Ran did not want to correct Huo Congjun because he just wanted to achieve his goal.
It would be too difficult to correct other people’s opinions.
If he were to ask others to change, others would want to change his opinion as well.
If that were the case, Ling Ran would not have been bothered by how he had to destroy the love letters he received when he was studying.
“I’ll ask them to get ready at Prosperous Fountain Restaurant.” Ling Ran sent a WeChat message and gave Zuo Cidian a special reminder.
[When you come over, please remember to bring my tracheotomy pack.]

chapters.title: Chapter 969: Skill
paragraphs: “Come, try some Australian spiny lobster. Everyone, please help yourself.” Huo Congjun was calling for the group to eat, and even his fierce expression became gentle. “Young He, don’t be shy. You’re still young and have a good appetite, so please, eat more... Come, let’s have a toast!”

He Liang immediately lifted his glass, leaned across the table, and knocked it against Huo Congjun’s glass. Then, he drank it in one gulp before he took a big piece of lobster meat from the plate held by the young and beautiful waitress who kept sneaking glances at Ling Ran, and he stuffed it in his mouth.
When the spiciness from the Baijiu matched the aroma of the Australian spiny lobster, He Liang felt the guilty pleasure of eating such an expensive item bloom on his taste buds.

When He Liang looked at tens of waiters around him, the private room that was large enough for a basketball game, the delicacies that were served, and the old guests who had wrinkles, he was even more fascinated.
Before he decided to join the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery, this was how He Liang had imagined a doctor’s life to be, or at least, this was how an attending physician’s life should be.
But after he joined the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery, He Liang realized that everything shown on the TV was a lie.
There was no laughing and talking among the experts, no formation of a large network of connections, no eating of food made meticulously...
He was a normal cardiologist facing normal patients, had endless calls, and could never finish the food he ordered through delivery...

The first time He Liang saw a hot Australian spiny lobster was two years ago, when he was a fresh-faced resident doctor. At that time, he already knew that a small department like the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery would not be able to afford Australian spiny lobsters, and he would only be able to eat scalloped spiny lobsters during Chinese New Year.

Of course, in the past, the Emergency Department could only afford scalloped spiny lobsters. Even when the department had expanded, the doctors were still not rich, could not eat well, and they still had to share if they had food. If they wanted to eat Australian spiny lobsters, the doctors should probably join the Department of Cardiovascular Medicine or Ophthalmology Department...

“Young He, what are you thinking about? You’re so absorbed with your thoughts. Do you want to perform surgery? Is it too boring to have meals with old people like us?” Huo Congjun tried to interact with He Liang again. Compared to the other person, Department Director Kang, who was his other target to form connections with, He Liang was obviously a more suitable option for him to break the wall between him and the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery.
He Liang immediately shook his head. “No, how would I? I’m just not good at talking...”

“I can tell. Those who are good at talking will definitely be talking now. You’re not old yet. You’re still young and energetic, and you don’t have prostatic hyperplasia yet... Hahaha...” Huo Congjun laughed loudly and held his glass, which was filled with Baijiu. “Come, let’s drink...”
The atmosphere at the banquet was really good, and even Associate Hospital Director Zhou lifted his glass and took a sip.
Every doctor had a need to make themselves numb to their surroundings, and seldom were there any exceptions.
Ling Ran also lifted his glass, but his glass was filled with another beverage. He was usually an exception, and nothing was surprising about it.
Ling Ran sipped his beverage but put his focus on Department Director Kang and He Liang.

The system mission had explained things very clearly. He had to show his skill outside the operating theater and make Kang Jian and He Liang give him Peer’s Admiration Basic Treasure Chests. Then, it was practically set in stone that he had to save these two people outside the operating theater.
Ling Ran observed these two men carefully and was ready to carry out visual inspection anytime to avoid missing even the slightest symptoms hinting that they might be sick.

Department Director Kang and He Liang were doctors from the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery. In order to get their admiration, it would definitely be easier if he used a cardiac surgery technique to save them. However, the requirements would be stricter if he were to use a cardiac surgery technique outside the operating theater. He needed to capture every single moment and used all the abilities he had.

When he thought about this carefully, the operating theaters used by the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery were the most high class Class 100 Laminar Flow Operating Theater, and even so, they still cannot avoid some patients dying from infection. Therefore, it was even more dangerous to perform a surgery in the private room of a hotel. This was unlike the early eighteenth century, where doctors could use a scalpel however he wanted, killing multiple people in a go, and continue performing surgery in the afternoon...

Ling Ran had made up his mind. Regardless of whether it was Department Director Kang or He Liang who collapsed first, he would prioritize saving them. As long as the patient could last through emergency treatment, he would then send them to Yun Hua Hospital before he operated on them.
He could take up another mission if he failed this one, but if a patient died, that was the end of the patient’s life.
The people drank three rounds... four rounds... five rounds...
Department Director Kang and He Liang had still not collapsed.
Ling Ran gradually felt that it was impossible for him to complete the mission by today.

But that was only logical. The mission did not mention that the task needed to be completed by today. However, if he did not complete the task by today, he would need to spend the next few days at the hospital. If Department Director Kang and He Liang collapsed, even if they did not want to enter the operating theater, they would still have to be pushed inside.
Ling Ran could not help but think about it.
There did not seem to be any loopholes he could exploit in the mission.
*Bang*
A loud crunch could be heard from Department Director Kang’s direction.
Ling Ran immediately looked at him, and he saw... the lobster shells in front of Department Director Kang had dropped on the floor.
“I’m old, you see?” Department Director Kang shook his head, and his face was slightly flushed.
Ling Ran observed him carefully for half a minute, and when he became certain that Department Director Kang only had a red face and was not suffering from thrombosis, and he looked away.

At that moment, He Liang—mildly drunk—proposed a toast. He lifted his glass and came in front of Ling Ran before he said, “Doctor Ling, a toast to you. I’ll be drinking it, and you can do whatever you like.”
Once he finished talking, he drank everything in one shot, and he asked with a slur, “Doctor Ling, you... How d’you bracdiceee?”
Ling Ran could not help but think before he said slowly, “I have less time to practice now.”

“Dat’s true. You need’ta perform surgery everyday, so iz only natural that yer skills are trained from dere.” He Liang was quite obsessed with surgery volume as well. For doctors who were attending physicians, surgery volume not only meant training, but also their income and status.
The number of cardiovascular surgeries was reducing, and this was the part that displeased He Liang and the other young doctors the most.
Ling Ran smiled. His skills were not merely trained by performing surgeries, but he knew that this was not the right time for him to explain things.
“D’you know how we usually bracdiceee?” He Liang asked. The alcohol in the Baijiu had already made his mind clouded.
“How do you practice?” Ling Ran was really curious.
“We use eggssss.” He Liang said and shouted at the waiter, “Get me an egg.”
“Is it okay to use the eggs for eggnog?” The head waiter asked politely.

“Suuure,” He Liang said and took out an osteotome before he said, “The game dat we always play is carving words on the egg using an osdeodome. S’long as the egg doesn’t break, we win. Doctor Ling, you wanna try?”
He Liang looked excited when he said this.
Opportunities need to be sought. With He Liang’s status and experience, he would not show his skills in front of people such as Associate Hospital Director Zhou or Huo Congjun.

Besides, the Department of Cardiovascular Surgeries of Yun Hua Hospital was so weak that their existence could be ignored. Even if their existence was recognized, they needed to perform high-end surgeries to be able to invite the hospital leaders to come over and watch them.

And at the current Department of Cardiovascular Surgeries, the department director was the first to choose the normal surgeries, and the high-end surgeries also solely belonged to the department director, thus, He Liang would have no chance to show his skills.
However, He Liang had the chance to show his skills right now.
After one to two minutes, the head waiter brought the eggs over. He Liang immediately took one, placed it in front of him, and said, “Doctor Ling, lemme give youu a demonztrazioon.”
As he spoke, he held the osteotome and cut into the raw egg.
The incision was quite deep, so much so that the outer layer was crushed, but the egg white and egg yolk did not flow out.

He Liang gulped and pretended like he was relaxed. He said slowly, “Even though the outer layer of the egg shell iz removed, the internal membrane iz well preserved. If dere iz time, you can even carve words on the shell!”

chapters.title: Chapter 970: Engraving
paragraphs: He Liang took the advantage of being partially drunk to deshell the egg boldly.
The basis of becoming a successful surgeon was to be bold but cautious.
A cowardly surgeon would not be successful. At most, he could only become a doctor in the General Surgery Department, and he would be a truly normal surgeon in all sense of the phrase.
Meanwhile, if he wanted to become a cardiologist, being bold was essential, regardless of how skilful he was.

The surgeon would have to push the needle through a beating heart and suture it in a surgery like cardiac trauma repair. Without courage and without the guts to take on a responsibility, the surgeon would not be satisfied even if he was able to perform a surgery like this.
There was no need to even mention the need for them to be attentive and observant.
Even if He Liang drank some alcohol, his hand still held the egg steadily.

He put one end of the egg in a champagne glass. Then, he held it gently with his left hand, steadied the egg, and held the osteotome with his right. Then, he cut the surface of the egg with a strength that was neither too light nor too heavy.
As the line became clearer, the egg shell gradually became loose, and it started to shake.
Associate Hospital Director Zhou held a glass of wine like the king enjoying watching his subjects performing a sword dance. Then, he chuckled and said to Huo Congjun, “It looks good.”
“Quite interesting.” Huo Congjun nodded as well.
Department Director Kang smiled faintly and said, “We always do something similar in the department.”

“Like the simulation training space of the Hand Surgery Department?” The first thing that came to the Associate Hospital Director Zhou’s mind was the mouse room in the Hand Surgery Department that cost millions of RMB.

Department Director Kang picked up the champagne glass and took a sip. Then, he smiled and said, “We can’t afford a simulation training area like the Hand Surgery Department. It’s already good enough that we can have an egg to practice.”
Huo Congjun was slightly drunk. When he heard this, he subconsciously smiled and asked, “Do you want a simulation training space?”

If it were another department director asking, Department Director Kang would answer with laughter, because he knew other department directors could not affect the probability of the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery getting a simulation training space.
However, Department Director Kang knew that Huo Congjun just built an 8-bed ICU in the Emergency Medical Center.
That was way more expensive than a simulation training space.

“Aren’t you paying too much attention to the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery, Department Director Huo?” Department Director Kang picked up a piece of lobster. It looked as if it was sparkling slightly under the light, just like a big, irregularly shaped pearl.
“Shouldn’t the departments care about each other?” Huo Congjun spewed nonsense in front of him.
“If the Emergency Department really cares about us, you should send more patients with cardiovascular diseases over,” the drunk Department Director Kang complained.

At Huo Congjun’s position, his impact on the emergency system was not as simple as the repositioning of patients. For example, when Ling Ran performed Achilles tendon repair, he could get many patients with ruptured Achilles tendons for him. Therefore, sometimes, the patient needed by the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery might be passed to other hospitals by Huo Congjun.
Department Director Kang was not very certain whether this was the case, but he had truly wondered about it before.
Department Director Huo laughed and answered in a hostile manner, “It’s easy to pass the patients to you, but you should be able to treat them.”

“We can’t improve in just one or two days,” Department Director Kang answered casually. He pointed at He Liang and said, “He Liang might be peeling off the egg shell easily right now, but he spent months practicing this motion alone.”
Huo Congjun looked at He Liang before he smiled at Department Director Kang. ‘He’s not exactly doing it easily, you know?”
Department Director Kang was stunned. ‘Did you not get the point of what I’m saying?’
As He Liang was peeling off the egg shell, he also listened to the conversation among two of them. When he heard Department Director Huo saying that he was not doing it easily, he became very mad.
‘How could he say something like this?!
‘Although I’m really not doing it easily, shouldn’t he be encouraging me at this time?’
“Doctor Zuo, Doctor Lu, do you want to try?” Department Director Kang asked Zuo Cidian and Lu Wenbin, who sat quietly across him.
“I’ll pass.” Zuo Cidian knew about himself very well, so he would never stand out when it was the time for them to show off their skills.
Lu Wenbin showed a smile as well and said, “I haven’t played this before, so I’m not joining.”
“It’s not difficult, just try and see.” Department Director Kang showed a faint smile, and he took a glance at Huo Congjun.

Huo Congjun schooled his face. “When the Emergency Medical Center performs surgeries, we like to operate on the patients boldly, and we don’t like doing things meticulously. Even Ling Ran didn’t practice this way in the past. He performs an average of at least three surgeries a day, and he always needs to perform more than six surgeries every day, so he can be said to have a specialization in the industry...”

The main reason behind why Huo Congjun gave this explanation was because he wanted to give Ling Ran a way out so that he would not be checkmated by the doctors from the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery.

Honestly, this “peeling off the egg shell” thing was a way for the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery or Neurosurgery Department to show off. They usually needed five to ten years’ time to train up a qualified, so it was also pretty normal for them to occasionally look down on the General Surgery Department and Emergency Department.
However, Kang Jian’s Department of Cardiovascular Surgery was so weak that Huo Congjun was not willing to be looked down upon, and he believed that Ling Ran also had the same thought with him.

“I’m done peeling it.” He Liang carefully put the egg into the champagne glass, put the glass at the center of the turnplate, pushed it slightly, and made it turn until it was in front of Associate Hospital Director Zhou.

Only a quarter of the egg shell was left on the egg, and half of that quarter remained on top of the egg. The rest of the egg was supported by the egg membrane, and the liquid from the egg white and yolk could be seen clearly.
“Nice. You’ve done it really well.”
Associate Hospital Director Zhou took the lead and applauded He Liang.
The waiters around the table also looked at He Liang differently, and this made his face blush.
“Doctor Ling, try it.” He Liang passed the osteotome.
When he made the suggestion, his idea was to compete with Ling Ran.

He could talk about it in great length if he won against a doctor like Ling Ran in a competition, but even if he lost, it was nothing to him. After all, if they both could compete on the spot, it was the best advertisement for He Liang.
For a junior attending physician from a small department like him, being able to enter the sight of the hospital management with this was not bad.
Ling Ran naturally took the osteome over.
A waiter who had been staring at him immediately handed over a big egg that was specially chosen.
He Liang was stunned. ‘This egg is double the size of my egg, can this be considered cheating?’
He Liang did not feel that it was right for him to say anything, as it was not an open competition...
Naturally, He Liang’s mood was not very good. He lifted his glass again, stood up, and said, “Associate Hospital Director Zhou, I propose a toast to you again...”
Associate Hospital Director Zhou smiled and nodded. Hee took a sip and asked, “Ling Ran, are you carving a word? What are you engraving?”
“Yes, engraving feels more fun,” Ling Ran answered.

As He Liang listened to this, he spilled his alcohol. He quickly turned around, and he saw Ling Ran holding an egg with a hand while he brandished the osteotome on the egg as if he was spinning a pen.
The egg was so stable like it was stuck on Ling Ran’s hand, but the egg shell was weak, like the friendship between the colleagues in the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery...
He Liang was completely stunned as he watched.
“Doctor Ling, you’re engraving really quickly.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou smiled and said so that there were no awkward silences during the time.
Department Director Kang and He Liang hummed softly in agreement.
“What letters have you engraved?” Associate Hospital Director Zhou asked out of his curiosity.
“Look.” As Ling Ran spoke, he lifted the osteotome, and a piece of the egg shell fell off. The remaining egg shell showed a small line of beautiful text.

Zuo Cidian immediately walked forward. He did a half squat and raised his head to read it out loud. “When a great physician treats diseases, he has to be mentally calm and resolved. He should not give way to wishes and desires, but has to first develop a heart filled with kindness and compassion. He should commit himself firmly to a willingness to take the effort to save every living creature out of kindness.”
