“I’ll pass.” Zuo Cidian knew about himself very well, so he would never stand out when it was the time for them to show off their skills.
Lu Wenbin showed a smile as well and said, “I haven’t played this before, so I’m not joining.”
“It’s not difficult, just try and see.” Department Director Kang showed a faint smile, and he took a glance at Huo Congjun.
Huo Congjun schooled his face.
“When the Emergency Medical Center performs surgeries, we like to operate on the patients boldly, and we don’t like doing things meticulously.
Even Ling Ran didn’t practice this way in the past.
He performs an average of at least three surgeries a day, and he always needs to perform more than six surgeries every day, so he can be said to have a specialization in the industry...”

The main reason behind why Huo Congjun gave this explanation was because he wanted to give Ling Ran a way out so that he would not be checkmated by the doctors from the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery.
Honestly, this “peeling off the egg shell” thing was a way for the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery or Neurosurgery Department to show off.
They usually needed five to ten years’ time to train up a qualified, so it was also pretty normal for them to occasionally look down on the General Surgery Department and Emergency Department.
However, Kang Jian’s Department of Cardiovascular Surgery was so weak that Huo Congjun was not willing to be looked down upon, and he believed that Ling Ran also had the same thought with him.

“I’m done peeling it.” He Liang carefully put the egg into the champagne glass, put the glass at the center of the turnplate, pushed it slightly, and made it turn until it was in front of Associate Hospital Director Zhou.
Only a quarter of the egg shell was left on the egg, and half of that quarter remained on top of the egg.
The rest of the egg was supported by the egg membrane, and the liquid from the egg white and yolk could be seen clearly.
“Nice.
You’ve done it really well.”
Associate Hospital Director Zhou took the lead and applauded He Liang.
The waiters around the table also looked at He Liang differently, and this made his face blush.
“Doctor Ling, try it.” He Liang passed the osteotome.
When he made the suggestion, his idea was to compete with Ling Ran.
He could talk about it in great length if he won against a doctor like Ling Ran in a competition, but even if he lost, it was nothing to him.
After all, if they both could compete on the spot, it was the best advertisement for He Liang.
For a junior attending physician from a small department like him, being able to enter the sight of the hospital management with this was not bad.
Ling Ran naturally took the osteome over.
A waiter who had been staring at him immediately handed over a big egg that was specially chosen.
He Liang was stunned.
‘This egg is double the size of my egg, can this be considered cheating?’
He Liang did not feel that it was right for him to say anything, as it was not an open competition...
Naturally, He Liang’s mood was not very good.
He lifted his glass again, stood up, and said, “Associate Hospital Director Zhou, I propose a toast to you again...”
Associate Hospital Director Zhou smiled and nodded.
Hee took a sip and asked, “Ling Ran, are you carving a word?
What are you engraving?”
“Yes, engraving feels more fun,” Ling Ran answered.
As He Liang listened to this, he spilled his alcohol.
He quickly turned around, and he saw Ling Ran holding an egg with a hand while he brandished the osteotome on the egg as if he was spinning a pen.
The egg was so stable like it was stuck on Ling Ran’s hand, but the egg shell was weak, like the friendship between the colleagues in the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery...
He Liang was completely stunned as he watched.
“Doctor Ling, you’re engraving really quickly.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou smiled and said so that there were no awkward silences during the time.
Department Director Kang and He Liang hummed softly in agreement.
“What letters have you engraved?” Associate Hospital Director Zhou asked out of his curiosity.
“Look.” As Ling Ran spoke, he lifted the osteotome, and a piece of the egg shell fell off.
The remaining egg shell showed a small line of beautiful text.
Zuo Cidian immediately walked forward.
He did a half squat and raised his head to read it out loud.
“When a great physician treats diseases, he has to be mentally calm and resolved.
He should not give way to wishes and desires, but has to first develop a heart filled with kindness and compassion.
He should commit himself firmly to a willingness to take the effort to save every living creature out of kindness.”

chapters.title: Chapter 971: Taking Photos
paragraphs: “Let me take a picture.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou gasped in amazement and brought out her phone before she took a few pictures around the egg. She then started to edit her WeChat Moments. [Today, I witnessed Doctor Ling’s great skills. He took three minutes to engrave two sentences on a raw egg.]

After Associate Hospital Director Zhou finished taking pictures, it was Department Director Huo’s turn, followed by Zuo Cidian and Lu Wenbin. To avoid looking as if they were not conforming to the group, Department Director Kang and He Liang also followed them to take some pictures.

After the raw egg was placed aside, the waiters in the private room became excited. They continuously took pictures, videos, and selfies. They did not even bother listening to the instructions from their leader.
The pharmaceutical sales representative who came deliberately to pay for the meal was reluctant to let go of this egg. He even wanted to pack this egg with his phone and take it away.

“I knew that Doctor Ling could perform surgery very well, but I did not expect him to have put in so much effort behind the scenes.” Associate Hospital Director Zhou sighed a little. Engraving a raw egg was very difficult, and engraving it like Ling Ran did was extremely rare.
Ling Ran only smiled and said, “I did not do any special practice. I just performed many surgeries and got familiar with operating using a scalpel.”

Ling Ran did not improve in a profound manner when it came to basic operations like incisions. However, surgeries like hepatectomy would naturally improve his incision skills, so performing surgeries continuously also meant nonstop training.
Ling Ran did not give too much of a response toward everyone’s surprise.
The people around him had always been like that, and many of them made a fuss about him, which was why his facial expression did not change much.
He Liang, who had been observing him all this while, finally showed admiration to Ling Ran.
Before this, he could not help but dream of the moment he won against Ling Ran.
In his head, He Liang had imagined countless scenarios. Even if he knew it was impossible, he still imagined himself being admired. After all, imagining things was not an illegal act.
And in reality, He Liang had also thought of what he should say and do in front of Associate Hospital Director Zhou and Huo Congjun after his victory...
However, Ling Ran obviously did something to the shell of the raw egg that very few people could do. He Liang also did not expect him to react so calmly to it.
‘Perhaps it’s because Ling Ran usually has too many impressive achievements.’ When He Liang thought about things this way, he admired Ling Ran more.
At this time, Ling Ran looked at He Liang.
Because in his mind, a mission notification popped up.
[Mission: Show Your Skills (1/2)]

[Mission Details: You can also show your skills outside the operating theater. Make Kang Jian and He Liang provide you with Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chests by using your skills outside the operating theater. Then, from this, you can obtain more surgeries along with more freedom to choose your surgeries.]
[Mission Progress: He Liang (Completed)]
[Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]
At the same time, a Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chest also appeared in front of Ling Ran.
This was the treasure chest given by He Liang.
Therefore, Ling Ran understood that he had completed his part with He Liang, but Department Director Kang had still not given him any Peers’ Admiration.
Ling Ran subconsciously muttered to himself.
He had not expected He Liang’s Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chest to be obtained so easily. Neither did he expect Department Director Kang to remain completely unmoved.
In this case, completing the next task would be more troublesome. Perhaps he truly required Department Director Kang to suffer from myocardial infarction.
Ling Ran looked at Department Director Kang carefully. He had rosy cheeks as he drank wine, and he did not show any symptoms of him about to immediately suffer from myocardial infarction.

‘I’ll just let fate do its work.’ Ling Ran thought. Department Director Kang was not old enough. At his age, he only performed ten to twenty surgeries every week. Even if he did not eat quite healthily and drank quite a lot, it was still not easy for him to get a heart attack.

If he was dealing with department directors from departments like the General Surgery Department and Neurocranial Surgery Department, when the department directors were busy, they would not even be able to accept bribes like sexual bribery. When they were free to accept it, it was far too normal for them to get a heart attack or cerebral infarction instead.
Ling Ran then casually opened Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chest given by He Liang before he picked up another piece of lobster and slowly ate it.
Under the bright and familiar light, a thick book emerged from the blue light.
Ling Ran blinked. Then, he saw the thick book opening, and a sentence of words appeared.
[Regional Anatomical Dissection Experience: Ten Times Heart Anatomical Dissection Experience]
Ling Ran frowned, but what he thought in his head was, ‘Does the book have to be so thick for just ten heart anatomical dissection experiences? Is the system clear with the concept of thickness?’
The book floating in the air shuddered until Ling Ran waved his hand to put it away. Then, the blue light disappeared completely. Next, a few searching gazes were exposed in front of Ling Ran.
“Doctor Ling, is the light suitable?” The head waiter obviously noticed Ling Ran narrowing his eyes just now, so he immediately came forward and asked.

“It’s good, you don’t have to adjust it.” Ling Ran added the last phrase on purpose, because he knew that if he did not deliberately state it, the waiters would probably come up with the idea of adjusting the brightness with the thought that this would be better.

The head waiter should have understood what he said, so he smiled and nodded. However, he did not immediately leave. He just hesitated slightly and whispered, “Doctor Ling, our colleague filmed you engraving on the raw egg just now in a Tik Tok video, can we upload it?”
“Oh.” Ling Ran already saw the waiter who took the video just now when he was still engraving the egg, so when he heard the question, he politely answered, “You can upload it.”

Ling Ran had a lot of photos and videos on the internet about himself, but most of them did not ask for his opinion about whether they could upload his videos or photos. Now, when they asked about his opinion, Ling Ran did not even have any reason to reject it.
The head waiter immediately expressed his gratitude. Then, he stood at the back happily.

Department Director Kang smiled as he raised his glass and said, “Actually, there is another way to play with a raw egg. You open the egg shell, make an incision on the membrane, and suture it. If the liquid from the egg does not leak out when it is turned over, then it’s counted as a successful suture. But you will need a microscope for that...”
“I brought surgical magnifying glasses over,” Ling Ran quickly answered and waved his hand. Then, Zuo Cidian gave him his surgical magnifying glasses.
Department Director Kang was stunned. “Why would you bring along surgical magnifying glasses when you come out?”

“To avoid encountering patients with ruptured Achilles tendons or severed fingers. It’s very inconvenient without the corresponding instruments.” After Ling Ran answered, he cast a meaningful glance at Department Director Kang.
Department Director Kang felt chills run down his spine because of Ling Ran’s stare, so he laughed subconsciously. “Doctor Ling, you’re pretty amusing.”

“Doctor Ling really said that when he asked us to bring the instruments over.” Zuo Cidian coughed and said, “I think I still need to clarify certain things, or else everyone will think that Doctor Ling brings along these instruments everyday.”
“True.” Department Director Kang laughed out loudly and said, “Many people think doctors will bring along the instruments when they go out, but how is this possible, right?”

“I will still bring along the tracheotomy pack.” Ling Ran corrected Department Director Kang. Then, he put on the surgical magnifying glasses, picked up the scalpel, positioned the egg until he was sure it was stable, and knocked it gently.
A number of phones were positioned from all directions at that moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 972: Ferocious
paragraphs: For Ling Ran, suturing the egg membrane was actually a simpler task.
In other words, it was easy for someone who was able to do it, but it was not for those who did not.

Engraving on an egg was like copying a text. Instead of the basic part, the difficulty increased along the increased number of words. For a normal attending physician like He Liang, when he was lucky, he could engrave one or two big words on the egg, but the reason he could not engrave more words was because he had a certain probability of error. If he made a mistake, he would fail completely. Therefore, forcefully engraving one or two words was already his limit.

However, suturing the egg membrane did not require that much attention to detail. This was like solving a math problem. If he did not know how to do it, he would not know how to do it. Not much work was needed, and it would also not give him the chance for him to make a mistake.
Department Director Kan’s suggestion for suturing the egg membrane was actually meant for him to corner Ling Ran.

However, Ling Ran was not affected even when he was under the focus of countless phone cameras. He held a scalpel with one hand, and he boldly performed an incision on the membrane of the egg which had already been cracked open.
The liquid from the egg shook a little in a barely perceivable manner, as if it was not very sure whether it had been poked through, so it did not flow out without hesitation.
“Thread.” Ling Ran’s voice volume was neither loud nor soft.
The people around him all held their breaths while staring, and they dared not make any noise, as if they were worried about waking up the liquid in the egg, like it was some sort of sentient being.
Zuo Cidian, who was squatting next to Ling Ran, took out a 7-0 surgical silk suture from the small instrument box and passed it to Ling Ran.

Naturally, there was no need for them to care about disinfecting an egg when they sutured it, but Ling Ran’s movements were still very careful, as if he was performing a surgery. He used minimal movements to take over the silk suture without touching anything. Once he confirmed the position, he poked through the membrane with the tip of the needle.
A waiter who was secretly streaming live only had less than one hundred viewers, but at this time, many bullet screens popped out.
[I want to make a quip about this, but I’m afraid of being blocked if I say anything.]
[I feel like I’ve learnt a lot.]
[The tip of the needle is so fine!]
[I think the stream channel is going to be blocked forever. Everyone, please treasure it while you watch.]
The waiters in the private room put their attention and focus on Ling Ran.

Ling Ran, who had the surgical magnifying glasses on his face partially cover his face, looked a bit weird. However, from another angle, he could be called a “pioneer”, ‘cool man’, or “fashionable”...

Just now, when they were eating, the waiters were still embarrassed to keep looking at him fearlessly. After all, their task was to put their attention on the customers they were serving. However, at this time, they did not need to be particular. Everybody held their phones to take pictures, so they naturally took this opportunity to stare at him.
Besides, while suturing the egg membrane might seem to be more difficult than peeling off an egg shell, when it came to pure aesthetic value, the former was not comparable to the latter.

Everyone only saw Ling Ran’s fingers moving back and forth, and they generally did not see any big change on the egg membrane. Only those who stood near could only see a black silk suture extending, but they also could not see it very clearly.
Only doctors like Department Director Kang would put more attention on the egg membrane.
They did not need to look at the changes of the egg membrane, they just stared at Ling Ran’s movement. As the effect of suture, they would naturally know through the performance of the egg.
Ling Ran sat upright, and his fingers moved very fast, just like how he usually performed surgery.
He had not sutured an egg membrane before, so he felt that it was interesting.
He felt that he could use this as a long-term training model.
Ling Ran thought in a relaxed fashion, and his hands moved even easier and more rhythmically than before.
For him, he might also be suturing something, but the difficulty of suturing the blood vessels in the fingers was higher, and the pressure of suturing those blood vessels was even greater.

If he failed in suturing the egg membrane, there was no problem, and naturally, he did not feel any stress. Being watched by everyone was also normal for Ling Ran. He also did not really bother about success, failure, compliments, or criticisms. Besides, under normal situations, if someone criticized or expressed negative emotions, naturally, another one would fight back with very positive emotions, and Ling Ran would not need to approach these things.
Ling Ran looked like he was full, and now, he wanted to move his muscles.
In fact, he liked this kind of activity during meals.
Suturing during a meal made him feel like he could eat one more round.

“Done.” At this time, Ling Ran gently tied a knot before he put down the silk suture and needle. He turned the egg around, just like he had finished a glass of wine and was showing off the bottom of the cup.
Not a drop of wine was spilled.
Applause was heard.
Most of the people did not care that much. When they saw that Ling Ran had finished, they gave a round of applause very politely.
“Let me see.” Department Director Kang sat for a while, and he felt slightly drunk. He shoved his way forward in a rather rude manner, then stretched his hand to grab the egg in front of Ling Ran.
“Be careful, pick up the bottom part together.” Huo Congjun stopped his action. He said with the ghost of a smile. “Department Director Kang, you’re a little drunk, right?”

Department Director Kang was a little stunned. It was only then that he realized that his movements had been rather forceful. He went along with Huo Congjun’s words and acted like he was slightly drunk. Then, he took the egg in front of Ling Ran and observed it carefully.
“Lend me the surgical magnifying glasses.” Department Director Kang was not embarrassed when he extended his hand.

Ling Ran observed Department Director Kang. He saw that he was acting very normally and did not look like he was going to show any signs of myocardial infarction, so he passed the surgical magnifying glasses to Department Director Kang and turned around to look at Zuo Cidian.
“I will do a thorough disinfection later,” Zuo Cidian calmly answered.
Ling Ran nodded in satisfaction, then he laid back against the chair in a relaxed manner.
Department Director Kang put on the surgical magnifying glasses and focused on observing the sutures on the egg membrane.
If he only looked at it with his eyes, the suture of the membrane was just a simple black line with a few short horizontal lines intersecting with each other in the middle.
However, after he put on the surgical magnifying glasses, he was overloaded with information.

He could see a straight, fine, long, black line which proved that the coverage and direction of the suture was correct. The black line was neither bent nor folded, which stated that the strength of the suture was balanced, and the gap between the sutures was balanced.
Department Director Kang raised his eyebrows again, then he looked at the short horizontal lines.

The horizontal line was still black. The focus of all of Ling Ran’s strength was completely perpendicular to the “wound” of the egg membrane, it was just like the legs of a centipede splayed neatly and densely by the sides of its body.
When he observed under the surgical magnifying glasses, the egg membrane sutured by Ling Ran was more ferocious than good-looking.
It was so ferocious that it could not be stopped until its goal was achieved.
When Department Director Kang thought about that, he became shocked.
When Department Director Kang was young, he was skilled. In the past, suturing egg membranes was also a training he always did, and he also did it as a performance.
However, making the sutures on a wound so... vivid... was something Department Director Kang had never tried before.
“Let me try.” As Department Director Kang spoke, he picked up the egg and turned it around gently.
No liquid flowed out, and the bearing capacity of the egg membrane was also functioning.
“Impressive.” Department Director Kang put the egg back in the champagne glass slowly. Although it was just a performance during dinner, he still felt very stressed.
Suddenly, Department Director Kang noticed that Ling Ran seemed to keep an eye on him, so he could not help but ask, “Doctor Ling, is there any problem?”
Ling Ran shook his head lightly. He just habitually observed Department Director Kang...
Department Director Kang still felt a little unnerved, but when he took a look at the egg in the champagne glass again, Department Director Kang was full of emotions.
A treasure chest softly popped out in front of Ling Ran.
The system notification telling him that he had received a Peer’s Admiration Basic Treasure Chest naturally appeared.
Subsequently, another notification popped out in front of Ling Ran.
[Mission Completed: Show Your Skills (2/2)]

[Mission Details: You can also show your skills outside the operating theater. Make Kang Jian and He Liang provide you with Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chests by using your skills outside the operating theater. Then, from this, you can obtain more surgeries along with more freedom to choose your surgeries.]
[Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]

Only those who stood near could only see a black silk suture extending, but they also could not see it very clearly.
Only doctors like Department Director Kang would put more attention on the egg membrane.
They did not need to look at the changes of the egg membrane, they just stared at Ling Ran’s movement.
As the effect of suture, they would naturally know through the performance of the egg.
Ling Ran sat upright, and his fingers moved very fast, just like how he usually performed surgery.
He had not sutured an egg membrane before, so he felt that it was interesting.
He felt that he could use this as a long-term training model.
Ling Ran thought in a relaxed fashion, and his hands moved even easier and more rhythmically than before.
For him, he might also be suturing something, but the difficulty of suturing the blood vessels in the fingers was higher, and the pressure of suturing those blood vessels was even greater.
If he failed in suturing the egg membrane, there was no problem, and naturally, he did not feel any stress.
Being watched by everyone was also normal for Ling Ran.
He also did not really bother about success, failure, compliments, or criticisms.

Besides, under normal situations, if someone criticized or expressed negative emotions, naturally, another one would fight back with very positive emotions, and Ling Ran would not need to approach these things.
Ling Ran looked like he was full, and now, he wanted to move his muscles.
In fact, he liked this kind of activity during meals.
Suturing during a meal made him feel like he could eat one more round.
“Done.” At this time, Ling Ran gently tied a knot before he put down the silk suture and needle.
He turned the egg around, just like he had finished a glass of wine and was showing off the bottom of the cup.
Not a drop of wine was spilled.
Applause was heard.
Most of the people did not care that much.
When they saw that Ling Ran had finished, they gave a round of applause very politely.
“Let me see.” Department Director Kang sat for a while, and he felt slightly drunk.
He shoved his way forward in a rather rude manner, then stretched his hand to grab the egg in front of Ling Ran.
“Be careful, pick up the bottom part together.” Huo Congjun stopped his action.
He said with the ghost of a smile.
“Department Director Kang, you’re a little drunk, right?”
Department Director Kang was a little stunned.
It was only then that he realized that his movements had been rather forceful.
He went along with Huo Congjun’s words and acted like he was slightly drunk.
Then, he took the egg in front of Ling Ran and observed it carefully.
“Lend me the surgical magnifying glasses.” Department Director Kang was not embarrassed when he extended his hand.
Ling Ran observed Department Director Kang.

He saw that he was acting very normally and did not look like he was going to show any signs of myocardial infarction, so he passed the surgical magnifying glasses to Department Director Kang and turned around to look at Zuo Cidian.
“I will do a thorough disinfection later,” Zuo Cidian calmly answered.
Ling Ran nodded in satisfaction, then he laid back against the chair in a relaxed manner.
Department Director Kang put on the surgical magnifying glasses and focused on observing the sutures on the egg membrane.
If he only looked at it with his eyes, the suture of the membrane was just a simple black line with a few short horizontal lines intersecting with each other in the middle.
However, after he put on the surgical magnifying glasses, he was overloaded with information.
He could see a straight, fine, long, black line which proved that the coverage and direction of the suture was correct.
The black line was neither bent nor folded, which stated that the strength of the suture was balanced, and the gap between the sutures was balanced.
Department Director Kang raised his eyebrows again, then he looked at the short horizontal lines.
The horizontal line was still black.
The focus of all of Ling Ran’s strength was completely perpendicular to the “wound” of the egg membrane, it was just like the legs of a centipede splayed neatly and densely by the sides of its body.
When he observed under the surgical magnifying glasses, the egg membrane sutured by Ling Ran was more ferocious than good-looking.
It was so ferocious that it could not be stopped until its goal was achieved.
When Department Director Kang thought about that, he became shocked.
When Department Director Kang was young, he was skilled.
In the past, suturing egg membranes was also a training he always did, and he also did it as a performance.
However, making the sutures on a wound so... vivid... was something Department Director Kang had never tried before.
“Let me try.” As Department Director Kang spoke, he picked up the egg and turned it around gently.
No liquid flowed out, and the bearing capacity of the egg membrane was also functioning.
“Impressive.” Department Director Kang put the egg back in the champagne glass slowly.
Although it was just a performance during dinner, he still felt very stressed.
Suddenly, Department Director Kang noticed that Ling Ran seemed to keep an eye on him, so he could not help but ask, “Doctor Ling, is there any problem?”
Ling Ran shook his head lightly.
He just habitually observed Department Director Kang...
Department Director Kang still felt a little unnerved, but when he took a look at the egg in the champagne glass again, Department Director Kang was full of emotions.
A treasure chest softly popped out in front of Ling Ran.
The system notification telling him that he had received a Peer’s Admiration Basic Treasure Chest naturally appeared.
Subsequently, another notification popped out in front of Ling Ran.
[Mission Completed: Show Your Skills (2/2)]
[Mission Details: You can also show your skills outside the operating theater.
Make Kang Jian and He Liang provide you with Peers’ Admiration Basic Treasure Chests by using your skills outside the operating theater.
Then, from this, you can obtain more surgeries along with more freedom to choose your surgeries.]
[Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]

chapters.title: Chapter 973: Atrial Septal Defect
paragraphs: When Ling Ran received the treasure chest, he immediately opened it.
A neither thick nor thin shining blue book emerged in the air. It had a faint halo around it.

Due to the semi-transparent effect from the system, Ling Ran could see the expressions on the other people’s faces. He could see the flashing red light on their phone cameras, as well as the greedy looks and idolizing gazes.
Ling Ran did not hesitate, care, or pay heed to those things. Like a fool, he waved his hands in the air and opened the shining blue book.
[Atrial Septal Defect Closure (Perfect Level)]. Those huge words appeared in front of Ling Ran’s eyes immediately.
Ling Ran could not help but nodded slightly.
Atrial septal defect was a common congenital heart disease, and atrial septal defect closure was one of the common treatment options.

Strictly speaking, atrial septal defect closure should be an intervention therapy, and according to Yun Hua’s classification, it belonged to the scope of surgery in the Cardiology Department. The occluder used in the closure was also a very important equipment for cardiology.

If the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery where Department Director Kang was at, wanted to treat atrial septal defect, they would use the repair of interatrial septal defect method. The damage done through this method was naturally greater than that of occlusion, but the indication scope would be wider.

However, Ling Ran was neither in the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery nor the Cardiology Department. It did matter whether he got occlusion or a repair method. After all, it would always be a good thing if he had skills in his hands.
As he had finished eating the Australian spiny lobster, Ling Ran got up without any reluctance and said, “If there’s nothing else, I’m going back.”
Huo Congjun immediately registered what he meant, looked at the Rolex Daytona around his wrist, and said, “It’s late, I’ll get a car to send you back.”
“I want to go to the hospital,” Ling Ran answered.
“You’re going back to the hospital now?” Huo Congjun was surprised.

“I am in a good condition today. I want to wait and see if there are any emergency cases,” Ling Ran said, and felt that his reason was not sound nough, so he added, “If there are no emergency cases, we can start my surgery earlier tomorrow morning.”
Zuo Cidian and Lu Wenbin looked at each other and started to pack up their things silently.
If Ling Ran said that he wanted to start surgery earlier, the young doctors under him must go to bed even earlier, then.

“Would you be too exhausted?” Huo Congjun said in slight worry, “You can just give your night duties and ordinary surgeries to your assistants. You are now a second-string doctor. It’s fine to just devote your energy to elective surgeries.”
“Young Doctor” Zuo Cidian wiped his face and tried to keep his face as still as possible.
“Young Doctor” Lu Wenbin hunched his shoulders and tried to keep his body size as small as possible.
Ling Ran calmly said, “I don’t feel tired when I’m on duty. And at night, I only choose the emergency surgeries I’m interested in doing.”
“What kind of surgery are you interested in?” Associate Hospital Director Zhou was curious at this moment.
Ling Ran said without thinking much, “If there are any emergency cardiac trauma repair cases right now, I’ll be pretty interested in them.”
Because Department Director Kang drank a lot of alcohol, his somewhat red cheeks turned redder at this moment.
However, even after drinking, Department Director Kang did not jump up to cause a ruckus again.
Some things cannot be solved with words.

In Yun Hua Hospital’s current environment, even if a patient with a cardiac trauma was sent to the Emergency Medical Center during the day, that patient would be first handled by the Emergency Department. Without the latter’s notification to the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery, the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery had no way of knowing the situation.

Unless it was a similar case to the one they operated on today, whereby due to the lack of beds or lack of corresponding experience in cardiac nursing care, the Emergency Medical Center had to transfer the patient to the Department of Cardiovascular Surgery.
However, the right to hand over the patient was still in the hands of the Emergency Medical Center.

Unless the Emergency Medical Center did not want to do it or there were no suitable doctors and conditions for them to perform the operation, the advantages of the Emergency Medical Center in grabbing patients were unparalleled, especially when it came to the distribution of emergency cases. The Emergency Medical Center held the greatest power in that regard.
Department Director Kang’s mind suddenly came up with this thought, ‘I should have tried hard to dismantle Huo Congjun’s Emergency Department in the past. It’s too late now.’
Ling Ran bade farewell to the people, and he left without wasting another second by the table.
The owners of the cameras moved their cameras to make sure that they captured the scene of Ling Ran moving out of the room before they quietly put their cameras away.

Several young waiters and pharmaceutical sales representatives even ignored the fact that their identities were an obstacle for them to talk to each other and gathered together to have an enthusiastic discussion.
“Doctor Ling is really handsome, and he also has a good attitude.”
“Did you take a picture of Doctor Ling’s waving his hand just now? Have you sent it to the group? I think that expression and action are absolute killers.”
“But why did Doctor Ling wave his hand just now?”
“Maybe he finds the man across him ugly? Who knows? Anyway, his action was insanely handsome!”

At the Emergency Medical Center in Yun Hua Hospital, Wang Jia, the young nurse on duty, hid in the room with her leg crossed over her knee while she played with her phone. Once a WeChat notification came, she jumped up instantly.
“Doctor Ling is coming back on duty.” Wang Jia seemed so happy that she looked like she was about to celebrate Chinese New Year.

Supervisor Nurse Liu also took out her phone and glanced at it, gasped in amazement, and said, “As expected of Doctor Ling. After dinner, he still came over to be on duty. By the way, are the rooms cleaned up?”

“I didn’t check them today. I’ll call the patient care assistant.” Wang Jia made a call immediately and spoke as if she was racing against time. “Do we use lavender oil? I think Doctor Ling prefers the orange scent.”

“Orange smells like cologne, but lavender is more suitable for resting,” Nurse Liu said and saw the young nurses gathering together. She decided to say, “Everyone, please also tidy up the wards. If Doctor Ling is coming back now, he’ll probably be doing ward rounds next morning.”
“Noted.”
“Alright.”
The young nurses were usually not that easy to order around, but at that moment, they worked hard and tried their best to restore the ward area in the Emergency Medical Center to its best state.
Nurse Liu also packed up the table and watched the group of young nurses working hard while she felt relieved.
Nurses can either be busy or not busy while they were on duty.

If it were a peaceful night, the patients’ conditions were stable, and the patients admitted had relatively simple diseases, the nurses would naturally be more relaxed. However, as long as two or three patients were in a bad condition on the day, everyone would need to be busy.
However, when Doctor Ling came over, the entire Emergency Medical Center became busy.
Once as many as five or more nurses participated in an operation, the entire team would have their abilities of working effectively while being shorthanded, tested.
Nurse Liu’s eyes fell on a can of luncheon meat at the corner of the room.

After thinking about it, Nurse Liu still took an apple and placed it under the luncheon meat. Then, she respectfully pushed her palms together and worshipped those items. “Please let it be peaceful today.”
Nurse Liu thought, ‘Even Doctor Ling should take a good night’s rest and only work tomorrow.’

chapters.title: Chapter 974: On Duty
paragraphs: At the Operating Area of the Emergency Medical Center, Doctor Zhou brought along a few resident doctors, housemen, and interns, where they earnestly came to a small kitchen and said, “We’re doctors, and we have different habits when we are on duty. I won’t stop you from going about with your habits. However, first of all, I hope that everyone will follow me in this worship. Then, you can go and use your own method to worship other things.”
After speaking, Doctor Zhou nodded at the chef to greet him. Then, he unlocked the lock over the cabinet door with a serious face and took out a long... pork belly.

The pork belly was the length of an ordinary person’s arms. The color between the layers of fat and lean meat was very distinct from each other, and there was a thick hemp rope tied at both ends of the meat, as well as the middle. Everything seemed to be marinated in oil as it glistened.
“Is this pickled meat?” Intern Qi Zao, who came from Yun Hua University, instantly had her curiosity—cultivated from her stint as a campus journalist—stirred.
Doctor Zhou took a serious look at Qi Zao and said, “This is salted meat.”
“Salted meat?”
Doctor Zhou solemnly nodded. “I suggest that all of you eat more salted meat in the hospital.”
He stressed on the word “salted”.
Qi Zao was not the only one who understood it, several interns also understood it.

Doctor Zhou did not talk much. He stepped on a chair and hung the arm-length pork belly on a hook on the ceiling—the newly renovated cafeteria actually originally had no room for a hook on the ceiling. It was under Doctor Zhou’s request that one was installed.
When everything was prepared, Doctor Zhou waved his hand and led everyone to bow solemnly to the pork belly. Then, he muttered something under his breath.

Qi Zao looked around and found that Doctor Zhou was not the only one devoted to his worship. Even the senior resident doctors were also very devoted to their worship. The in-service training doctors who came from the lower floor also had solemn and serious expressions that did not lose to Doctor Zhou’s.
In comparison, the younger the doctor was, the lower their devotion to the pork belly was.
Qi Zao observed while thinking, and she wanted to pull out her phone to take this picture.

“Okay, let’s put it away.” Doctor Zhou straightened up. Naturally, his expression also relaxed a little. He ordered a resident doctor to take down the pork belly, put it back into the cabinet, and lock the cabinet door.
The resident doctors and in-service training doctors also relaxed.

The interns and housemen looked a little confused. A few of them looked like children who were dragged to City God Temple to pray during Chinese New Year. The interns and housemen also looked like they were not thinking too much, like the children dragged to City God Temple who gradually stopped thinking after they knocked their heads against the floor too much while they kowtowed to pray.

The tall and strong in-service training doctor, Ren Qi laughed out loud and snapped the crowd out of the atmosphere of worship by saying, “Coincidentally, I also bought apples. Everyone can eat some.”
He turned around and took out a fresh container from the refrigerator. When he opened it, the people saw neat rows of apples inside.
Ren Qi took another toothpick out and said while chuckling, “The apple slices might have turned brown after I cut it, but it’s still good.”
“What apple is it?” Doctor Zhou asked calmly.
“Ralls Janet,” Ren Qi replied just as seriously, as if he was giving a secret code.
Doctor Zhou nodded slowly. Then, he took a toothpick and inserted it into a piece of apple.
The other doctors took the apple slices one by one, and whether they liked it or not, they stuffed it into their mouths and chewed.
Qi Zao was at the back. She took a small piece of apple, but could not help asking, “Doctor Zhou, why did you choose Ralls Janet? Is it because Janet means grace?”

Doctor Zhou had worshipped the pickled meat and ate the apple. Now, he exuded a lackadaisical air as he said, “It doesn’t matter whether Ralls Janet means grace. Our requirements are not so strict. But some varieties are not suited to be eaten when you’re on duty, such as Red Fuji. They are red and flavorful, and isn’t that life-threatening? ”

Ren Qi nodded in agreement. “That’s true. This happened one year when I was on duty at the hospital. We ate a Red Fuji, and because of it, that night, four cars crashed into each other back to back on the county road, and eight people were injured in one breath. Think about it, that’s a county road, and the speed limit is at 12 mph, 24 mph, and 43 mph. Even so, four cars still crashed into each other. Isn’t it abnormal?”

Doctor Zhou nodded in admiration. “Some young doctors and nurses don’t understand this. They think things can be peaceful by just eating any piece of apples. They don’t use their brains to think. Red Fuji, Red General, Red Star Apple, and some other varieties cannot be eaten during night shift. Those are basically complots!”
“Red Fuji is the worst. It’s red and flavorful. It’s a real killer.”

“The Red General is not much better. It has general in its name. I once encountered a patient who only had appendicitis and was going to have surgery the next morning. But that night, he suddenly started hurting like hell, and when we sent him into the operating theater and took a look, good grief, his appendix started suppurating, we were basically racing against time...”
Qi Zao listened, and she swayed. As she looked at the apple in front of her, she found that she did not want to eat it anymore.
At this moment, Doctor Zhou stretched lazily and said, “I’ll go back to sleep first. If anything happens, you should discuss it among yourselves. If you can’t solve it, call me.”
Ren Qi and the others agreed willingly without any dispute.
Doctor Zhou nodded with satisfaction and then wobbled straight to the on-call room.

The other doctors dispersed with loud discussions. Those who were not a second-string doctor can also sleep for a while during their shift. If they were lucky, they could sleep up to eight hours without a problem.

Of course, there was nothing they could do if their luck was too bad, and they would end up not sleeping for an entire night. They also had to continue performing surgery the next morning, though this was a common experience for resident doctors.
Qi Zao fell to the back. She looked at the crowd with an indescribable expression, and her heart was incredibly heavy.

“That’s how people are when they get old. Don’t bother about them.” An intern in the same group felt that he just gained an opportunity to talk to her, and he hurried forward to speak to her so that he could curry to her favor.
Qi Zao grunted, lowered the half piece of apple she took a small bite from just now, and quietly threw it into the trash while nobody was around her.
“Yes, superstition is boring.” The boy who was also in his internship also threw his apple into the trash, despite the fact that he had eaten most of it.
“I don’t like apples,” Qi Zao said, looked around and sat in the corner of the cafeteria.
“I also don’t like to eat them either.” The boy hurriedly followed her and looked at where Qi Zao had chosen to sit. He could not help but feel happy and quickly sat across her.
Qi Zao frowned and did not say anything. She just played with her phone and watched the people in the cafeteria from the corner of her eyes.

The boy smiled. The scene of everyone playing with their phones after meeting with each other was not an unfamiliar sight. An anti-social and naive girl would be easier to conquer. The boy spoke in an experienced manner, “Qi Zao, what’s the APP you’re currently using the most now?”
“Are you hungry?”
“Are you hungry already?” The boy was surprised. Was she going to attach the label of a glutton on him? It seemed that his Premium Haidilao membership would have a chance to play a role again.
Qi Zao shook her head, leaned over, and took out a mango from her LV bag. She put it in front of the boy and said, “I’m asking you if you’re hungry.”
The boy rejoiced. How could a man say that he was not hungry at this moment? He quickly said, “I’ll peel it off, let’s eat together.”
Qi Zao nodded slowly, took out a dragon fruit, and quietly placed it in front of the boy.
The boy froze and thought, ‘Could it be that she’s the glutton?’
Without waiting for him to understand what was going on, a Wangzi milk was placed beside the mango.

“Mango... Dragon, Prosper?” The boy finally understood something. He looked nervously behind him and whispered when he saw no other doctors. “Um... Qi Zao, don’t be disagreeable with the teachers. If these are seen and things turn out to be very busy tonight, do you know how much trouble we’ll be in? ”

Qi Zao’s eyes went wide, and she knocked his head with her hand. She said, “Wouldn’t it be good if it’s busy? You don’t even know who you are, do you? You’re an intern. If there are no patients during our duty at night, you wouldn’t even have a chance to practice.”
The boy could not quite register what she said. “Don’t interns need to sleep?”
Qi Zao thought about it, and she took out a box of Mao Xue Wang Sauce from her bag and said, “If you are really afraid, then just eat half of the Mao Xue Wang.”

The interns and housemen looked a little confused.
A few of them looked like children who were dragged to City God Temple to pray during Chinese New Year.

The interns and housemen also looked like they were not thinking too much, like the children dragged to City God Temple who gradually stopped thinking after they knocked their heads against the floor too much while they kowtowed to pray.
The tall and strong in-service training doctor, Ren Qi laughed out loud and snapped the crowd out of the atmosphere of worship by saying, “Coincidentally, I also bought apples.
Everyone can eat some.”
He turned around and took out a fresh container from the refrigerator.
When he opened it, the people saw neat rows of apples inside.
Ren Qi took another toothpick out and said while chuckling, “The apple slices might have turned brown after I cut it, but it’s still good.”
“What apple is it?” Doctor Zhou asked calmly.
“Ralls Janet,” Ren Qi replied just as seriously, as if he was giving a secret code.
Doctor Zhou nodded slowly.
Then, he took a toothpick and inserted it into a piece of apple.
The other doctors took the apple slices one by one, and whether they liked it or not, they stuffed it into their mouths and chewed.
Qi Zao was at the back.
She took a small piece of apple, but could not help asking, “Doctor Zhou, why did you choose Ralls Janet?
Is it because Janet means grace?”
Doctor Zhou had worshipped the pickled meat and ate the apple.
Now, he exuded a lackadaisical air as he said, “It doesn’t matter whether Ralls Janet means grace.
Our requirements are not so strict.
But some varieties are not suited to be eaten when you’re on duty, such as Red Fuji.
They are red and flavorful, and isn’t that life-threatening? ”
Ren Qi nodded in agreement.
“That’s true.
This happened one year when I was on duty at the hospital.
We ate a Red Fuji, and because of it, that night, four cars crashed into each other back to back on the county road, and eight people were injured in one breath.
Think about it, that’s a county road, and the speed limit is at 12 mph, 24 mph, and 43 mph.
Even so, four cars still crashed into each other.
Isn’t it abnormal?”
Doctor Zhou nodded in admiration.
“Some young doctors and nurses don’t understand this.
They think things can be peaceful by just eating any piece of apples.
They don’t use their brains to think.
Red Fuji, Red General, Red Star Apple, and some other varieties cannot be eaten during night shift.
Those are basically complots!”
“Red Fuji is the worst.
It’s red and flavorful.
It’s a real killer.”
“The Red General is not much better.
It has general in its name.
I once encountered a patient who only had appendicitis and was going to have surgery the next morning.

But that night, he suddenly started hurting like hell, and when we sent him into the operating theater and took a look, good grief, his appendix started suppurating, we were basically racing against time...”
Qi Zao listened, and she swayed.
As she looked at the apple in front of her, she found that she did not want to eat it anymore.
At this moment, Doctor Zhou stretched lazily and said, “I’ll go back to sleep first.
If anything happens, you should discuss it among yourselves.
If you can’t solve it, call me.”
Ren Qi and the others agreed willingly without any dispute.
Doctor Zhou nodded with satisfaction and then wobbled straight to the on-call room.
The other doctors dispersed with loud discussions.
Those who were not a second-string doctor can also sleep for a while during their shift.
If they were lucky, they could sleep up to eight hours without a problem.
Of course, there was nothing they could do if their luck was too bad, and they would end up not sleeping for an entire night.
They also had to continue performing surgery the next morning, though this was a common experience for resident doctors.
Qi Zao fell to the back.
She looked at the crowd with an indescribable expression, and her heart was incredibly heavy.
“That’s how people are when they get old.
Don’t bother about them.” An intern in the same group felt that he just gained an opportunity to talk to her, and he hurried forward to speak to her so that he could curry to her favor.
Qi Zao grunted, lowered the half piece of apple she took a small bite from just now, and quietly threw it into the trash while nobody was around her.
“Yes, superstition is boring.” The boy who was also in his internship also threw his apple into the trash, despite the fact that he had eaten most of it.
“I don’t like apples,” Qi Zao said, looked around and sat in the corner of the cafeteria.
“I also don’t like to eat them either.” The boy hurriedly followed her and looked at where Qi Zao had chosen to sit.
He could not help but feel happy and quickly sat across her.
Qi Zao frowned and did not say anything.
She just played with her phone and watched the people in the cafeteria from the corner of her eyes.
The boy smiled.
The scene of everyone playing with their phones after meeting with each other was not an unfamiliar sight.
An anti-social and naive girl would be easier to conquer.
The boy spoke in an experienced manner, “Qi Zao, what’s the APP you’re currently using the most now?”
“Are you hungry?”
“Are you hungry already?” The boy was surprised.
Was she going to attach the label of a glutton on him?
It seemed that his Premium Haidilao membership would have a chance to play a role again.
Qi Zao shook her head, leaned over, and took out a mango from her LV bag.
She put it in front of the boy and said, “I’m asking you if you’re hungry.”
The boy rejoiced.
How could a man say that he was not hungry at this moment?
He quickly said, “I’ll peel it off, let’s eat together.”
Qi Zao nodded slowly, took out a dragon fruit, and quietly placed it in front of the boy.
The boy froze and thought, ‘Could it be that she’s the glutton?’
Without waiting for him to understand what was going on, a Wangzi milk was placed beside the mango.
“Mango...
Dragon, Prosper?” The boy finally understood something.
He looked nervously behind him and whispered when he saw no other doctors.
Qi Zao, don’t be disagreeable with the teachers.
If these are seen and things turn out to be very busy tonight, do you know how much trouble we’ll be in? ”
Qi Zao’s eyes went wide, and she knocked his head with her hand.
She said, “Wouldn’t it be good if it’s busy?
You don’t even know who you are, do you?
You’re an intern.
If there are no patients during our duty at night, you wouldn’t even have a chance to practice.”
The boy could not quite register what she said.
“Don’t interns need to sleep?”
Qi Zao thought about it, and she took out a box of Mao Xue Wang Sauce from her bag and said, “If you are really afraid, then just eat half of the Mao Xue Wang.”

chapters.title: Chapter 975: Would They?
paragraphs: Doctor Zhou lay in bed and could not quite fall asleep. He was unable to hold back from taking out his phone and checking for any missed calls.
On a normal day, this would be the period in which it was the easiest for him to receive calls.

People would call to ask him about what kind of medication they should take at night, confirm the surgeries he would be conducting at night, confirm the arrangement for tasks at night, and other miscellaneous tasks. All these tasks would usually be confirmed at this time.
Once the patients who were admitted in the afternoon were treated and their conditions were stable, it would be very easy for him to have a good night’s sleep.
Of course, Doctor Zhou was usually able to have a good night’s sleep during his night shifts.
However, he did not think that a good night’s sleep came by chance.
As doctors, they needed to work harder, be smarter, and be lucky during their night shift to be able to have a good night’s rest.

Every single time he was on shift duty, Doctor Zhou would go through the medical record of each patient and make some prior preparations based on the patient’s condition. He would also prescribe medication beforehand to those who were suited to receive medication. For those who were not in good condition, he would call for a consultation if they needed it or transfer the patient to other departments if they needed it. Besides, Doctor Zhou was good at winning everyone’s hearts. He would thoroughly check the fruits in the office and nurse’s station. He would not forgive young doctors and young nurses who ate the wrong type of apples. When it came to that matter, the head nurse and nurses on duty stood on the same front as Doctor Zhou.
In truth, many nurses preferred to share shifts with Doctor Zhou, and they even agreed with the discipline Doctor Zhou upheld and his respect for the local customs.
However, the situation was different today.
Doctor Zhou stared at his phone for a long time, but he did not receive any calls. He could not help but get up and take out his valuable, personal phone before he used it to call his work phone.
“The joy of contentment allowed me to endure the pain in my heart. The joy of contentment allowed me to endure the pain in my heart...”
His work phone rang just as he had expected.
“There’s actually a signal?” Doctor Zhou sighed and put his two phones on the floor. He lay down and tried to sleep.
Yet, he did not feel sleepy at all.

“I can’t fall asleep.” Doctor Zhou sighed. He frowned and thought, ‘Ling Ran’s around tonight so there shouldn’t be any problems with surgeries. But why do I have a feeling that something’s wrong? It’s impossible that I am paranoid...’
He looked at his phone again. The one thing doctors were usually most afraid of was their phones ringing, but it was terrifying too when their phones did not ring at all.
Doctor Zhou lay in bed again without getting undressed. He closed his eyes, and after three minutes, he got out of his bed once more to look at his phone. Then, he opened his closet decisively.

The closet was about the size of a 17-inch display screen. The inner part was mostly empty, and only a yellow box was found in the lowest compartment. It was just like a 17-inch display screen that had a small yellow case to put a CD player in it.

Doctor Zhou turned around and looked at the bed, which was covered with the white bed sheet. In the end, he chose to sit in a chair just like when he was seventeen years old. He used his hand and slowly touched the small yellow case... No, it was a yellow box, and he took it out!
Diced fish in black bean sauce!
It was the secret weapon of Yun Hua Hospital’s Emergency Department.
The attending physicians would only eat that on rare occasions.
Doctor Zhou stared at the Honor P9[1], which had seemingly jammed up, and he opened the lid of the diced fish in black bean sauce without any hesitation.
“The joy of contentment has allowed me to endure the pain in my heart...”
Dropping on the bed, the phone suddenly rang.
Doctor Zhou was first delighted before he lowered his head and looked at the salted fish, which had yet to be eaten. He frowned.
‘How ominous!’
While Doctor Zhou thought about that, he picked up his phone. “Hello?”
The resident doctor who made the call spoke anxiously, “Doctor Zhou, a boiler blew up, and the patients are being sent over now.”
Doctor Zhou’s emotions were inexplicably complicated.
One, he was feeling regretful. If he had opened the can of salted fish much earlier...
Two, Doctor Zhou felt relieved...
Of course, he also felt so tense that he could hardly put it to words.
In fact, three to four seconds after Doctor Zhou picked up the call and realized how tense the situation was, he became truly anxious. “What was the size of the boiler?”
“The size?” The resident doctor was dumbfounded.

Doctor Zhou wore his clothes calmly and licked the fish. He then grabbed the phone and said, “If a 600 MW boiler exploded, it’s an especially serious matter, and our hospital will not be able to handle it alone. So, what’s the size of the boiler? How many people were injured? Since the patients are on their way, where are they now?”
“I... I don’t know.” The resident doctor sounded like an idiot.
“How about the patients? How many patients are being sent over?”
“Um... Four ambulances, eight people.”
“How many seriously wounded patients?” Doctor Zhou helped him organize his thinking instead of acting like other senior doctors, who would scold the young doctors fiercely before anything else.

The resident doctor who was on the other end of the phone finally felt calmer and thought for a few seconds before he said, “Maybe it’s more than six people because the operating theaters need to be prepared...”
“I’ll come over now.” When Doctor Zhou heard that, he immediately wore his shoes and went out. He added, “I’ll call Department Director Huo. You inform the departments for consultation.”
“Which departments?” It was clear that the resident doctor who was on the other end of the phone was panicking a little.

Doctor Zhou tried not to scold him and slowly said, “The Neurosurgery Department, Orthopedics Department, and Thoracic Department. Once you’ve arranged a consultation and notified one department, note it down. After your mind is clear, just follow the standard operating procedures.”
“Oh... Okay.”
Doctor Zhou hung up and called Huo Congjun once again.
At the same time, the doctors and nurses in the Emergency Medical Center gathered together.
It was not surprising that Ling Ran stood in front of the doctors.
Without the presence of any third-string doctors, Ling Ran would naturally become the on-site commander.
“Ambulance ETA in five minutes.” The reception nurse quickly walked forward and reported.
However, the doctors on-site dared not relax in the slightest. If all the ambulances arrived together, five minutes of preparation time would hardly be able to reduce the tension in the air.
“How many are seriously wounded?” Ling Ran asked.

“Six are seriously wounded, and the other four are lightly wounded. Besides, there are still two more ambulances following these ambulances, and there are still some wounded patients on the scene of the accident,” the reception nurse replied softly as if she was worried that if she mentioned it, it would affect how many people were injured.
Ling Ran nodded lightly as he listened. “Have the doctors from the departments come over?”
“I’ve informed the doctors on shift.”
“Let them call as many doctors as they can to come over,” Ling Ran gave his order in a familiar manner.
At that moment, Doctor Zhou rushed over with his phone in hand, and he stared at Ling Ran in surprise.
With how familiar Doctor Zhou was with Ling Ran, he would not be surprised if Ling Ran actually said that he wanted to operate on all the patients.
‘But he actually told them to call as many doctors from other departments over?’
The doctors from other departments would not be like the young doctors from the Emergency Department and obey his orders obediently.
When that crossed Doctor Zhou’s mind, his heart skipped a beat. ‘Would they?’
