“Please ask the Orthopedics Department to provide consultation.” Ling Ran turned his head and ordered.
Guo Liqing snorted internally before he whispered to Huo Congjun, “Department Director Huo, when the next patient comes, watch carefully.”
“Yes, I’m watching.” Huo Congjun’s voice was also so low that it sounded as if his vocal cords were in his stomach.
The resident doctor sent by the Orthopedics Department came running like the wind.
He reported for duty to Ling Ran and Huo Congjun before he nervously examined the patient on the bed.
He had to do it in front of Ling Ran, Huo Congjun, and an associate chief physician from the Department of Urology.
The resident doctor from the Orthopedics Department felt that all his bones had become stiff and were now refusing to move freely.
“By the looks of it, the patient needs to be sent directly to the operating theater, maybe...?” The resident doctor looked at Ling Ran and whispered.
Ling Ran nodded and asked, “Do you still have an empty operating theater?”
The surgical floor’s only purpose was to gather all operating theaters together to save resources.
During actual operations, the surgical floor was also used by various departments.

Although the Orthopedics department was a powerful department in Yun Hua Hospital and there were many operating theaters allocated for them, most of their patients suffered from orthopedics injuries in the current accident.
They were definitely running short of operating theaters.

In fact, as far as Ling Ran’s judgment was concerned, the Orthopedics Department still could not make room at that time, and if they wanted to operate on the patient, they would have to fight for a communal operating theater.
The resident doctor from the Orthopedics Department was baffled by the question.
He hesitated for a few seconds.
“Shall I call and ask, then?”
“Ask.
If it’s not enough, let them apply for a mobile operating theater quickly,” Ling Ran replied.
He then put on his gloves again and gave the patient a physical examination.
He tried not to touch the wound.
After a while, the patient was pushed away, and the other patients were sent over.
However, there were still no patients with internal bleeding and no bleeding spots that were hidden from view.
Huo Congjun looked at Guo Liqing.
“What do you want me to see?”
“Ling Ran ...” Guo Liqing held his breath.
“There’s just no way his operating methods were handed to him on a silver platter.”
“You don’t know anything about genii.” Huo Congjun smiled and shook his head.
“All in all, When Ling Ran pointed out where the patients were bleeding just now to the other departments, it was incredible,” Guo Liqing insisted.
Huo Congjun sighed heavily.
“Old Guo, the Department of Urology can’t just circumcise patients all day long to earn income.
You’ll start hallucinating if you cut too much of the same thing.”
“I swear.” Guo Liqing continued to fight for his reputation.
Huo Congjun raised his eyebrows, but he seemed to be unmoved.
However, in his heart, he was weighing the pros and cons.
‘Guo Liqing seems to be quite fun to play with.
Should I toy with him a little?’

chapters.title: Chapter 982: Romantic
paragraphs: At night, Yun Hua Hospital shone with a fearsome red light.
The white walls, green plants, and yellow street lights were like a secret forest, and no one knew what sort of unknown fierce monsters and dangerous traps were hidden inside.

The emergency medical center was the brightest place in Yun Hua Hospital at night. Every window in the independent, small building was fully lit. The word “emergency” was carved into a plate placed outside the building, and it also had a huge string of lights hung over it. That made every passerby shudder when they saw it as if there was a natural pressure coming from it. Even if they pretended not to see it, they would unknowingly remember the location of the emergency room and hope that they would never need to use such information.
Right then, a couple looked at the word on the plate with great agitation on their faces.
“Here we are.” A girl with a ponytail pedaled hard on her bike and comforted the boy in the back seat.
“Kay...” the boy said solemnly. “Don’t tire yourself. Let’s take a cab.”
“Hey, you’ve been saying the same thing over and over again all along the way. I’m really okay.” The girl pretended to be strong. She raised one hand and clenched her fist to show her muscles.
“Be careful.” The boy groaned weakly. He had to stretch out one of his legs to support the rickety bike. At the same time, he bared his teeth in advance in case he felt pain.
The girl instantly became flustered, and she said, “It’s okay, I’m supporting it.”
“I know.” The boy broke out in a sweat because of the pain, and he said, “Really, let’s take a cab.”
“I can do it,” the girl insisted and started cycling again.
The boy, who was sitting on the backseat of the bicycle, watched a cab pass by. His entire body desired it, especially the body part that was currently hurting.
“Doctor! Doctor!” The girl carried the boy to the reception door, and it was only then that they were discovered by the nurse inside.
“What’s the matter?” The nurse came forward and asked.
The girl looked at the nurse pitifully and said, “He was trying to protect me from...”
The boy whispered, “I fell down the stairs. Now, I have chest pain.”
“Please have a seat first. Wheelchair, please...” The moment the nurse heard the word “chest pain”, she became very sensitive to the situation. She immediately waved and called a free houseman over.
They were currently busy, and it was hard for resident doctors to spare time for this patient.
Simultaneously, a nurse who had come over from the Department of Surgery to provide assistance pushed a wheelchair over and helped the boy on it.
The boy sat in the wheelchair, which did not dig into his butt and leaned against it slowly. He could not help but breathe a long, comfortable sigh. “Finally...”
The nurse asked strangely, “How did you get to the hospital?”
“I sent him here by bicycle.” There was faint pride on the girl’s face along with a trace of shyness.
The nurse was very surprised to hear it. She looked at the boy, who was not thin. She felt impressed as she asked, “How far did you cycle?”
“About two miles.” The girl rubbed her aching thigh with her aching arm and said with a smile, “I didn’t expect to hold on this long.”
“Why didn’t you take a cab?” asked the nurse.
The boy looked at the girl.

The girl’s expression was a mixture of embarrassment and pride. “We usually ride bicycles. Besides, the nearest accessible transportation when it happened was the bicycle. I often run, and I was confident that I could give him a ride, right...?”
The girl looked at the boy after she finished talking.
The boy bore with the pain as he smiled at her. “You’re amazing.”
The girl swayed her ponytail with joy. “I find myself amazing too.”

The nurse was also impressed by the girl with the ponytail. She then praised her, “I also think you’re amazing. Some people only know how to call for a cab when they get injured. You were still able to send your boyfriend here without calling one. It’s really rare...”
“I’m not really that amazing. At that time, I was ready to call a cab in case I couldn’t get the bicycle moving. But I never thought I would last the whole journey until we reached the hospital.”
“You were ready to call a cab in case you couldn’t carry him?” The nurse frowned. “Were there any cabs on the way?”
“Of course. I cycled along Binjiang Road. How could there be no cabs on the road? We even met an illegal cab, and the owner foolishly asked us where we were going.” The girl smiled.
The nurse glanced at the pale boy.
The boy forced himself to smile. “It’s already fortunate that we’re here.”

“I’ll take the patient inside. Family member, please head over to pay the fee.” The nurse pushed the boy to the treatment room as she spoke. After pushing the wheelchair a little, she asked, “Are you facing any problems? Do you want me to call someone?”
“No.” The boy quickly shook his head and bared his teeth subconsciously before he firmly said, “She... likes romance...”

‘Riding a bicycle while carrying her boyfriend and going on an arduous journey for two miles is indeed romantic,’ the nurse thought, and she instantly found that the suffering the boy went through was nothing.
“I saw Doctor Ling at the reception hall. We’re students of Yun Hua University School of Medicine. Can you request for our senior to be our doctor?” The girl came back in a hurry after she came back.
“We should let the other doctors see how he is first. If it’s necessary, they’ll look for Doctor Ling,” the nurse answered.
“But... his chest is causing him so much pain...” The girl’s expression was sullen.

The young nurse recalled the fact that the girl gave her boyfriend a ride for about two miles on a bicycle, and she frankly said, “How about this? I’ll take you to the rescue area first, and I’ll ask around for you.”
The girl did not doubt her. She patiently gave her boyfriend a few reminders for two minutes before she followed the young nurse to the rescue area.

Due to the large number of injured patients caused by the boiler explosion, the Emergency Medical Center’s rescue area had been expanded to twice its original size to accommodate the number of patients they had to receive.

When the nurse took the girl to the part that was “invaded” by the rescue area, she saw that the ground already had bloodstains, which the staff did not have time to clean. As she walked a little further into the area, she saw a patient whose arm was obviously dislocated.
“Wait...” The girl stopped. “I... don’t think I need to go in.”
The nurse nodded. Her plan went well. “Okay, wait a moment. In truth, a doctor’s already checked your boyfriend earlier. He probably just has a broken rib.”
“Just?” The girl repeated that word before she looked up and saw the scene in the rescue room. Suddenly, she felt that what the nurse said was not wrong.
Ling Ran only entered the emergency room at midnight.
At this point in time, all the doctors who could return already did, and the first batch of doctors who came back was exhausted.

For hospitals like Yun Hua Hospital, doctors would be performing surgeries at full capacity for the whole day. The junior doctors who were required to be on duty at night were generally young and could only provide support to the best of their abilities, but they were also tired. As for chief physicians and associate chief physicians who were forty to fifty years old, they were forced to conduct surgeries at least once at dawn. They were already at their limit once they persevered until the second half of the night.
Ling Ran was slightly exhausted, but after he drank a bottle of Energy Serum, he became the most energetic one in the hospital.
“Is this an atrial septal defect?” With the report in his hand, Ling Ran walked lightly toward Doctor Zhou.
Doctor Zhou, who just came out of a room in the ward, yawned. He hummed, then looked at Ling Ran strangely. “You run really fast.”
“How’s the situation?” Ling Ran felt that he did not need to explain that he had set the electronic medical record system to remind him if any medical cases with atrial septal defect appeared.

Truth be told, this was just a casual remark from Doctor Zhou. He yawned sleepily again and said, “The patient is a blue-collar worker. He suddenly felt sick while he was sleeping, and his family sent him to the Emergency Department. When we found that his BP was 180/110, I performed an examination on him.”

When Doctor Zhou said that, he paused for a moment and said, “Now that I’ve given him some medication, his blood pressure has dropped below a hundred and sixty. I was going to transfer him to the Cardiology Department in the morning...”

Although the patient needed urgent treatment, it was okay for the patient to go through elective surgery after his blood pressure was controlled. There was no need to call for a doctor from the Cardiology Department at night.
Ling Ran took out his iPad, looked through the medical case carefully, and said, “You don’t have to transfer the patient to the Cardiology Department, I’ll do it.”

“You...” Doctor Zhou looked at Ling Ran, and he had a strong urge to say something. Finally, he was able to suppress his urge. He just said to himself, ‘My grandfather lived until he was ninety-three years old because he minded his own business.’

chapters.title: Chapter 983: Wanted to Chase Away
paragraphs: Ling Ran prescribed some medication for the patient with the atrial septal defect and gave the nurse some orders before rushing back to resuscitate patients.

Atrial septal defect closure was considered a small heart surgery, and it could be carried out as an outpatient surgery in many hospitals, which means that the patients could leave the hospital on the day of the surgery itself. For the purpose of claims, the patients would be admitted to the hospitals. However, the patients would actually only stay at the hospital for a few hours. After their family members received some instructions, they could recuperate at home.

However, even though it was an outpatient surgery, it was still a scheduled surgery. Hence, it was different from emergency surgeries, where the focus was to deal with the main problems. Before receiving atrial septal defect closure, a patient had to go for a transesophageal echocardiography, electrocardiography and chest X-ray. They also had to consume aspirin beforehand. All of this required arrangements to be made.
After having breakfast the following morning, Ling Ran called all his subordinates along and headed to the Cardiology Department.

The equipment and facilities required for interventional surgeries were relatively different, and even though they were placed on the surgical floor, they belonged to various departments. Since Ling Ran wanted to borrow them, he naturally had to explain where he was coming from.

After Huo Congjun and Zuo Cidian got a confirmation from Ling Ran, they showed their support. Moreover, they even asked the other doctors in the treatment group to accompany Ling Ran to receive the patient.
Ling Ran led the way as they walked toward the Cardiology Department.
Behind him, Zuo Cidian stood a little to his right. Lu Wenbin and Zhang Anmin were also there, and all of them walked around Yu Yuan to protect her as she might get trampled on due to her height.
Aside from this, Huang Maoshi from Changxi Medical Company and Mai Chun from Yunli Medical Company were there with engineers from their respective companies.
Even though there were quite a lot of people, they were silent, and they appeared exceptionally well-trained.
They walked calmly through the main hall of the Emergency Medical Center and divided themselves into two batches to enter the elevator.
It was only then that Lu Wenbin and the rest of the people who were still waiting for the elevator breathed a sigh of relief.
“I’m so nervous. I feel like we’re going to war.” Lu Wenbin took a deep breath when he saw that the elevator doors had slid close.

“We are indeed going to war,” Zhang Anmin said in a nostalgic tone, and he was in rather high spirits. He was definitely the one who supported Ling Ran in carrying out cardiac surgeries the most among the members of Ling Treatment Group. Hence, even though he was already an associate chief physician of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, Zhang Anmin insisted on heading to the Cardiology Department along with the resident doctors. And he was more earnest in doing so compared to Yu Yuan and the others.
Lu Wenbin’s face twitched a few times, and he did not refute what Zhang Anmin said. He merely nodded a little and said, “It’s a pity that atrial septal defect closure is not a major surgery...”

“We should always start small. Moreover, it’s heart surgery, and it’s atrial septal defect closure at that... It’s a good start.” Zhang Anmin tried to flash a heroic smile, but no matter how he tried, he was unable to look like a man of justice.
Ma Yanlin, who was standing beside them, looked a little pale. But he agreed. “Heart surgeries are pretty good.”

“It’s more than good.” Zhang Anmin tried to flash an even more heroic smile, and there was a longing in his eyes. “If we really start performing heart surgeries in the Emergency Medical Center, in the future, even your wife would have to kneel down and give you a bl*wjob at home.”
Ma Yanlin’s face immediately became even paler. He gulped with difficulty and said, “Can you talk about something else?”

“You want something else?” Zhang Anmin gazed at his reflection on the stainless steel elevator doors and could not help but to flash a smile. “If you want something else, then you must think about getting a promotion, no? With a higher position, you would get more perks, such as getting more surgeries.”
Zhang Anmin had taken the opportunity to boast about his position. And he could not help but start comparing heart surgeries and liver surgeries.

In the hospital, the Cardiology Department and the Orthopedics Department were the ones that made the most money. Of course, profits were high in the Ophthalmology Department too. However, with the way things were in Yun Hua Hospital now, not too many doctors were needed.

The profits made by various departments were determined by the way money was distributed in the hospital. Now that the policy no longer favored departments that mainly earned money through drugs, the Neurosurgery Department and other internal medicine departments no longer made as much money. Instead, departments, where plenty of expensive medical consumables were required, made plenty of money due to the fact that they could get an exaggerated amount of commission from those medical consumables.
Artificial hip joints and knee joints used in the Orthopedics Department for joint replacement surgeries cost tens of thousands of RMB.

However, it was tough to work in the Orthopedics Department, where the surgeons had to lift heavy objects like thighs, and things were a lot easier in the Cardiology Department. Whether a person was talking about the stents that even laymen knew about or occluders which were quite rarely used, they were both pricey medical consumables. Moreover, due to the difference in technology levels between doctors in China and foreign doctors, the prices of these medical consumables in China were often hiked.
From what Zhang Anmin knew, doctors from the Cardiology Department almost never carried out freelance surgeries.
What kind of life must they be living and how much money must they be making to be able to resist freelance surgeries?
If Zhang Anmin had a choice, he would definitely choose to become a cardiologist.
With this thought in mind, Zhang Anmin was even more determined to conquer the Cardiology Department today.
“Old Zuo, what’re you guys planning to do?” After stepping out of the elevator, Zhang Anmin immediately caught up with Zuo Cidian.
“From what I hear from Doctor Ling, he should be planning to have a friendly discussion with them,” Zuo Cidian answered earnestly, but his expression was not serious at all?
“Friendly discussion?” Zhang Anmin glanced at the resident doctors behind him. If it were not for the fact that he was on the same team as them, he would have started laughing.
Lu Wenbin cleared his throat and said, “If a fight ensues later, I’ll be responsible for protecting Doctor Ling as he flees.”
The other people finally started laughing, which made the atmosphere a little less tense.
This was when the doctors and nurses of the Cardiology Department started noticing Ling Ran and his entourage. They saw that there were smiles on the faces of the doctors walking behind Ling Ran.
Soon, Department Director Yuan from the Cardiology Department gathered a group of people. He walked out of his office with those people to welcome Ling Ran.

Department Director Yuan was over the age of fifty, but his cheeks were pink, indicating that he was still as fit as a fiddle. He looked vigilantly at Ling Ran and asked, “Doctor Ling, why are you here? Oh, by the way, is everything fine with the patient from yesterday? Did things go well?”

Not even a preoperative consultation required the presence of so many doctors, and Ling Ran as well as his entourage were giving Department Director Yuan the vibe that they were here to start a gang fight.

Of course, this was not the only reason why Department Director Yuan felt threatened. He would rather have Ling Ran here for a gang fight. This way, he would not mind too much even if all the nurses in his department were injured.

“I would like to borrow an operating theater from the Cardiology Department. It would be best if the Cardiology Department could send some men over to help out,” Ling Ran voiced out his request right away.

He was a straightforward man, and he believed that the operating theater of the Cardiology Department was the best place to perform surgeries such as atrial septal defect closure, as it would be the simplest and the most convenient.

If Department Director Yuan agreed to it, he could immediately ask his subordinates to get the operating theater ready, and it would be best if he could learn a thing or two from the doctors from the Cardiology Department by assisting them in a couple of surgeries. This way, the Cardiology Department basically would not be affected at all. Ling Ran would also reap plenty of benefits out of this.
However, from the perspective of the doctors of the Cardiology Department, Ling Ran’s reply was like him firing a gun in their faces.

Department Director Yuan had expected this, and he flashed the kind of expression one had when faced with a formidable enemy. He said with a dark expression, “Doctor Ling, you’ve just conquered a territory of the Cardiovascular Surgery Department, and I’m sure that you haven’t spent enough time enjoying it yet. Why are you in such a rush to conquer our territory?”
Ling Ran looked at him with a baffled expression. “There isn’t any logical relation between what you’re saying and my request at all.”

“I...” Department Director Yuan wanted to speak some harsh words, but he ended up shaking his head. “Doctor Ling, you can forget about this. We from the Cardiology Department have worked hard for what we have. Things weren’t handed to us in a silver platter, you know. Every time you’re interested in a new surgical method, look at what happened? Look at what happened to the Cardiovascular Department, Department of Interventional Services, and the Digestive Surgery Department...”
Department Director Yuan looked around in an arrogant manner, and his gaze was sharp.

“I only intend to borrow the operating theater for around two hours.” Ling Ran merely wanted to perform a surgery, as he wanted to try out the Perfect Level Atrial Septal Defect Closure that he had just obtained.
Department Director Yuan shook his head again. He was not worried about how long Ling Ran would be using the operating theater. What he was worried about was Ling Ran conquering his department.
“This way, we’ll have no choice but to purchase our own facilities.” Ling Ran sighed. He then turned and nodded at Huang Maoshi and Mai Chun, who were standing behind him.

He brought these pharmaceutical sales representatives along with him so that they could guide him regarding the related facilities. They could also prepare the medical consumables that he would be using.

The main selling point of Changxi Medical Company was locally produced amplatzer septal occluders made of nitinol. Meanwhile, Yunli Medical Company was capable of providing imported amplatzer septal occluders. Ling Ran needed to weigh the pros and cons of both choices before making a decision.
When Department Director Yuan heard what Ling Ran had said, his expression immediately changed. He no longer looked like he wanted to chase Ling Ran and his entourage away.
‘Purchase their own facilities?
‘Purchase their own facilities just to perform an atrial septal defect closure?
‘Is he an idiot?’
But Department Director Yuan could not help but feel a chill run down his spine when he thought about the implications of this idiotic plan.
It was not so easy to purchase hospital facilities. Even the tendering process itself might take a year or two.

However, it had never been difficult for Ling Ran to purchase equipment and facilities. Department Director Yuan could not help but think of something else. ‘If Ling Ran purchases his own facilities and builds an operating theater fit for heart surgeries, would he stop at one surgery?’
“Wait...” Department Director Yuan forced a smile. “Doctor Ling, how many hours did you say that you need the operating theater again?”

Atrial septal defect closure was considered a small heart surgery, and it could be carried out as an outpatient surgery in many hospitals, which means that the patients could leave the hospital on the day of the surgery itself.
For the purpose of claims, the patients would be admitted to the hospitals.
However, the patients would actually only stay at the hospital for a few hours.
After their family members received some instructions, they could recuperate at home.
However, even though it was an outpatient surgery, it was still a scheduled surgery.
Hence, it was different from emergency surgeries, where the focus was to deal with the main problems.
Before receiving atrial septal defect closure, a patient had to go for a transesophageal echocardiography, electrocardiography and chest X-ray.
They also had to consume aspirin beforehand.
All of this required arrangements to be made.
After having breakfast the following morning, Ling Ran called all his subordinates along and headed to the Cardiology Department.
The equipment and facilities required for interventional surgeries were relatively different, and even though they were placed on the surgical floor, they belonged to various departments.
Since Ling Ran wanted to borrow them, he naturally had to explain where he was coming from.
After Huo Congjun and Zuo Cidian got a confirmation from Ling Ran, they showed their support.
Moreover, they even asked the other doctors in the treatment group to accompany Ling Ran to receive the patient.
Ling Ran led the way as they walked toward the Cardiology Department.
Behind him, Zuo Cidian stood a little to his right.
Lu Wenbin and Zhang Anmin were also there, and all of them walked around Yu Yuan to protect her as she might get trampled on due to her height.
Aside from this, Huang Maoshi from Changxi Medical Company and Mai Chun from Yunli Medical Company were there with engineers from their respective companies.
Even though there were quite a lot of people, they were silent, and they appeared exceptionally well-trained.
They walked calmly through the main hall of the Emergency Medical Center and divided themselves into two batches to enter the elevator.
It was only then that Lu Wenbin and the rest of the people who were still waiting for the elevator breathed a sigh of relief.
“I’m so nervous.
I feel like we’re going to war.” Lu Wenbin took a deep breath when he saw that the elevator doors had slid close.
“We are indeed going to war,” Zhang Anmin said in a nostalgic tone, and he was in rather high spirits.
He was definitely the one who supported Ling Ran in carrying out cardiac surgeries the most among the members of Ling Treatment Group.

Hence, even though he was already an associate chief physician of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, Zhang Anmin insisted on heading to the Cardiology Department along with the resident doctors.
And he was more earnest in doing so compared to Yu Yuan and the others.
Lu Wenbin’s face twitched a few times, and he did not refute what Zhang Anmin said.
He merely nodded a little and said, “It’s a pity that atrial septal defect closure is not a major surgery...”
“We should always start small.
Moreover, it’s heart surgery, and it’s atrial septal defect closure at that...
It’s a good start.” Zhang Anmin tried to flash a heroic smile, but no matter how he tried, he was unable to look like a man of justice.
Ma Yanlin, who was standing beside them, looked a little pale.
But he agreed.
“Heart surgeries are pretty good.”
“It’s more than good.” Zhang Anmin tried to flash an even more heroic smile, and there was a longing in his eyes.
“If we really start performing heart surgeries in the Emergency Medical Center, in the future, even your wife would have to kneel down and give you a bl*wjob at home.”
Ma Yanlin’s face immediately became even paler.
He gulped with difficulty and said, “Can you talk about something else?”
“You want something else?” Zhang Anmin gazed at his reflection on the stainless steel elevator doors and could not help but to flash a smile.
“If you want something else, then you must think about getting a promotion, no?
With a higher position, you would get more perks, such as getting more surgeries.”
Zhang Anmin had taken the opportunity to boast about his position.
And he could not help but start comparing heart surgeries and liver surgeries.
In the hospital, the Cardiology Department and the Orthopedics Department were the ones that made the most money.
Of course, profits were high in the Ophthalmology Department too.
However, with the way things were in Yun Hua Hospital now, not too many doctors were needed.
The profits made by various departments were determined by the way money was distributed in the hospital.
Now that the policy no longer favored departments that mainly earned money through drugs, the Neurosurgery Department and other internal medicine departments no longer made as much money.

Instead, departments, where plenty of expensive medical consumables were required, made plenty of money due to the fact that they could get an exaggerated amount of commission from those medical consumables.
Artificial hip joints and knee joints used in the Orthopedics Department for joint replacement surgeries cost tens of thousands of RMB.
However, it was tough to work in the Orthopedics Department, where the surgeons had to lift heavy objects like thighs, and things were a lot easier in the Cardiology Department.
Whether a person was talking about the stents that even laymen knew about or occluders which were quite rarely used, they were both pricey medical consumables.
Moreover, due to the difference in technology levels between doctors in China and foreign doctors, the prices of these medical consumables in China were often hiked.
From what Zhang Anmin knew, doctors from the Cardiology Department almost never carried out freelance surgeries.
What kind of life must they be living and how much money must they be making to be able to resist freelance surgeries?
If Zhang Anmin had a choice, he would definitely choose to become a cardiologist.
With this thought in mind, Zhang Anmin was even more determined to conquer the Cardiology Department today.
“Old Zuo, what’re you guys planning to do?” After stepping out of the elevator, Zhang Anmin immediately caught up with Zuo Cidian.
“From what I hear from Doctor Ling, he should be planning to have a friendly discussion with them,” Zuo Cidian answered earnestly, but his expression was not serious at all?
“Friendly discussion?” Zhang Anmin glanced at the resident doctors behind him.
If it were not for the fact that he was on the same team as them, he would have started laughing.
Lu Wenbin cleared his throat and said, “If a fight ensues later, I’ll be responsible for protecting Doctor Ling as he flees.”
The other people finally started laughing, which made the atmosphere a little less tense.
This was when the doctors and nurses of the Cardiology Department started noticing Ling Ran and his entourage.
They saw that there were smiles on the faces of the doctors walking behind Ling Ran.
Soon, Department Director Yuan from the Cardiology Department gathered a group of people.
He walked out of his office with those people to welcome Ling Ran.
Department Director Yuan was over the age of fifty, but his cheeks were pink, indicating that he was still as fit as a fiddle.
He looked vigilantly at Ling Ran and asked, “Doctor Ling, why are you here?
Oh, by the way, is everything fine with the patient from yesterday?
Did things go well?”

Not even a preoperative consultation required the presence of so many doctors, and Ling Ran as well as his entourage were giving Department Director Yuan the vibe that they were here to start a gang fight.
Of course, this was not the only reason why Department Director Yuan felt threatened.
He would rather have Ling Ran here for a gang fight.
This way, he would not mind too much even if all the nurses in his department were injured.
“I would like to borrow an operating theater from the Cardiology Department.
It would be best if the Cardiology Department could send some men over to help out,” Ling Ran voiced out his request right away.

He was a straightforward man, and he believed that the operating theater of the Cardiology Department was the best place to perform surgeries such as atrial septal defect closure, as it would be the simplest and the most convenient.

If Department Director Yuan agreed to it, he could immediately ask his subordinates to get the operating theater ready, and it would be best if he could learn a thing or two from the doctors from the Cardiology Department by assisting them in a couple of surgeries.
This way, the Cardiology Department basically would not be affected at all.
Ling Ran would also reap plenty of benefits out of this.
However, from the perspective of the doctors of the Cardiology Department, Ling Ran’s reply was like him firing a gun in their faces.
Department Director Yuan had expected this, and he flashed the kind of expression one had when faced with a formidable enemy.
He said with a dark expression, “Doctor Ling, you’ve just conquered a territory of the Cardiovascular Surgery Department, and I’m sure that you haven’t spent enough time enjoying it yet.
Why are you in such a rush to conquer our territory?”
Ling Ran looked at him with a baffled expression.
“There isn’t any logical relation between what you’re saying and my request at all.”
“I...” Department Director Yuan wanted to speak some harsh words, but he ended up shaking his head.
“Doctor Ling, you can forget about this.
We from the Cardiology Department have worked hard for what we have.
Things weren’t handed to us in a silver platter, you know.
Every time you’re interested in a new surgical method, look at what happened?
Look at what happened to the Cardiovascular Department, Department of Interventional Services, and the Digestive Surgery Department...”
Department Director Yuan looked around in an arrogant manner, and his gaze was sharp.

“I only intend to borrow the operating theater for around two hours.” Ling Ran merely wanted to perform a surgery, as he wanted to try out the Perfect Level Atrial Septal Defect Closure that he had just obtained.
Department Director Yuan shook his head again.
He was not worried about how long Ling Ran would be using the operating theater.
What he was worried about was Ling Ran conquering his department.
“This way, we’ll have no choice but to purchase our own facilities.” Ling Ran sighed.
He then turned and nodded at Huang Maoshi and Mai Chun, who were standing behind him.
He brought these pharmaceutical sales representatives along with him so that they could guide him regarding the related facilities.
They could also prepare the medical consumables that he would be using.
The main selling point of Changxi Medical Company was locally produced amplatzer septal occluders made of nitinol.
Meanwhile, Yunli Medical Company was capable of providing imported amplatzer septal occluders.
Ling Ran needed to weigh the pros and cons of both choices before making a decision.
When Department Director Yuan heard what Ling Ran had said, his expression immediately changed.
He no longer looked like he wanted to chase Ling Ran and his entourage away.
‘Purchase their own facilities?
‘Purchase their own facilities just to perform an atrial septal defect closure?
‘Is he an idiot?’
But Department Director Yuan could not help but feel a chill run down his spine when he thought about the implications of this idiotic plan.
It was not so easy to purchase hospital facilities.
Even the tendering process itself might take a year or two.
However, it had never been difficult for Ling Ran to purchase equipment and facilities.
Department Director Yuan could not help but think of something else.
‘If Ling Ran purchases his own facilities and builds an operating theater fit for heart surgeries, would he stop at one surgery?’
“Wait...” Department Director Yuan forced a smile.
“Doctor Ling, how many hours did you say that you need the operating theater again?”

chapters.title: Chapter 984: Coming?
paragraphs: “Two hours,” Ling Ran said. He then added, “I need an assistant too.”

Ling Ran could be said to trust the skills given by the system wholeheartedly. After all, he had tried and tested them many times. But he felt that it was a good idea for him to have an assistant watching his back.

This was especially true as it was an interventional cardiac surgery, and he should try his best to minimize errors so that this minor surgery did not become a major surgery. As long as the thoracic cavity was opened, the patient would suffer a lot of damage. And this was what interventional surgery served to prevent in the first place.
“Oh, yeah. Assistant... I’ll get a skilled doctor to help you out. You, go and call Doctor Lai over.” Department Director Yuan earnestly made arrangements. He did not seem annoyed at all.
He was already more than fifty years old, and he was able to separate what he felt like doing and what he should be doing in reality.

Of course, he felt like kicking Ling Ran out of the Cardiology Department. He was willing to do that even if his daughter would curse him and his wife would beat him up for doing so after going home. However, in reality, not only could he not do that, but he also had to treat Ling Ran well.

Compared to cardiovascular and liver surgeries, it took a lot less skill to start carrying out interventional heart surgeries. Department Director Yuan had watched Ling Ran carry out liver surgeries before too, and he knew that Ling Ran had started eating into the territory of the Cardiovascular Department...
With Ling Ran’s skills, Department Director Yuan did not expect Ling Ran to face any difficulty when he started carrying out interventional cardiac surgeries.

There were only two obstacles for a doctor who wanted to start carrying out interventional cardiac surgeries. The first one was the approval of the hospital administration, and the second one was the cost of the equipment and facilities needed.

Huo Congjun and Ling Ran had stopped being worried about the hospital administration a long time ago. Because of how Huo Congjun had been planning to expand the Emergency Department for twenty years, he was well-prepared to refute any kind of accusations and arguments. Even though ordinary departments in Yun Hua Hospital were capable of putting up a fight against Huo Congjun, it was impossible for them to shun Huo Congjun and disallow his men from carrying out surgeries that were under the domain of their departments altogether.
This was why the cost of the equipment and facilities needed to carry out interventional cardiac surgery was Department Director Yuan’s most important weapon against the Emergency Department.

Take the equipment required for coronary angiography as an example. The expensive ones would be tens of millions of RMB, and even the cheaper ones that were good enough to be used in Yun Hua Hospital would be more than four or five million RMB.
If a department were to fork out this money, no matter what, they would be dealt a huge blow.

Correspondingly, if a department spent five hundred million RMB on a piece of new equipment, the doctors in the department would definitely use it nonstop to make the piece of equipment worth the money.
What Department Director Yuan did not want to see the most was the Emergency Medical Center performing interventional cardiac surgeries nonstop.

Department Director Yuan closed his eyes for a short while and said to Ling Ran, “If there’s anything else you need, Doctor Ling, you can tell me everything at once as it would be easier for me to make arrangements for you.”

“Huh, really?” Ling Ran did not expect Department Director Yuan to be so amiable. In reality, quite a lot of people were looking at Department Director Yuan with a baffled expression, including doctors and nurses from the Cardiology Department.

Department Director Yuan closed his eyes again. He opened it again and flashed another smile. “Of course, it’s not a problem at all. Since you’re interested in interventional heart surgery, everyone in the Cardiology Department is very willing to work together with you. We have no complaints at all.”
“No complaints at all?” Behind him, Doctor Lai who had just rushed over repeated.
“No complaints at all!” Department Director Yuan repeated. He then turned to look at Doctor Lai with a solemn expression.

Doctor Lai was Department Director Yuan’s direct disciple, and if they were in a Wuxia novel, the former would have been the latter’s successor. If they were in a Xianxia novel, Doctor Lai would have been an inner sect member. If they were in a palace, Doctor Yuan would have been Department Director Yuan’s godson.
Department Director Yuan felt the most at ease to have Doctor Lai deal with Ling Ran.

Doctor Lai did not disappoint Department Director Yuan. It merely took him a look at his godfather’s eyes to understand what was going on. He turned, smiled at Ling Ran, and said obediently, “Department Director Yuan’s opinions represent the opinions of everyone in the Cardiology Department.”

Department Director Yuan nodded in satisfaction. What Doctor Lai said made a lot of sense, and it was pleasing to the ears. Not only did it exemplify Department Director Yuan’s role in the department, but it also showcased how united their department was.

“Doctor Lai, do bring Doctor Ling over to the operating theater. You can tell him about what’s going on while you’re at it so that Doctor Ling gets to save some time.” Department Director Yuan used every ounce of energy in his body to force a smile.
Doctor Lai hummed in acknowledgment. He lowered his voice a little and said, “But surgery might have already been scheduled in the operating theater.”
“Just push it back. Let Doctor Ling use it first.” After Department Director Yuan finished speaking, he even smiled at Ling Ran.

Department Director Yuan had already thought things through. The most important thing right now was to stop Ling Ran from becoming rebellious. He knew young people around Ling Ran’s age very well, as Ling Ran was about his daughter’s age. These young people would do the exact opposite of what other people told them to do.

Under current circumstances, what he was afraid the most was that Ling Ran would purchase a full set of equipment and facilities for interventional cardiac surgery from the pharmaceutical sales companies. With Ling Ran’s position and power in the hospital now, no one would give him any trouble for that.
However, that would result in plenty of trouble for the Cardiology Department.
Since Ling Ran had already achieved his goal, he felt more at ease now. He said, “You don’t have to postpone the scheduled surgery. I can take the opportunity to watch it.”
“Alright, sure,” Department Director Yuan agreed. This made things even easier for him.
“Doctor Ling, this way please.” Doctor Lai led the way.
“Wait for a moment. I have an idea.” Ling Ran looked at Department Director Yuan and said, “You mentioned that I can make any requests according to my needs just now, right?”
Department Director Yuan’s face twitched a few times. ‘I was just trying to be polite.’
However, Department Director Yuan continued to put on a polite front and said obediently, “Please go ahead.”
“Let’s have a consultation.” Ling Ran looked a little excited as he said, “We can all participate in it together.”

Right now, he had obtained plenty of knowledge about atrial septal defect closure, but he had never used them in real life. Hence, he wanted to know how ordinary doctors who were not blessed with a system went about atrial septal defect closure.
Department Director Yuan started trembling.
Not out of fear, but out of fury!
Consultations were the best place for a doctor to showcase his abilities.

When doctors from various departments sat around a table to discuss a patient’s condition, even though they appeared on the surface as if they were trying to reach a consensus, they were actually going through a very complicated version of the law of the jungle and establishing a hierarchy.
“A consultation... Will it be about interventional cardiac surgery?” Doctor Lai asked.
“Yes. the patient is thirty-nine years old this year, and he’s a blue-collar worker.” Ling Ran took the opportunity to explain the patient’s condition, and there was anticipation in his voice.

The Cardiology Department did more than just interventional cardiac surgeries. Even though the main focus of the Cardiology Department right now was the insertion of stents, Ling Ran still had plenty to learn from them due to their many years of experience.

Department Director Yuan and Doctor Lai glanced at each other, and they really did not know how to say no. They had no choice but to agree with an exasperated expression. “Alright. Let’s have a consultation, then.”

chapters.title: Chapter 985: Abnormal Situation
paragraphs: Three hours later, Doctor Lai was the first one to enter the meeting room. He smiled when he saw that the meeting room was empty. He seemed pleased with himself.
“Is Ling Ran not here yet?” Department Director Yuan walked in behind Doctor Lai. He was holding a large mug of tea and trying his best to appear elegant.
Surgeons were brutes, and the doctors of the Cardiology Department liked to put on an act of elegance as a show of force towards the other surgery departments and to dissociate themselves from them.
Doctor Lai was used to Department Director Yuan’s act of elegance. He chuckled as he turned and whispered, “Maybe he won’t even come.”
“Oh, what’s going on?”

“I played a little trick.” Doctor Lai did not bother to hide what he had done. “I heard that Ling Ran had not slept for a day and a night, as he rushed straight to our department after the rescue efforts in the Emergency Medical Center. I insisted on having the meeting right now. I reckon that Ling Ran had gone to sleep the moment he left our department just now, which means that he would get less than two hours of sleep if he attends the meeting. That’s the magic number to get people most tired, so he might not be able to wake up for the meeting.”
All doctors knew what the lack of sleep felt like.
It felt even worse to finally get the opportunity to sleep only to end up being woken up.
Doctor Lai chuckled and said, “Ling Ran is still a young man, after all. He might forget about the whole thing after he is held up for a while.”

Department Director Yuan though, merely smiled. He looked like he was a pet owner looking at his cat who brought him a mouse. Bright anticipation on his face, but he was not actually expecting anything.
Department Director Yuan had no intention of exposing the fact that Doctor Lai was definitely not powerful enough to insist on having the meeting at a designated time.

If the people in the Cardiology Department were powerful enough to “insist” upon such things, as a department director, he would not have had to come to the meeting room and participate in a preoperative consultation. It was the same reason behind why anyone would use “his friend’s Porsche” as a profile picture when using a dating application.
“Ling Ran always stays up for more than thirty hours,” whispered one of the attending physicians sitting in the corner.
Department Director Yuan was not willing to break the news to Doctor Lai, but it did not mean that the rest of the attending physicians had the same intention.

Doctor Lai could not help but furrow his eyebrows. “Ling Ran only stays up for thirty hours when he has something to do. Everyone wants more sleep when there’s nothing for them to do. Aside from this, for the past twenty-four hours, Ling Ran has done more than just existing. He was probably very busy in the Emergency Medical Center.”

“You’re right. Young people should realize what a precious resource their energy is, and they shouldn’t stay up late just because they’re young. The same goes to you. You’re already more than thirty, so try your best to operate on patients during the day. Don’t be a night owl anymore...” Department Director Yuan took the opportunity to give Doctor Lai some advice, and he was speaking in the kind of tone he used to speak to his daughter.
However, Doctor Lai was a lot more obedient compared to his daughter. He immediately nodded when he heard that. “I rarely burn the midnight oil anymore...”

The attending physician sitting in the corner twisted his mouth. His head was lowered, and he said nothing. The doctors in the Cardiology Department were very busy because of their high workload, and if Doctor Lai who was an attending physician were to operate on fewer patients in the middle of the night, the rest of the attending physicians would have to do more of it.

Of course, overall, there were not that many things for the doctors of the Cardiology Department to do when they were on night shift. This was especially true on nights when nobody died, as they would basically get to sleep all night. Hence, they rarely kept tabs or fought over who was on night shift and who was not.

After Department Director Yuan gave Doctor Lai advice, he continued, “Regarding Ling Ran, I always had the impression that he’s someone who works himself to the bone. But like what I always tell you guys, humans are not omnipotent. Even if he never sleeps, how many surgeries can he carry out? He’s already carrying out emergency surgeries, liver surgeries, hand surgeries, and Achilles tendon repair surgery. I heard that he even does arthroscopy?”
“He’s pretty good at it.” Doctor Lai smiled and said, “He even spent some time treating VIP patients.”

“He’s truly talented and skillful. But he can’t just carry out all the surgeries in the world, can he? He’s even carrying out cardiovascular surgeries now. It wouldn’t be so easy for him to carry out cardiac surgeries too.” Department Director Yuan smiled.
“I know, right?”
“That makes a lot of sense.”
The doctors in the meeting room nodded in unison.

“So, the most important thing right now is to prevent him from setting up a system.” Department Director Yuan changed the topic. “Take that guy from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. Doctor Zhang, right? I heard that he became an associate chief physician.”
“Zhang Anmin. You’re right. He’s been promoted to associate chief physician.” Most of the doctors in the meeting room were attending physicians, and they were rather envious of Zhang Anmin.

Department Director Yuan nodded a little and said, “Doctor Zhang is Ling Ran’s subordinate, but he became an associate chief physician of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery instead of the Emergency Department. So, everyone in the Cardiology Department must be careful.”
He gazed at all his attending physicians one by one. Even though there was a smile in his face, his gaze was a dangerous one.

The first challenge in a doctor’s life was to get promoted to associate chief physician from attending physician. Most attending physicians who did their work in a normal manner without offending anyone would basically become associate chief physician eventually. However, the age whereby they became associate chief physicians did make a difference. Take Zhang Anmin as an example. He was the kind who would have to work hard as an attending physician for years but would still not get a chance to become an associate chief physician before he met Ling Ran.
Department Director Yuan was vigilant, as he was worried that one of his subordinates would utilize Ling Ran’s presence as a shortcut to get promoted.
The atmosphere in the meeting room was a little tense.
*Knock, knock*

Someone knocked on the door of the meeting room. Soon after that, an adorable young nurse entered the meeting room with her hands clasped before her chest. She said, “Department director, you’re here...”

“Is Ling Ran here?” Doctor Lai glared exasperatedly at the young nurse. ‘Why do young girls nowadays care about looks so much? Can’t they be simple girls who only care about houses, cars, and the positions men hold?’
The young nurse was not afraid of him, as she was not his subordinate anyway. She glared back at him. “If Doctor Ling’s here, people would have started cheering already. Did you hear any cheers?”
Department Director Yuan cleared his throat. “Who’s here?”
“A super beautiful woman. I heard that she’s the chairwoman of Yunli Medical Company,” the young nurse said softly.
“Chairwoman?” Department Director Yuan and his subordinates looked at one another. None of them understood what was going on.

They would not have cared about pharmaceutical sales representatives from pharmaceutical sales companies. But now that the chairwoman of a pharmaceutical sales company was here, things were different.
Before Department Director Yuan could ask any more detailed questions, a tall and slender woman in a pantsuit entered the meeting room.

Due to the powerful aura the woman emanated, Department Director Yuan stood up without being aware of it. He was about to greet her when another tall and slender woman in a pantsuit entered the meeting room.
“You’re Department Director Yuan from the Cardiology Department, aren’t you?” The second woman who came in was elegant, and she spoke gracefully.
Department Director Yuan hummed in acknowledgement. “I am. May I know who I am speaking to?”

“I’m Jin Mintian from Yunli Medical Company, and I’m also the general manager of Yunli Medical Company in Yun Hua City.” Jin Mintian looked about forty years old. She was rather skinny, and she looked like a clever woman.

“Oh, you’re Manager Jin. Nice to meet you.” The moment Department Director Yuan heard his name, he recalled a thing or two about her. Yunli Medical Company had been doing very well in Changxi Province and many other provinces around it for the past two years, and he often heard about them in medical conferences and the sales events of medical consumables. Hence, he had heard Jin Miantian’s name quite a few times.

This was also when Department Director Yuan became a little annoyed with the young nurse just now. ‘She doesn’t deserve such an adorable face at all. It’s just the general manager. Why did she say that the chairwoman is here...?’
“Nice to meet you, Department Director Yuan. Please wait for a moment. We’re just accompanying our chairwoman here.” Jin Mintian smiled. She then took a few steps forward and pulled out a chair.

This was when two women wearing short formal skirts with a shirt and had broad shoulders as well as square faces showed up. Then, they looked around vigilantly before opening the door. One of them stepped outside, and the other went into the meeting room without saying a thing.
This was when Department Director Yuan and the rest of the doctors stood up straight without even realizing it.
Doctor Lai whispered, “The chairwoman of Yunli Medical Company? Why is such a bigshot coming?”
Before anyone could say anything, a young woman wearing sports shoes appeared.

“I’m sorry. I’m a little busy today. I just returned from another country.” Tian Qi was wearing fitting casual wear. She did not look formal at all, but compared to all her subordinates who were surrounding her, Tian Qi blended into the informal meeting today very well.
“Miss Tian Qi cares a lot about the updating of the medical facilities in Yun Hua Hospital. Hence, she insisted on joining this meeting even though she’s very busy.” Jin Mintian added.

“I’ll try my best not to disturb you guys. You guys discuss among yourselves, and Yunli Medical Company will try our best to cooperate.” Tian Qi flashed an amiable smile and sat in a chair at the back of the meeting room.

Department Director Yuan and his subordinates looked at one another. They did not know what situation they had gotten themselves into, but all of them knew that it was something that they had never encountered before.
This was when cheers erupted outside the door.
As the young woman’s voice was rather shrill, the cheers could be heard even more clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 986: Play House
paragraphs: This time, Ling Ran only brought Zuo Cidian, Yu Yuan, and Lu Wenbin. They went to the Cardiology Department.
He had not performed ASD closure before, otherwise, Ling Ran would not come back and forth for a surgery.

However, the Cardiology Department was highly perceptive when it came to detecting Ling Ran. After the young nurses cheered when they learned that he was coming, a few young doctors automatically followed Ling Ran as if they did it to fend against Ling Ran’s invasion.
No one, including Yu Yuan, cast a glance at the young doctors from the Cardiology Department.

Ling Ran, too, just wanted to perform ASD closure for the time being, and he was not interested in the doctors of the Cardiology Department. He was not good at handling interpersonal relationships, and Ling Ran was even lazier in fostering a relationship with people who were hostile to him.

Since his youth, too many people were around him, and too many people were willing to work for him, and they unleashed different kinds of goodwill and friendly emotions at him. Ling Ran did not need to bother with those malicious emotions either...
“Doctor Ling.” Two staff members from Yunli Medical Company stood outside the meeting room and greeted Ling Ran.

The built female bodyguard who had a thick, powerful back and shoulders also glanced at Ling Ran. Then, she curled up the corners of her mouth and took the initiative to open the door of the meeting room for him.
“Thank you.” Ling Ran showed a smile that met the expectations of society before he stepped into the meeting room.
*Creak*
When Tian Qi, who was sitting in her chair, saw Ling Ran, she happily stood up, and she made everyone stand up, each makingdifferent sounds as they pushed their chairs to get up.

Doctor Lai also stood up subconsciously, but when he did this, he felt slightly uncomfortable. He thought that it would be too deliberate if he sat down again, so he could not help but scold himself secretly, ‘Why am I still looking at beautiful girls at this time? Do I really have the freaking potential of being an *ss kisser?’

Department Director Yuan remained steadily seated in his chair. When all the sounds made by the pushing of chairs disappeared, he slowly stood up and greeted Ling Ran, “Doctor Ling, you’re here. These friends from Yunli Medical Company came to wait for you on purpose.”

“I came to Yun Hua Hospital in the morning.” Tian Qi faced Ling Ran while she smiled sweetly and said, “I needed to attend my family’s year end meeting, and when I came back, I heard that you wanted to purchase some cardiology equipment, so I just came over.”

“I wanted to borrow the operating theater from the Cardiology Department for a little while, so I haven’t made up my mind if I will purchase it.” Ling Ran smiled faintly and said again, “If I really need them, I will look for Mai Chun.”

“Sure, you are free to use the staff from the company. If you can’t find anyone suitable, you can also get help from the import and export company. Besides, my family also invests and donates to some laboratories and schools, so we can always find a way.” Tian Qi seriously analyzed the situation and provided solutions for Ling Ran.

Department Director Yuan became mad as he listened. ‘Are you guys discussing the purchase of cardiology equipment for the Emergency Department in front of me, the department director of the Cardiology Department? Isn’t this too much?’
However, Department Director Yuan could only listen to them, and he dared not say anything.

He was not willing to offend Ling Ran, and he was not willing to offend the director of a big medical company. Pharmaceutical sales representatives could be used at any time, but if they wanted to use the director, they could choose which they wanted to use.
This director in front of him had two bodyguards and seven to eight attendants accompanying her, so what she said naturally carried a lot of weight.

In other words, she might really be able to get an import and export company to help import the relevant instruments and equipment, and perhaps her family really invested and donated to the laboratories and schools...
Look at all those words, none of them were good news to him!
Department Director Yuan looked at Ling Ran, then he stared at Tian Qi. He seemed to have understood something, but he looked like he did not want to understand it.
A few seconds later, Department Director Yuan made his final decision. He acted as if he was distracted, like he did not hear anything.
‘I can’t hear anything, I don’t know anything, I don’t have a clear decision about anything, and I won’t make any decisions!’
Department Director Yuan stared blankly at air, and soon, his mind truly began to wander.
A few other doctors looked at each other. They also wanted to do this, but they were afraid that they would be too obvious.
“I won’t delay your meeting. Hmm, do you want Manager Jin to stay? She is quite familiar with the consumables,” Tian Qi said a few words before she gave her suggestion again.

She was already very happy that she could see Ling Ran, so she did not have to necessarily stay beside Ling Ran. Her father and grandfather lived like this too. Everyone was busy with their own work, so cherishing every moment they met would show the true colors of life even more.
1Ling Ran also nodded before he said, “The consultation won’t take too long.”
“Then, I’ll just stay.” Tian Qi went along with the flow and sat down. Then, she chased away all the other people except Jin Mintian.
Ling Ran smiled, then he looked at Department Director Yuan and said, “Let’s start.”
“Department Director Yuan?” Doctor Lai called out to his department director to help him snap out of his daze.
“Oh, has it started?” Department Director Yuan immediately snapped out of his daze, and he sat up straighter.

Ling Ran did not want to waste time in bantering. He immediately took out the medical record of the first day the patient was admitted and let Yu Yuan put on the powerpoint slides. He spoke at the same time, “The patient is thirty-nine years old. He has never undergone relevant examinations before this, so he did not know he has congenital heart disease. That night, he could not bear with his headache, so he was sent to the Emergency Department by his family. His BP is above 180/110... and he;’s diagnosed with transesophageal echocardiography...”
“It looks like the common atrial septal defect... Except that he was sent to the Emergency Department.” Doctor Lai could not help but make a sarcastic quip.
Ling Ran raised his head and said, “Previously, quite a number of patients with heart discomfort were passed to the Cardiology Department, but none of them had atrial septal defect?”
“What I mean is...” Doctor Lai sighed. “Forget it. Anyways, just handle this case based on the general procedure. I don’t see any meaning to this meeting.”

“Oh, because I haven’t had any preoperative consultation for ASD closure, so I want to see how you guys do it.” Ling Ran paused. “It’s very good for us to have a preoperative consultation according to the general procedure. Any words from Doctor Lai?”
Doctor Lai laughed. “It’s not as if we’re playing house...”
“Ahem.” Zuo Cidian coughed loudly before he said with a low, muffled voice, “You can just go home at any time you want.”
Doctor Lai looked at Zuo Cidian, and he was scared by his gaze.
Old resident doctor Zuo Cidian was old and ugly, but his sharp gaze was like a senior doctor who was there for a freelance surgery...
“Doctor Ling is just curious and wants to hear what we think, so we can just speak our thoughts.” Department Director Yuan eased the tension again.
He had to ease the tension. Did they really want to offend Ling Ran and the Emergency Medical Center, then watch them to invade their department?

Huo Congjun had done this kind of thing before. When they were still the Emergency Department, the dialysis room in the Emergency Department at that time suppressed the Nephrology Department by a large degree. Department Director Yuan did not want his Cardiology Department to go back to the time where they could only give out prescriptions, do the physical examinations, and compete for interventional surgery with others. At that time, the cardiologists could just become intervention specialists, but Department Director Yuan did not have any alternatives.

When a person became a department director, that person was the king of the department. A department director in a hospital like Yun Hua Hospital was even the king of a medical field. However, this also meant that if he could not win against others in a competition, they could only be suppressed continuously.
“You, whatever your name is, we’ll start from you. Just do things according to the normal procedure of a consultation.” Department Director Yuan waved his hand to ask his subordinate to start acting.
The Cardiology Department also put up the same show when certain inspection groups came over.
As requested by Department Director Yuan, the cardiologists obediently became alert and started to get into their roles.
“The patient does not have surgical contraindications. He has normal myocardium and has mild mitral regurgitation, but it won’t affect the surgery...”
“He’s at a suitable age.”
“I suggest to use transthoracic echocardiography during the surgery, and place the occluder inside to provide assistance.”

Everyone talked about this superficial topic seriously, just like unprofessional actors acting with each other and competing to see who was the better actor. Their exaggerated actions and loud voices made the consultation look more dramatic.

However, Ling Ran was very interested in listening to them. Just like how Doctor Lai and the others presented the case, ASD Closure was a simple surgery, but every simple thing would become complicated when it aimed for perfection.
After he listened for a while, Ling Ran slowly felt he had roughly mastered the situation. He thought for a while before he called for the system in his mind and asked, ‘Should we do a mission?’
After four to five seconds, the system slowly gave him a mission.
1[Mission: Atrial Septal Defect Closure]
[Mission Details: Perform a successful/perfect atrial septal defect closure.]
[Reward: Basic Treasure Chest/Intermediate Treasure Chest]

At that time, the cardiologists could just become intervention specialists, but Department Director Yuan did not have any alternatives.
When a person became a department director, that person was the king of the department.
A department director in a hospital like Yun Hua Hospital was even the king of a medical field.
However, this also meant that if he could not win against others in a competition, they could only be suppressed continuously.
“You, whatever your name is, we’ll start from you.
Just do things according to the normal procedure of a consultation.” Department Director Yuan waved his hand to ask his subordinate to start acting.
The Cardiology Department also put up the same show when certain inspection groups came over.
As requested by Department Director Yuan, the cardiologists obediently became alert and started to get into their roles.
“The patient does not have surgical contraindications.
He has normal myocardium and has mild mitral regurgitation, but it won’t affect the surgery...”
“He’s at a suitable age.”
“I suggest to use transthoracic echocardiography during the surgery, and place the occluder inside to provide assistance.”
Everyone talked about this superficial topic seriously, just like unprofessional actors acting with each other and competing to see who was the better actor.
Their exaggerated actions and loud voices made the consultation look more dramatic.
However, Ling Ran was very interested in listening to them.
Just like how Doctor Lai and the others presented the case, ASD Closure was a simple surgery, but every simple thing would become complicated when it aimed for perfection.
After he listened for a while, Ling Ran slowly felt he had roughly mastered the situation.
He thought for a while before he called for the system in his mind and asked, ‘Should we do a mission?’
After four to five seconds, the system slowly gave him a mission.
1[Mission: Atrial Septal Defect Closure]
[Mission Details: Perform a successful/perfect atrial septal defect closure.]
[Reward: Basic Treasure Chest/Intermediate Treasure Chest]

chapters.title: Chapter 987: Not Resisting
paragraphs: At the operating theater, under the green wall were six medical staff who wore blue scrubs. They were nervous, but they still worked in an organized way.
Ling Ran stood at the position of the chief surgeon and looked at Department Director Yuan who was adjusting the instruments and devices.

For some unknown reason, Department Director Yuan decided that he was the only one who was suited to deal with the instruments and devices in the operating theater of the Cardiology Department. Because of his persistence in this, Ling Ran and Zuo Cidian could only tacitly agree to his insistence.
In fact, Ling Ran was not interested in the preoperative preparation on the devices. He would at most only check through it once before he let his subordinates do the rest.
If Department Director Yuan was willing to do this work, Ling Ran was fine with it.
Doctor Lai stood beside Department Director Yuan and helped him. He felt sorry for Department Director Yuan and almost cried when he saw how busy his department director was.
Department Director Yuan was struggling because he was concerned about the survival, the rise, and the fall of the Cardiology Department.
At that moment, Department Director Yuan did not look like a department director anymore!

Department Director Yuan was the department director of the Cardiology Department of Yun Hua Hospital. In Yun Hua City or even in Changxi Province, those in this position would be greatly respected. The respect was not directed to just their position, but also to the knowledge that the person with this position had.

Regardless of whether the patient was a rich businessman or an officer who had high authority, if someone had a problem with their heart, they would definitely look for the department director of the Cardiology Department. Only 20% of the patients who were crazy would choose to go to the People’s Liberation Army General Hospital and the provincial hospital.
Doctor Lai had seen his department director acting and energetically, and at that time, he looked very cool.
Doctor Lai could still remember his department director’s voice when he taught them, and that was very cool.
Doctor Lai could still remember his department director’s look when he scolded his subordinates, and that was... something he did not want to see again...
However, Department Director Yuan always gave Doctor Lai a strong sense of security.
Even when Department Director Yuan faced a senior administrative officer or the hospital’s leader, he would not become as... humble as he was today.
“Department director, let me do this.” Doctor Lai bowed and whispered to the department director who was busy with the devices.
But Department Director Yuan glared at Doctor Lai fiercely, and he said, “Did you forget what I said?”
“No.” Doctor Lai lowered his head.
He still remembered what the department director had told him.

The devices in the Cardiology Department were purchased one after another in the past decade. Each time, there would be different pharmaceutical companies, pharmaceutical sales representatives, and leaders who participated in the purchasing process. So, the instruments and devices purchased at the end would not be the perfect package.

But even though they did not manage to buy the perfect packing, they were still able to use the devices and instruments by mixing and matching them, and this was the result of the hard work poured forward by the cardiologists in the Cardiology Department over the years.

For example, the oxygen suction unit and flowmeter had never been accurate before. When it reached the last bar, they always needed to pay attention to oxygen flow, and that resulted in a necessity to always prepare extra oxygen bags in the operating theater.

Another example was the ECG monitor package. Even if it was placed on its original rack, there would be broad wave interruptions no matter how it was adjusted. Only when it was torn down and put at the opposite would the broad wave interruptions disappear...

The Cardiology Department was the department that earned the most for the hospital, and the department also had the most imported devices. The minor problems in these devices used to cause everyone in the Cardiology Department to be incredibly frustrated and annoyed.
However, today, this advantage became the last defense line of the Cardiology Department.

Department Director Yuan was willing to humble himself and worked on his own to secure this defense line. Although it did not mean anything much, Doctor Lai could understand the department director’s mentality.
Just as the department director said, once a doctor had first class skills, he would have nothing to fear unless he was facing a top-class doctor.
Doctor Lai looked at Ling Ran who was at the operating table through the corner of his eyes.
‘Top-class doctor, huh?’
He believed what the department director said, somewhat, but he was unwilling to accept it.

Although the interventional surgery in the Cardiology Department was much easier than hepatectomy, it could not be performed by any Tom, Dick, and Harry, and these people were definitely not qualified to perform a top-class surgery.

Even Department Director Yuan would only say that he was a first-class doctor although he had performed more than two thousand interventional cardiovascular surgeries. He would not dare to declare himself as a top-class doctor. In that case, Doctor Lai would not trust his department director’s words that much.
“Doctor Ling, the devices are ready.” Department Director Yuan stood up and showed a calm look.
He would not surrender. However... he would not fight back aggressively. Certainly, the Department Director would not give up easily...
Afterall, the Cardiology Department and his destiny would be determined by Ling Ran.

Fierce competition between the Emergency Medical Center and the Cardiology Department would only happen if Ling Ran’s skill was good and desired more benefits, otherwise, Department Director Yuan felt that his passive confrontation could still work.
‘Hopefully... it works...’
Department Director Yuan’s sight fell on Ling Ran.
Ling Ran stood straight and was dressed neatly right then. By just looking at his appearance, he could tell how serious Ling Ran was.
However, even in such a serious event today, Department Director Yuan could still notice Ling Ran’s handsomeness through his imposing presence.
‘A man with such a handsome face is willing to stay in dark operating theaters.’ Department Director Huo felt terrified when he thought about that.
“I’m ready, too.” Today’s anesthetist was someone who was always used by the Cardiology Department. However, just to be safe, Zuo Cidian asked Su Jiafu to come over and help.
So, even if it was just a simple atrial septal defect, the operating theater today was crowded.
“I’m performing the puncture now.” Ling Ran pressed the patient’s disinfected femoral vein twice and poked through the skin along the femoral vein.

This was a very normal action. This was especially so in the Cardiology Department. The number of times they performed this action was more than the total daily sex life of married or unmarried couples.
However, Doctor Lai looked very awkward.
‘You’re just a doctor from the Emergency Department. How can you be so familiar with poking the femoral vein? What do you use to practice in private?’
“Catheter.”
“Harden the exchange guide wire.”
“Measure the defect size.”
Ling Ran’s voice could be heard intermittently, and it made Doctor Lai’s new thoughts disappear.
Ling Ran’s orders had a distinct, unfamiliar quality to them. The resident doctor in the Cardiology Department could be considered as senior compared to Ling Ran.
Therefore, Doctor Lai was sure that Ling Ran had not performed many surgeries in the field of cardiology before.
‘But how could he be so familiar with the operation?’
Doctor Lai’s thoughts kept popping up in his mind.
If he had a lightbulb pop up above his head every time he had a thought appear in his mind, he could probably become the landscape lighting in the city.
“Can you choose an occluder with a diameter of 1.2 inches?” At this moment, Ling Ran looked at the pharmaceutical sales representatives at the corner of the operating theater.

The occluder that he used was one of the imported items sold by Yunli Medical Company. Due to the different sizes, there were twenty to thirty types of occluder. The most suitable size of the occluder was selected based on the intraoperative measurement result.
The pharmaceutical sales representative from Yunli Medical Company immediately reported the model type, and the nurse took it out for examination.
This was also the scene that Doctor Lai was incredibly familiar with, and also the scene that he did not want to see the most.
Ling Ran had chosen the pharmaceutical sales company that he was familiarized with and also its occluder.
For the Cardiology Department, this was a destructive problem.
Doctor Lai immediately looked at Department Director Yuan.
Department Director Huo was upset and shook his head gently.
